definitions.definitionEn: To be reasonable or acceptable.

example.en: It simply will not do to have dozens of children running around such a quiet event.
example.ja: こうした静かな出来事の中で、幾十人もの子供が走り回るということは決してありません。

definitions.definitionEn: (ditransitive) To have (as an effect).

example.en: The fresh air did him some good.
example.ja: 新鮮な空気は彼に少し効果があった。

definitions.definitionEn: To fare, perform (well or poorly).

example.en: Our relationship isn't doing very well;  how do you do?
example.ja: 私たちの関係はうまく行ってませんどうですか?

definitions.definitionEn: (chiefly in questions) To have as one's job.

example.en: What does Bob do? — He's a plumber.
example.ja: ボブはどうするでしょうか。

definitions.definitionEn: To perform the tasks or actions associated with (something).

example.en: "Don't forget to do your report" means something quite different depending on whether you're a student or a programmer.
example.ja: 学生かプログラマかによっては、かなり違う意味が生じます。

definitions.definitionEn: To cook.

example.en: I'll just do some eggs.
example.ja: 私は卵をいくつか。

definitions.definitionEn: To travel in, to tour, to make a circuit of.

example.en: Let’s do New York also.
example.ja: ニューヨークもやってみましょう。

definitions.definitionEn: To treat in a certain way.
To work for or on, by way of caring for, looking after, preparing, cleaning, keeping in order, etc.
To act or behave in a certain manner; to conduct oneself.
To spend (time) in jail. (See also do time)

example.en: I did five years for armed robbery.
example.ja: 武装強盗で5年

definitions.definitionEn: To impersonate or depict.

example.en: They really laughed when he did Clinton, with a perfect accent and a leer.
example.ja: 彼はクリントンをやったとき本当に笑ったアクセントもレバーも完璧だった

definitions.definitionEn: (with 'a' and the name of a person, place, event, etc.) To copy or emulate the actions or behaviour that is associated with the person or thing mentioned.

example.en: He did a Henry VIII and got married six times.
example.ja: ヘンリー8世を 6回結婚した

definitions.definitionEn: To kill.
To deal with for good and all; to finish up; to undo; to ruin; to do for.
To punish for a misdemeanor.

example.en: He got done for speeding.
example.ja: スピード違反で終わったんだ

definitions.definitionEn: To have sex with. (See also do it)
To cheat or swindle.

example.en: That guy just did me out of two hundred bucks!
example.ja: あの野郎は 200ドルで俺を殺った!

definitions.definitionEn: To convert into a certain form; especially, to translate.

example.en: the novel has just been done into English;  I'm going to do this play into a movie
example.ja: 2019年10月10日閲覧. ^ ""映画". 映画ナタリー (2018年3月21日).

definitions.definitionEn: To finish.
To work as a domestic servant (with for).
(auxiliary) Used to form the present progressive of verbs.
To cash or to advance money for, as a bill or note.
(ditransitive) To make or provide.

example.en: Could you do me a burger with mayonnaise instead of ketchup?
example.ja: ケチャップの代わりにマヨネーズを

definitions.definitionEn: To injure (one's own body part).
To take drugs.

example.en: I do cocaine.
example.ja: コカインはやってる

definitions.definitionEn: (in the form be doing [somewhere]) To exist with a purpose or for a reason.

example.en: What's that car doing in our swimming pool?
example.ja: プールで何してるの?

definitions.definitionEn: A syllable used in solfège to represent the first and eighth tonic of a major scale.
As said before, likewise.

meaning: ～として／～するように／～するとき

definitions.definitionEn: To such an extent or degree; to the same extent or degree.

example.en: It's not as well made, but it's twice as expensive.
example.ja: (2018年3月18日). http://www.nikkansports.com/articles/news/ 2018年2月22日閲覧. ^ "あまりよく作られていないが、高価で2倍も高い。

definitions.definitionEn: Considered to be, in relation to something else; in the relation (specified).

example.en: 1865, The Act of Suicide as Distinct from the Crime of Self-Murder: A Sermon
example.ja: 1865年、自衛隊の犯罪と別段の自殺行為:伝承。

definitions.definitionEn: For example; for instance. (Compare such as.)
Introducing a basis of comparison, with an object in the objective case.

example.en: They're big as houses.
example.ja: 家のように大きい

definitions.definitionEn: In the role of.

example.en: He was never seen as the boss, but rather as a friend.
example.ja: 彼は決してボスとしてではなく友人として見られなかった。

definitions.definitionEn: In the (same) way or manner that; to the (same) degree that.

example.en: As you wish, my lord!
example.ja: 御意のままに、閣下!

definitions.definitionEn: At the time that; during the time when:
Being that, considering that, because, since.

example.en: As it’s too late, I quit.
example.ja: もう遅すぎるので、私はやめました。

definitions.definitionEn: Introducing a comparison with a hypothetical state (+ subjunctive, or with the verb elided): as though, as if.
Functioning as a relative conjunction, and sometimes like a relative pronoun: that, which, who. (See usage notes.)

example.en: He had the same problem as she did getting the lock open.
example.ja: 錠を開けた時と同じ問題を抱えてた

definitions.definitionEn: (possibly obsolete) Than.
(unit of weight) A libra.
Any of several coins of Rome, coined in bronze or later copper; or the equivalent value.
To reply to or talk to someone, either online or face-to-face. (from the practice of targeting a message or reply to someone online by writing @name)

example.en: Cars 2 is the most influential film of all time. Don't @ me.
example.ja: 自動車2は史上最も影響力のあるフィルムです。

definitions.definitionEn: The at sign (@).
In, near, or in the general vicinity of a particular place.

example.en: Caesar was at Rome;  at the corner of Fourth Street and Vine;  at Jim’s house
example.ja: カエサルはローマにいた。

definitions.definitionEn: (indicating time) Indicating occurrence in an instant of time or a period of time relatively short in context or from the speaker's perspective.

example.en: at six o’clock;  at closing time;  at night.
example.ja: 6 時、閉幕時、夜。

definitions.definitionEn: In the direction of (often in an unfocused or uncaring manner).

example.en: He threw the ball at me.  He shouted at her.
example.ja: 彼はボールを投げて彼女に向かって叫んだ

definitions.definitionEn: Denotes a price.

example.en: 3 apples at 2¢ (each)   The offer was at $30,000 before negotiations.
example.ja: 3 個のリンゴ(それぞれ2個につき3個) この申し出は交渉前の3万ドルだった。

definitions.definitionEn: Occupied in (activity).

example.en: men at work
example.ja: 男性が仕事をする

definitions.definitionEn: In a state of.

example.en: She is at sixes and sevens with him.  They are at loggerheads over how best to tackle the fiscal cliff.  The city was at the mercy of the occupying forces.
example.ja: 昭和六十七年十八年十四月十七日閲覧. ^ a b c d e f g h i j k l m c d a b "都道府県は、財政崖の対処の最上段を調査中". 国土交通省。

definitions.definitionEn: Indicates a position on a scale or in a series.

example.en: Sell at 90.  Tiger finished the round at tenth, seven strokes behind the leaders.  I'm offering it—just to select customers—at cost.
example.ja: 90に販売. タイガーは、第10,第7弾をリーダーの裏で終えた。

definitions.definitionEn: Because of.

example.en: to laugh at a joke   mad at their comments
example.ja: 彼らのコメントに怒ったジョークを笑う。

definitions.definitionEn: Indicates a means, method, or manner.
Holding a given speed or rate.

example.en: It is growing at the rate of 3% a year.  Cruising along at fifty miles per hour.
example.ja: 年間3パーセントの成長率で時速50マイルで

definitions.definitionEn: (used for skills (including in activities) or areas of knowledge) On the subject of; regarding.

example.en: He slipped at marksmanship over his extended vacation.
example.ja: 長い休暇の間、首飾りをはぎ取られました。

definitions.definitionEn: (stressed pronunciation) Bothering, irritating, causing discomfort to
Reduced form of that.

example.en: I've never seen anything like ’at.
example.ja: あんなの見た事ない

definitions.definitionEn: A subdivision of currency, equal to one hundredth of a Lao kip.
A female.

example.en: Pat is definitely a she.
example.ja: パットは間違いなく彼女だ

definitions.definitionEn: (personal) The female person or animal previously mentioned or implied.

example.en: After the cat killed a mouse, she left it on our doorstep.
example.ja: 猫がネズミを殺したあと、玄関のドアのところに置いておきました。

definitions.definitionEn: (personal, sometimes affectionate) A ship or boat.

example.en: She could do forty knots in good weather.
example.ja: 天気が良くても40ノットだ

definitions.definitionEn: (personal, sometimes affectionate, old-fashioned) A country, or sometimes a city, province, planet, etc.

example.en: She is a poor place, but has beautiful scenery and friendly people.
example.ja: 彼女は貧しい土地ですが、美しい景色と友好的な人々がいます。

definitions.definitionEn: (personal, old-fashioned) Any machine or thing, such as a car, a computer, or (poetically) a season.

example.en: She only gets thirty miles to the gallon on the highway, but she’s durable.
example.ja: 高速道路では 1 リットルの水しか得られませんが、長持ちします。

definitions.definitionEn: (personal) A person whose gender is unknown or irrelevant (used in a work, along with or in place of he, as an indefinite pronoun).
An instance or example of using the word "but".

example.en: It has to be done – no ifs or buts.
example.ja: 然れど又は非なり。

definitions.definitionEn: The outer room of a small two-room cottage.
A limit; a boundary.
The end; especially the larger or thicker end, or the blunt, in distinction from the sharp, end; the butt.
Use the word "but".

example.en: But me no buts.
example.ja: しかし、私は違う。

definitions.definitionEn: Merely, only, just.

example.en: Christmas comes  but once a year.
example.ja: クリスマスは年に一度しか来ない。

definitions.definitionEn: Though, however.

example.en: I'll have to go home early but.
example.ja: 早く家に帰らなきゃ

definitions.definitionEn: Used as an intensifier.

example.en: Nobody, but nobody, crosses me and gets away with it.
example.ja: 誰も、誰も、誰も、私を渡して、それを逃れる。

definitions.definitionEn: Apart from, except (for), excluding.

example.en: Everyone but Father left early.
example.ja: 父以外にはみんな早く出て行った。

definitions.definitionEn: (obsolete outside Scotland) Outside of.
On the contrary, rather (as a regular adversative conjunction, introducing a word or clause in contrast or contradiction with the preceding negative clause or sentence).

example.en: I am not rich but [I am] poor  not John but Peter went there.
example.ja: わたしは富んではいませんが、貧しいのはヨハネではなく、ペテロがそこへ行ったからです。

definitions.definitionEn: However, although, nevertheless, on the other hand (introducing a clause contrary to prior belief or in contrast with the preceding clause or sentence).

example.en: She is very old but still attractive.
example.ja: 彼女は非常に年を取りましたが、それでも魅力的です。

definitions.definitionEn: Except that (introducing a subordinate clause which qualifies a negative statement); also, with omission of the subject of the subordinate clause, acting as a negative relative, "except one that", "except such that".

example.en: I cannot but feel offended.
example.ja: 私は感情を害されずにはいられません。

definitions.definitionEn: Without its also being the case that; unless that (introducing a necessary concomitant).

example.en: It never rains but it pours.
example.ja: 物事は重なって起こる。

definitions.definitionEn: Except with; unless with; without.
Only; solely; merely.
Until.
(following a negated expression of improbability) That.
Used to indicate source or provenance.

example.en: I got a letter from my brother.
example.ja: 弟から手紙が届いた

definitions.definitionEn: Originating at (a year, time, etc.)

example.en: This manuscript is from the 1980s.
example.ja: この原稿は1980年代のもの。

definitions.definitionEn: Used to indicate a starting point or initial reference.

example.en: Face away from the wall!
example.ja: 壁から離れて!

definitions.definitionEn: Indicating removal or separation.

example.en: After twenty minutes, remove the cake from the oven.
example.ja: 20分後、ケーキをオーブンから脱いでください。

definitions.definitionEn: Indicating exclusion.

example.en: A parasol protects from the sun.
example.ja: パラソルは太陽から守られます。

definitions.definitionEn: Indicating differentiation.

example.en: He knows right from wrong.
example.ja: 神は正しいことを悪からご存じです。

definitions.definitionEn: Produced with or out of (a substance or material).

example.en: It's made from pure gold.
example.ja: 純粋な金から作られている。

definitions.definitionEn: Used to indicate causation; because of, as a result of.

example.en: Too many people die from breast cancer.
example.ja: 乳がんで亡くなる人は多すぎます。

definitions.definitionEn: A flying insect, of the clade Anthophila within the hymenopteran superfamily Apoidea, known for its organised societies (though only a minority have them), for collecting pollen and (in some species) producing wax and honey.
A contest, especially for spelling; see spelling bee.

example.en: geography bee
example.ja: 地理的なハチ

definitions.definitionEn: A community gathering to share labour, e.g. a sewing bee or a quilting bee.
A ring or torque; a bracelet.
The name of the Latin-script letter B.
(usually in the plural) Any of the pieces of hard wood bolted to the sides of the bowsprit, to reeve the fore-topmast stays through.
Out of the way, subsidiary.
Along a path which runs past the speaker.

example.en: I watched as it passed by.
example.ja: 通り過ぎていくのを見てた

definitions.definitionEn: In the vicinity, near.

example.en: The shop is hard by the High Street.
example.ja: ハイストリートは店が苦手だ

definitions.definitionEn: To or at a place, as a residence or place of business.

example.en: I'll stop by on my way home from work.
example.ja: 仕事から帰る途中で寄ってくる

definitions.definitionEn: Aside, away.

example.en: The women spent much time after harvest putting jams by for winter and spring.
example.ja: 女性たちは、収穫後多くの時間を費やして、冬と春のためにジャムを用意しました。

definitions.definitionEn: Near or next to.

example.en: The mailbox is by the bus stop.
example.ja: 郵便はバス停の近く。

definitions.definitionEn: From one side of something to the other, passing close by; past.

example.en: He ran straight by me.
example.ja: 彼は直撃した

definitions.definitionEn: Not later than (the given time); not later than the end of (the given time interval).

example.en: Be back by ten o'clock!.
example.ja: 10時までに戻って!

definitions.definitionEn: Indicates the person or thing that does or causes something: Through the action or presence of.
Indicates the creator of a work: Existing through the authorship etc. of.

example.en: There are many well-known plays by William Shakespeare
example.ja: ウィリアム・シェイクスピアの有名な戯曲は数多くあります

definitions.definitionEn: Indicates a means of achieving something: Involving/using the means of.

example.en: By 'maybe' she means 'no'.
example.ja: "たぶん"とは,"ノー"という意味だ。

definitions.definitionEn: Indicates an authority according to which something is done.

example.en: By the power vested in me, I now pronounce you man and wife.
example.ja: 私の中に備わった力によって、私は今、夫婦を宣言する。

definitions.definitionEn: Indicates a means of classification or organisation.

example.en: I sorted the items by category.
example.ja: カテゴリで並べ替えた

definitions.definitionEn: Indicates the amount of change, difference or discrepancy

example.en: His date of birth was wrong by ten years.
example.ja: 彼の誕生日は 10 年もの間に間違っていました。

definitions.definitionEn: In the formulae X by X and by Xs, indicates a steady progression, one X after another.

example.en: We crawled forward by inches.
example.ja: 私たちは数センチ前に進み出ました。

definitions.definitionEn: Indicates a referenced source: According to.

example.en: By my reckoning, we should be nearly there.
example.ja: 私の計算では、我々はほぼそこにする必要があります。

definitions.definitionEn: Used to separate dimensions when describing the size of something.

example.en: It is easy to invert a 2-by-2 matrix.
example.ja: 2 x 2 の行列を反転させるのは容易です。

definitions.definitionEn: (horse breeding) Designates a horse's male parent (sire); cf. out of.

example.en: She's a lovely little filly, by Big Lad, out of Damsel in Distress.
example.ja: 彼女は美しい小さな充実しているビッグ・ラッドによる「苦悩」のダムセルから

definitions.definitionEn: The position of a person or team in a tournament or competition who draws no opponent in a particular round so advances to the next round unopposed, or is awarded points for a win in a league table; also the phantom opponent of such a person or team.

example.en: Craig's Crew plays the bye next week.
example.ja: クレイグ・クルーは来週はサヨナラする

definitions.definitionEn: An extra scored when the batsmen take runs after the ball has passed the striker without hitting either the bat or the batsman.
A dwelling.
A thing not directly aimed at; something which is a secondary object of regard; an object by the way, etc.
A pass.
Goodbye.
(now uncommon or literary) To wish, desire (something).

example.en: Do what you will.
example.ja: 好きにしろ

definitions.definitionEn: (nowadays rare) To wish or desire (that something happen); to intend (that).
(auxiliary) To habitually do (a given action).
(auxiliary) To choose to (do something); used to express intention but without any temporal connotations (+ bare infinitive), often in negation.

example.en: I’ve told him three times, but he won’t take his medicine.
example.ja: 私は 3 回も話しましたが、医師は薬を受けようとしません。

definitions.definitionEn: (auxiliary) Used to express the future tense, sometimes with some implication of volition when used in the first person. Compare shall.
(auxiliary) To be able to, to have the capacity to.

example.en: Unfortunately, only one of these gloves will actually fit over my hand.
example.ja: 残念なことに、この手袋の1つだけが実際に私の手の上に収まります。

definitions.definitionEn: (auxiliary) Expressing a present tense with some conditional or subjective weakening: "will turn out to", "must by inference".
One's independent faculty of choice; the ability to be able to exercise one's choice or intention.

example.en: Of course, man's will is often regulated by his reason.
example.ja: 言うまでもなく、人の意志は、その理由によりしばしば統制される。

definitions.definitionEn: One's intention or decision; someone's orders or commands.

example.en: Eventually I submitted to my parents' will.
example.ja: やがて私は親の遺言に従うようになった。

definitions.definitionEn: The act of choosing to do something; a person’s conscious intent or volition.

example.en: Most creatures have a will to live.
example.ja: 大抵の動物には生きる意志があります。

definitions.definitionEn: Law A formal declaration of one's intent concerning the disposal of one's property and holdings after death; the legal document stating such wishes.
That which is desired; one's wish.
Desire, longing. (Now generally merged with later senses.)

example.en: He felt a great will to make a pilgrimage to the Holy Land.
example.ja: 彼は聖地に巡礼することに大きな意志を感じました。

definitions.definitionEn: To wish, desire.
To instruct (that something be done) in one's will.
To try to make (something) happen by using one's will (intention).

example.en: All the fans were willing their team to win the game.
example.ja: ファンたちは全員、試合に勝つために、チームを喜んでいた。

definitions.definitionEn: To bequeath (something) to someone in one's will (legal document).

example.en: He willed his stamp collection to the local museum.
example.ja: 彼は地元の博物館に切手を寄贈したいと思いました。

definitions.definitionEn: Connects at least two alternative words, phrases, clauses, sentences, etc. each of which could make a passage true. In English, this is the "inclusive or." The "exclusive or" is formed by "either [...] or".

example.en: He might get cancer, or be hit by a bus, or God knows what.
example.ja: 癌になるかもしれないしバスに打たれるかもしれない

definitions.definitionEn: An operator denoting the disjunction of two propositions or truth values. There are two forms, the inclusive or and the exclusive or.
Counts the elements before and after as two possibilities.
Otherwise (a consequence of the condition that the previous is false).

example.en: It's raining! Come inside or you'll catch a cold!
example.ja: 雨だ中に入って風邪をひくぞ!

definitions.definitionEn: Connects two equivalent names.

example.en: The country Myanmar, or Burma
example.ja: ミャンマー、つまりビルマ

definitions.definitionEn: The binary operator inclusive or, true if one at least one of two inputs is true. In infix notation.
Initialism of Olympic Record.
Initialism of odorant receptor.
Initialism of olfactory receptor.
(Wiktionary and WMF jargon) Initialism of original research.
A room in a hospital used for performing surgical operations.
(operations) The application of scientific methods and techniques to problems of decision making, especially in business management and government administration.
The gold or yellow tincture on a coat of arms.
Of gold or yellow tincture on a coat of arms.
Early (on).
Earlier, previously.
Before; ere. Followed by "ever" or "ere".
A chance to speak; the right or power to influence or make a decision.
To pronounce.

example.en: Please say your name slowly and clearly.
example.ja: ゆっくりとはっきり言ってください

definitions.definitionEn: To recite.

example.en: Martha, will you say the Pledge of Allegiance?
example.ja: マーサあなたは「忠誠の書記」と言う?

definitions.definitionEn: To tell, either verbally or in writing.

example.en: He said he would be here tomorrow.
example.ja: 明日来るって

definitions.definitionEn: To indicate in a written form.

example.en: The sign says it’s 50 kilometres to Paris.
example.ja: 看板には、パリ行き50kmと書いてある。

definitions.definitionEn: To have a common expression; used in singular passive voice or plural active voice to indicate a rumor or well-known fact.

example.en: They say "when in Rome, do as the Romans do", which means "behave as those around you do."
example.ja: "ローマでは"と云うが,"周囲の人のように振る舞う"といふ。

definitions.definitionEn: Suppose, assume; used to mark an example, supposition or hypothesis.

example.en: A holiday somewhere warm – Florida, say – would be nice.
example.ja: 暖かな場所の休日 - フロリダとか...

definitions.definitionEn: To speak; to express an opinion; to make answer; to reply.
(of a possession, especially money) To bet as a wager on an outcome; by extension, used to express belief in an outcome by the speaker.
For example; let us assume.

example.en: He was driving pretty fast, say, fifty miles per hour.
example.ja: 時速50マイルのスピードで走っていた

definitions.definitionEn: Used to gain someone's attention before making an inquiry or suggestion

example.en: Say, what did you think about the movie?
example.ja: 映画はどう思った?

definitions.definitionEn: A type of fine cloth similar to serge.
Trial by sample; assay; specimen.
Tried quality; temper; proof.
Essay; trial; attempt.
To try; to assay.
A strainer for milk.
The act of going.
A turn at something, or in something (e.g. a game).

example.en: It’s your go.
example.ja: それはあなたの行くべき道です。

definitions.definitionEn: An attempt, a try.

example.en: I’ll give it a go.
example.ja: わたしはやってみましょう。

definitions.definitionEn: An approval or permission to do something, or that which has been approved.

example.en: We will begin as soon as the boss says it's a go.
example.ja: ボスの言動がばれるとすぐに始める。

definitions.definitionEn: An act; the working or operation.
A circumstance or occurrence; an incident, often unexpected.
The fashion or mode.

example.en: quite the go
example.ja: かなりの量だ

definitions.definitionEn: Noisy merriment.

example.en: a high go
example.ja: 盛大に

definitions.definitionEn: A glass of spirits; a quantity of spirits.
Power of going or doing; energy; vitality; perseverance.

example.en: There is no go in him.
example.ja: 彼へは入ってこない

definitions.definitionEn: The situation where a player cannot play a card which will not carry the aggregate count above thirty-one.
A period of activity.

example.en: ate it all in one go
example.ja: 全部一度に食べました

definitions.definitionEn: (British slang) A dandy; a fashionable person.
To move:
(chiefly of a machine) To work or function (properly); to move or perform (as required).

example.en: The engine just won't go anymore.
example.ja: エンジンはもう動かない

definitions.definitionEn: To start; to begin (an action or process).

example.en: Get ready, get set, go!
example.ja: 構えろ!

definitions.definitionEn: To take a turn, especially in a game.

example.en: It’s your turn; go.
example.ja: あなたの番です。

definitions.definitionEn: To attend.

example.en: I go to school at the schoolhouse.
example.ja: 学校の学校へ通う。

definitions.definitionEn: To proceed:
To follow or travel along (a path):
To extend (from one point in time or space to another).

example.en: This property goes all the way to the state line.
example.ja: この資産は状態の線まで続く。

definitions.definitionEn: To lead (to a place); to give access to.

example.en: Does this road go to Fort Smith?
example.ja: この道路はフォート・スミスまで?

definitions.definitionEn: To become. (The adjective that follows usually describes a negative state.)

example.en: After failing as a criminal, he decided to go straight.
example.ja: 犯罪者として失敗したので、まっすぐに行くことにしました。

definitions.definitionEn: To assume the obligation or function of; to be, to serve as.
To continuously or habitually be in a state.

example.en: I don't want my children to go hungry.
example.ja: 子供に腹をすかせたくない。

definitions.definitionEn: To come to (a certain condition or state).

example.en: They went into debt, she goes to sleep around 10 o'clock.
example.ja: 彼らは借金をし、彼女は10時頃寝ます。

definitions.definitionEn: To change (from one value to another) in the meaning of wend.

example.en: The traffic light went straight from green to red.
example.ja: 交通信号は緑から赤へと直進した。

definitions.definitionEn: To turn out, to result; to come to (a certain result).

example.en: How did your meeting with Smith go?
example.ja: スミスとの出会いは?

definitions.definitionEn: To tend (toward a result).

example.en: These experiences go to make us stronger.
example.ja: こうした経験は、わたしたちを強くします。

definitions.definitionEn: To contribute to a (specified) end product or result.

example.en: qualities that go to make a lady / lip-reader / sharpshooter
example.ja: 女性 / 唇のリーガー / シャープシューターを作るための資質

definitions.definitionEn: To pass, to be used up:
To die.
To be discarded.

example.en: This chair has got to go.
example.ja: この椅子を取らないと

definitions.definitionEn: To be lost or out:
To break down or apart:
To be sold.

example.en: Everything must go.
example.ja: すべてをしなければならない。

definitions.definitionEn: To be given, especially to be assigned or allotted.

example.en: The award went to Steven Spielberg.
example.ja: 賞はスティーブン・スピルバーグに贈られた。

definitions.definitionEn: To survive or get by; to last or persist for a stated length of time.

example.en: Can you two go twenty minutes without arguing?!
example.ja: 二人は二十分間も議論せずに済みますか。

definitions.definitionEn: To have a certain record.

example.en: The team is going five in a row.
example.ja: チームは5組連続だ

definitions.definitionEn: To be authoritative, accepted, or valid:
To say (something), to make a sound:
To be expressed or composed (a certain way).

example.en: As the story goes, he got the idea for the song while sitting in traffic.
example.ja: 話が進むうちに、彼は往来で座っている間に、その曲のアイディアを得た。

definitions.definitionEn: To resort (to).

example.en: I'll go to court if I have to.
example.ja: 必要なら裁判所に行く

definitions.definitionEn: To apply or subject oneself to:
To fit (in a place, or together with something):
To date.

example.en: He's been going with her for two weeks.
example.ja: 彼は2週間彼女と一緒に出かけている。

definitions.definitionEn: To attack:
To be in general; to be usually.

example.en: As sentences go, this one is pretty boring.
example.ja: 文が続くとかなり退屈する

definitions.definitionEn: To take (a particular part or share); to participate in to the extent of.

example.en: Let's go halves on this.
example.ja: この上半身で行こう

definitions.definitionEn: To yield or weigh.

example.en: Those babies go five tons apiece.
example.ja: その赤ちゃんは 1着に5トン

definitions.definitionEn: To offer, bid or bet an amount; to pay.

example.en: I'll go a ten-spot.
example.ja: 10スポットだ

definitions.definitionEn: To enjoy. (Compare go for.)

example.en: I could go a beer right about now.
example.ja: ビール飲みに行くよ

definitions.definitionEn: To urinate or defecate.

example.en: Have you managed to go today, Mrs. Miggins?
example.ja: 今日はどうしました? ミギンスさん

definitions.definitionEn: Working correctly and ready to commence operation; approved and able to be put into action.
A strategic board game, originally from China, in which two players (black and white) attempt to control the largest area of the board with their counters.

meaning: だから／とても／そのように

definitions.definitionEn: True, accurate.

example.en: That is so.  You are responsible for this, is that not so?
example.ja: 確かにそう言えます。

definitions.definitionEn: In that state or manner; with that attribute. A proadjective that replaces the aforementioned adjective phrase.
Homosexual.

example.en: Is he so?
example.ja: そうなの?

definitions.definitionEn: To the (explicitly stated) extent that.

example.en: It was so hot outside that all the plants died.  He was so good, they hired him on the spot.
example.ja: 外は暑いので植物は死滅した。

definitions.definitionEn: To the (implied) extent.

example.en: I need a piece of cloth so long. [= this long]
example.ja: この長い布がほしい

definitions.definitionEn: In a particular manner.

example.en: Place the napkin on the table just so. If that's what you mean, then say so; (or do so).
example.ja: テーブルの上にブラシを置きます。その意味ならそう言ってください(またはそうしてください).

definitions.definitionEn: In the same manner or to the same extent as aforementioned; also.

example.en: Just as you have the right to your free speech, so I have the right to mine.  Many people say she's the world's greatest athlete, but I don't think so.  "I can count backwards from one hundred." "So can I."
example.ja: 多くの人は、彼女は世界一のアスリートだと言いますが、私はそうは思いません。「100から逆数で数えられる」と。

definitions.definitionEn: With as To such an extent or degree; as.

example.en: so far as;  so long as;  so much as
example.ja: しかし、私は、この時点では、私はそのように、私はちょうどこのように、この上なく長いです

definitions.definitionEn: In order that.

example.en: Eat your broccoli so you can have dessert.
example.ja: ブロッコリーを食べてデザートを食べる

definitions.definitionEn: With the result that; for that reason; therefore.

example.en: He ate too much cake, so he fell ill.
example.ja: 彼はケーキを食べすぎたので、病気になった。

definitions.definitionEn: Provided that; on condition that, as long as.
Used after a pause for thought to introduce a new topic, question or story.

example.en: So, let's go home.
example.ja: だから家に帰ろう

definitions.definitionEn: Short for so what.

example.en: "You park your car in front of my house every morning." — "So?"
example.ja: "毎朝、私の家の前に車を停めて" - "それで?"

definitions.definitionEn: Used to connect previous conversation or events to the following question.

example.en: So how does this story end?
example.ja: この物語はどうやって終わるの?

definitions.definitionEn: Used to introduce a rhetorical question.

example.en: We'd like to visit but I don't know if we can afford a hotel. —So who's staying in a hotel? Stay with us.
example.ja: 私たちも行きたいけど、ホテルに泊まる余裕はあるの?

definitions.definitionEn: Be as you are; stand still; used especially to cows; also used by sailors.
Some person.

example.en: Can someone help me, please?
example.ja: 誰か手伝ってくれる?

definitions.definitionEn: A syllable used in solfège to represent the fifth note of a major scale.
(foods) A type of dairy product, made especially in Japan between the seventh and 10th centuries, by reducing milk by boiling it.
(with a possessive pronoun) Everything that one is capable of.

example.en: She gave her all, and collapsed at the finish line.
example.ja: 彼女は全力を尽くし、フィニッシュラインで倒れた。

definitions.definitionEn: The totality of one's possessions.
All gone; dead.

example.en: The butter is all.
example.ja: バターだけ

definitions.definitionEn: (degree) Intensifier.

example.en: It suddenly went all quiet.
example.ja: 突然静まり返った。

definitions.definitionEn: Entirely; completely; totally.
Apiece; each.

example.en: The score was 30 all when the rain delay started.
example.ja: スコアは30で雨の遅延が始まり

definitions.definitionEn: (degree) so much.

example.en: Don't want to go? All the better since I lost the tickets.
example.ja: チケットを失くしてからずっとマシだった

definitions.definitionEn: Even; just.
Everything.

example.en: She knows all and sees all.
example.ja: 彼女はすべてを知っているそしてすべてを見ている

definitions.definitionEn: Everyone.

example.en: A good time was had by all.
example.ja: すべての人にとって楽しい時でした。

definitions.definitionEn: The only thing(s).

example.en: All that was left was a small pile of ash.
example.ja: 残っていたのは、灰の山だけでした。

definitions.definitionEn: Used after who, what, where, how and similar words, either without changing their meaning, or indicating that one expects that they cover more than one element, e.g. that "who all attended" is more than one person. (Some dialects only allow this to follow some words and not others.)
Clipping of y’all. Used only as a vocative.
Although.
An uncertainty, possibility, condition, doubt etc.
Supposing that, assuming that, in the circumstances that; used to introduce a condition or choice.

example.en: If it rains, I shall get wet.
example.ja: 雨が降れば濡れる

definitions.definitionEn: In the event that a statement is true (a programming statement that acts in a similar manner).

example.en: If A, then B, else C.
example.ja: A、B、その他のC。

definitions.definitionEn: Supposing that; used with past or past perfect subjunctive indicating that the condition is closed.

example.en: I would be unhappy if you had not talked with me yesterday.
example.ja: 昨日話してくれなかったら私は残念だった

definitions.definitionEn: Supposing that; given that; supposing it is the case that.

example.en: If that's true, we had better get moving!
example.ja: もしそれが本当なら移動しないと!

definitions.definitionEn: Although; used to introduce a concession.

example.en: He was a great friend, if a little stingy at the bar.
example.ja: 彼は偉大な友人だったバーで少し尖ったなら

definitions.definitionEn: (sometimes proscribed) Whether; used to introduce a noun clause, an indirect question, that functions as the direct object of certain verbs.

example.en: I don't know if I want to go or not.
example.ja: 行きたいかどうかは分かりません

definitions.definitionEn: (usually hyperbolic) Even if; even in the circumstances that.
Introducing a relevance conditional.

example.en: I have leftover cake if you want some.
example.ja: 食うか?

definitions.definitionEn: The digit or figure 1.
The neutral element with respect to multiplication in a ring.
A one-dollar bill.
One run scored by hitting the ball and running between the wickets; a single.
A joke or amusing anecdote.
A particularly special or compatible person or thing.

example.en: I knew as soon I met him that John was the one for me and we were married within a month.
example.ja: ジョンが私のためになり、私たちは 1 か月もたたないうちに結婚しました。

definitions.definitionEn: (leet) Used instead of ! to amplify an exclamation, parodying unskilled typists who forget to press the shift key while typing exclamation points, thus typing "1".

example.en: 2003 September 26, "DEAL WITH IT!!!!11one!!", in alt.games.video.nintendo.gamecube, Usenet
example.ja: 2003年9月26日閲覧. ^ a b c d e f games.mendo.gamecube, Usnet (2012年3月22日).

definitions.definitionEn: To cause to become one; to gather into a single whole; to unite.
Of a period of time, being particular.

example.en: One day the prince set forth to kill the dragon that had brought terror to his father’s kingdom for centuries.
example.ja: ある日のこと、その王子は、父の王国に何世紀もの間恐怖をもたらしていた龍を殺そうとしました。

definitions.definitionEn: Being a single, unspecified thing; a; any.

example.en: My aunt used to say, "One day is just like the other."
example.ja: 私の叔母さんはよく言った "いつかは他と同じだ"

definitions.definitionEn: Sole, only.

example.en: He is the one man who can help you.
example.ja: 彼は、あなたを助けることができる唯一の男だ。

definitions.definitionEn: Whole, entire.

example.en: Body and soul are not separate; they are one.
example.ja: 肉体と魂は分離しているのではありません。

definitions.definitionEn: In agreement.

example.en: We are one on the importance of learning.
example.ja: 私たちは、学ぶことの大切さを認識しています。

definitions.definitionEn: The same.

example.en: The two types look very different, but are one species.
example.ja: この 2 種類は非常に異なっていますが、一つの種です。

definitions.definitionEn: Being a preeminent example.

example.en: He is one hell of a guy.
example.ja: 彼はひどい男だ

definitions.definitionEn: Being an unknown person with the specified name; see also "a certain".

example.en: The town records from 1843 showed the overnight incarceration of one “A. Lincoln”.
example.ja: 1843年時点の市町村の記録では"A. L.

definitions.definitionEn: The number represented by the Arabic numeral 1; the numerical value equal to that cardinal number.

example.en: In many cultures, a baby turns one year old a year after its birth.
example.ja: 多くの文化圏で、赤ちゃんは生まれてから 1 年後に 1 歳になります。

definitions.definitionEn: The first positive number in the set of natural numbers.
The cardinality of the smallest nonempty set.
The ordinality of an element which has no predecessor, usually called first or number one.
(impersonal pronoun, indefinite) One thing (among a group of others); one member of a group.

example.en: Any one of the boys.  The big one looks good.  I want the green one.  A good driver is one who drives carefully.
example.ja: 大きいのはいいし緑の運転は慎重に運転する

definitions.definitionEn: (impersonal pronoun, sometimes with "the") The first mentioned of two things or people, as opposed to the other.

example.en: She offered him an apple and an orange; he took one and left the other.
example.ja: その人はリンゴとオレンジを勧めましたが、一方を取って他方を残しました。

definitions.definitionEn: (indefinite personal pronoun) Any person (applying to people in general).

example.en: One’s guilt may trouble one, but it is best not to let oneself be troubled by things which cannot be changed.  One shouldn’t be too quick to judge.
example.ja: 人は罪悪感に悩まされるかもしれませんが、変化することのできない事柄に悩まされないようにするのが最善です。

definitions.definitionEn: (pronoun) Any person, entity or thing.

example.en: "driver", noun: one who drives.
example.ja: 名詞:運転する人。

definitions.definitionEn: Something that would happen, or would be the case, under different circumstances; a potentiality.
Moving around; astir.

example.en: After my bout with Guillan-Barre Syndrome, it took me 6 months to be up and about again.
example.ja: ギリャン・バーレ症候群にぶつかってから、再び起き上がりながら半年かかった。

definitions.definitionEn: In existence; being in evidence; apparent.

example.en: This idea has been about for a while but has only recently become fashionable.
example.ja: こうした考えはしばらく前から存在していましたが、最近流行したばかりです。

definitions.definitionEn: Near; in the vicinity or neighbourhood.

example.en: I had my keys just a minute ago, so they must be about somewhere.
example.ja: ちょっと前に鍵があったからどこかにいるはずだ

definitions.definitionEn: On all sides; around.

example.en: I looked about at the scenery that surrounded me.
example.ja: 私は周囲の景色を見ました。

definitions.definitionEn: Here and there; around; in one place and another; up and down.

example.en: Bits of old machinery were lying about.
example.ja: 昔の機械の中にはうそをつくものもありました。

definitions.definitionEn: From one place or position to another in succession; indicating repeated movement or activity.

example.en: walking about;  rushing about;  jumping about;  thrashing about
example.ja: 歩き回る; 飛び回る; 跳ね回る

definitions.definitionEn: Indicating unproductive or unstructured activity.

example.en: messing about;   fooling about;  loafing about
example.ja: いたずら; ごまかし; ぶらぶらする

definitions.definitionEn: Nearly; approximately; with close correspondence in quality, manner, degree, quantity, or time; almost.

example.en: Dinner's about ready.
example.ja: 夕食の準備はできてる

definitions.definitionEn: Near; in the vicinity.
To a reversed order; half round; facing in the opposite direction; from a contrary point of view.

example.en: to face about;  to turn oneself about
example.ja: 身を転じる

definitions.definitionEn: In succession; one after another; in the course of events.
In circuit; circularly; by a circuitous way; around the outside; in circumference.

example.en: a mile about, and a third of a mile across
example.ja: 約1. 5キロ、横の3分の1

definitions.definitionEn: In a circle around; all round; on every side of; on the outside of.

example.en: The snake was coiled about his ankle.
example.ja: 蛇は足首のまわりに巻きついていた。

definitions.definitionEn: Over or upon different parts of; through or over in various directions; here and there in; to and fro in; throughout.

example.en: He was well known about town.
example.ja: 彼は町のことでよく知られていました。

definitions.definitionEn: Indicates that something will happen very soon; indicates a plan or intention to do something.
Concerning; with regard to; on account of; on the subject of; to affect.

example.en: He talked a lot about his childhood.
example.ja: 彼は子供時代の話をよくした。

definitions.definitionEn: Concerned with; engaged in; intent on.

example.en: to be about one's business
example.ja: 人のビジネスになるために

definitions.definitionEn: Within or in the immediate neighborhood of; in contiguity or proximity to; near, as to place.

example.en: I can't find my reading glasses, but they must be somewhere about the house.
example.ja: 眼鏡は見つからないが家のどこかにあるはずだ

definitions.definitionEn: On one's person; nearby the person.

example.en: I had no weapon about me but a stick.
example.ja: 私には棒だけの武器はありませんでした。

definitions.definitionEn: In or near, as in mental faculties or in the possession of; under the control of; at one's command; in one's makeup.

example.en: He has his wits about him.
example.ja: 彼は自分の知力を持っている。

definitions.definitionEn: (auxiliary verb, defective) To know how to; to be able to.

example.en: She can speak English, French, and German.   I can play football.   Can you remember your fifth birthday?
example.ja: 彼女は英語もフランス語もドイツ語も話せるしフットボールもできるわ

definitions.definitionEn: (modal auxiliary verb, defective) May; to be permitted or enabled to.

example.en: You can go outside and play when you're finished with your homework.   Can I use your pen?
example.ja: 宿題が済んだら外で遊ぼうよ

definitions.definitionEn: (modal auxiliary verb, defective) To have the potential to; be possible.

example.en: Animals can experience emotions.
example.ja: 動物は感情を経験します。

definitions.definitionEn: (auxiliary verb, defective) Used with verbs of perception.

example.en: Can you hear that?.
example.ja: 聞こえたか?

definitions.definitionEn: To know.
A more or less cylindrical vessel for liquids, usually of steel or aluminium, but sometimes of plastic, and with a carrying handle over the top.
A container used to carry and dispense water for plants (a watering can).
A tin-plate canister, often cylindrical, for preserved foods such as fruit, meat, or fish.
A chamber pot, now a toilet or lavatory.

example.en: Bob's in the can. You can wait a few minutes or just leave it with me.
example.ja: ボブは缶に入ってる数分待っててくれ

definitions.definitionEn: Buttocks.
Jail or prison.

example.en: Bob's in the can. He won't be back for a few years.
example.ja: ボブは数年も戻ってこない

definitions.definitionEn: (in the plural) Headphones.
A drinking cup.
A cube-shaped buoy or marker used to denote a port-side lateral mark
A chimney pot.
(in the plural) an E-meter used in Scientology auditing.
To seal in a can.

example.en: They canned air to sell as a novelty to tourists.
example.ja: 観光客の目を引くように、空気をかんで売るのです。

definitions.definitionEn: To preserve by heating and sealing in a jar or can.

example.en: They spent August canning fruit and vegetables.
example.ja: そして、 8 月には、かん詰めの果物や野菜を使っていました。

definitions.definitionEn: To discard, scrap or terminate (an idea, project, etc.).

example.en: He canned the whole project because he thought it would fail.
example.ja: 彼は失敗すると考えていたので、全プロジェクトを缶にしました。

definitions.definitionEn: To shut up.

example.en: Can your gob.
example.ja: あなたのゴッバ。

definitions.definitionEn: To fire or dismiss an employee.

example.en: The boss canned him for speaking out.
example.ja: ボスは口を利いて彼を逮捕した。

definitions.definitionEn: To hole the ball.

meaning: どちら／ものを説明する文をつなぐ

definitions.definitionEn: (interrogative) What one or ones (of those mentioned or implied).

example.en: By now, you must surely know which is which.
example.ja: 今頃は、いずれかを知るべきだ。

definitions.definitionEn: The/Any ones that; whichever.

example.en: Please take which you please.
example.ja: お好きにどうぞ

definitions.definitionEn: (relative) Introduces a relative clause giving further information about something previously mentioned.

example.en: He had to leave, which was very difficult.
example.ja: それは非常に難しいことでした。

definitions.definitionEn: (relative) Used of people (now generally who, whom or that).

meaning: そこに。there is / are では存在を表す

definitions.definitionEn: That place.
That status; that position.

example.en: You rinse and de-string the green beans; I'll take it from there.
example.ja: あなたは水洗いして、緑豆を流して、私はそこからそれを取る。

definitions.definitionEn: (location) In a place or location (stated, implied or otherwise indicated) at some distance from the speaker (compare here).
In that matter, relation, etc.; at that point, stage, etc., regarded as a distinct place.

example.en: He did not stop there, but continued his speech.
example.ja: 彼はそこで立ち止まりませんでしたが、話を続けました。

definitions.definitionEn: (location) To or into that place; thither.
Where, there where, in which place.
In existence or in this world; see pronoun section below.
Used as an expletive subject of be in its sense of “exist”, with the semantic, usually indefinite subject being postponed or (occasionally) implied.

example.en: Is there an answer? [=Does an answer exist?]
example.ja: 答は存在するのか?

definitions.definitionEn: Used with other intransitive verbs of existence, in the same sense, or with other intransitive verbs, adding a sense of existence.

example.en: If x is a positive number, then there exists [=there is] a positive number y less than x.
example.ja: x が正の数の場合, [=]は正の数 y が x 未満です。

definitions.definitionEn: Used with other verbs, when raised.

example.en: I expected there to be a simpler solution. [=I expected that there would be a simpler solution.]
example.ja: [=]より簡単な解があると予想しました。

definitions.definitionEn: (in combination with certain prepositions, no longer productive) That.

example.en: therefor, thereat, thereunder
example.ja: その中にも、それに登るに足る。

definitions.definitionEn: Used to replace an unknown name, principally in greetings and farewells

example.en: Hi there, young fellow.
example.ja: やあ若造

definitions.definitionEn: Used to offer encouragement or sympathy.

example.en: There, there. Everything is going to turn out all right.
example.ja: そこだすべてうまくいくだろう

definitions.definitionEn: Used to express victory or completion.

example.en: There! That knot should hold.
example.ja: そこだその結びは保たないと

definitions.definitionEn: Knowledge; the state of knowing.
To perceive the truth or factuality of; to be certain of or that.

example.en: He knew something terrible was going to happen.
example.ja: 恐ろしい事が起こると知ってた

definitions.definitionEn: To be aware of; to be cognizant of.

example.en: Did you know Michelle and Jack were getting divorced? ― Yes, I knew.
example.ja: ミシェルとジャックが離婚するって知ってた?

definitions.definitionEn: To be acquainted or familiar with; to have encountered.

example.en: I know your mother, but I’ve never met your father.
example.ja: あなたのお母さんは知っていますが、お父さんに会ったことは一度もありません。

definitions.definitionEn: To experience.

example.en: Their relationship knew ups and downs.
example.ja: 二人の関係は浮き沈みを知っていました。

definitions.definitionEn: To be able to distinguish, to discern, particularly by contrast or comparison; to recognize the nature of.

example.en: I wouldn't know one from the other.
example.ja: もう片方から知ることはない。

definitions.definitionEn: To recognize as the same (as someone or something previously encountered) after an absence or change.
To understand or have a grasp of through experience or study.

example.en: His mother tongue is Italian, but he also knows French and English.
example.ja: 母語はイタリア語ですが、フランス語と英語も知っています。

definitions.definitionEn: To have sexual relations with. This meaning normally specified in modern English as e.g. to ’know someone in the biblical sense’ or to ‘know Biblically.’
To have knowledge; to have information, be informed.

example.en: He knows about 19th century politics.
example.ja: 19 世紀の政治について知っておられます。

definitions.definitionEn: To be or become aware or cognizant.

example.en: Did you know Michelle and Jack were getting divorced? ― Yes, I knew.
example.ja: ミシェルとジャックが離婚するって知ってた?

definitions.definitionEn: To be acquainted (with another person).
To be able to play or perform (a song or other piece of music).

example.en: Do you know "Blueberry Hill"?
example.ja: "ブルーベリーヒル" 知ってる?

definitions.definitionEn: To a greater degree or extent.

example.en: I could no more climb that than fly!
example.ja: 空を飛ぶこと以上に登ることはできませんでした。

definitions.definitionEn: Used to form the comparative form of adjectives and adverbs.

example.en: You're more beautiful than I ever imagined.
example.ja: 想像以上に美しい

definitions.definitionEn: In negative constructions: any further, any longer; any more.
Used in addition to an inflected comparative form.

example.en: I was more better at English than you.
example.ja: お前より英語が上手だった

definitions.definitionEn: A greater number or quantity (of something).

example.en: There isn't enough salt in this. You need to add more.
example.ja: 塩が足りませんさらに追加する必要があります

definitions.definitionEn: An extra or additional quantity (of something).

example.en: There aren't many people here yet, but more should be arriving soon.
example.ja: まだ大勢いないがまもなく到着するはずだ

definitions.definitionEn: A carrot; a parsnip.
A root; stock.
A plant.
To root up.
Offspring.
Lineage.
A difficult return or block of a shot.
Something gained; an acquisition.
(ditransitive) To obtain; to acquire.

example.en: I'm going to get a computer tomorrow from the discount store.
example.ja: 明日ディスカウントストアからコンピューターを調達する

definitions.definitionEn: To receive.

example.en: He got a severe reprimand for that.
example.ja: そのことでひどく叱責されたのです。

definitions.definitionEn: (in a perfect construction, with present-tense meaning) To have. See usage notes.

example.en: I've got a concert ticket for you.
example.ja: コンサートのチケットがある

definitions.definitionEn: To fetch, bring, take.

example.en: Can you get my bag from the living-room, please?
example.ja: リビングからバッグを取ってくれ

definitions.definitionEn: To become, or cause oneself to become.

example.en: I'm getting hungry; how about you?
example.ja: お腹が空いた。

definitions.definitionEn: To cause to become; to bring about.

example.en: I can't get these boots off (or on).
example.ja: (又は上)このブーツを脱ぐことができない。

definitions.definitionEn: To cause to do.

example.en: I can't get it to work.
example.ja: 治せません

definitions.definitionEn: To cause to come or go or move.

example.en: I got him to his room.
example.ja: 彼の部屋へ

definitions.definitionEn: To cause to be in a certain status or position.

example.en: Get him here at once.
example.ja: すぐに彼をここに呼んで

definitions.definitionEn: (with various prepositions, such as into, over, or behind; for specific idiomatic senses see individual entries get into, get over, etc.) To adopt, assume, arrive at, or progress towards (a certain position, location, state).

example.en: I'm getting into a muddle.
example.ja: 私は泥沼に入る。

definitions.definitionEn: To cover (a certain distance) while travelling.

example.en: to get a mile

definitions.definitionEn: To begin (doing something or to do something).

example.en: After lunch we got chatting.
example.ja: 昼食の後チャットした

definitions.definitionEn: To take or catch (a scheduled transportation service).

example.en: I normally get the 7:45 train.
example.ja: 通常は7時45分に列車に乗る。

definitions.definitionEn: To respond to (a telephone call, a doorbell, etc).

example.en: Can you get that call, please? I'm busy.
example.ja: 電話をお願い忙しいの

definitions.definitionEn: (followed by infinitive) To be able, be permitted, or have the opportunity (to do something desirable or ironically implied to be desirable).

example.en: Great. I get to clean the toilets today.
example.ja: 今日はトイレを掃除する

definitions.definitionEn: To understand. (compare get it)

example.en: I don't get what you mean by "fun". This place sucks!
example.ja: "金"って意味が解らないここは最低だ

definitions.definitionEn: To be told; be the recipient of (a question, comparison, opinion, etc.).

example.en: "You look just like Helen Mirren." / "I get that a lot."
example.ja: "ヘレン・ミュレンに似ている" / "よくわかる".

definitions.definitionEn: To be. Used to form the passive of verbs.

example.en: He got bitten by a dog.
example.ja: 犬に噛まれて

definitions.definitionEn: To become ill with or catch (a disease).

example.en: I went on holiday and got malaria.
example.ja: 休日に行ってマラリアになった

definitions.definitionEn: To catch out, trick successfully.

example.en: He keeps calling pretending to be my boss—it gets me every time.
example.ja: 上司のふりをしながら、ずっと電話してきた。

definitions.definitionEn: To perplex, stump.

example.en: That question's really got me.
example.ja: その質問には本当に納得した

definitions.definitionEn: To find as an answer.

example.en: What did you get for question four?
example.ja: 質問4は?

definitions.definitionEn: To bring to reckoning; to catch (as a criminal); to effect retribution.

example.en: I'm gonna get him for that.
example.ja: その為に彼を捕まえる

definitions.definitionEn: To hear completely; catch.

example.en: Sorry, I didn't get that. Could you repeat it?
example.ja: すまないがわからなかった

definitions.definitionEn: To getter.

example.en: I put the getter into the container to get the gases.
example.ja: ガスを取りに容器に入れておいた

definitions.definitionEn: To beget (of a father).
To learn; to commit to memory; to memorize; sometimes with out.

example.en: to get a lesson;  to get out one's Greek lesson
example.ja: ギリシャ語の教科から抜け出すこと

definitions.definitionEn: Used with a personal pronoun to indicate that someone is being pretentious or grandiose.

example.en: Get her with her new hairdo.
example.ja: 新しいヘアードを

definitions.definitionEn: To go, to leave; to scram.
To kill.

example.en: They’re coming to get you, Barbara.
example.ja: あなたを捕まえに来ているのです。

definitions.definitionEn: To make acquisitions; to gain; to profit.
To measure.

example.en: Did you get her temperature?
example.ja: 彼女の温度は?

definitions.definitionEn: A git.
A Jewish writ of divorce.

meaning: 誰／人を説明する文をつなぐ

definitions.definitionEn: A person under discussion; a question of which person.
(interrogative) What person or people; which person or people; asks for the identity of someone. (used in a direct or indirect question)

example.en: I don't know who it is. (indirect question)
example.ja: (直接質問)

definitions.definitionEn: (interrogative) What is one's position; asks whether someone deserves to say or do something.

example.en: I don't like what you did, but who am I to criticize you? I've done worse.
example.ja: あなたがしたことが気に入らなかったでもあなたを批判するのは誰?

definitions.definitionEn: (relative) The person or people that.
(relative) Whoever, he who, they who.

example.en: It was a nice man who helped us.
example.ja: 私たちを助けてくれたのがいい男でした

definitions.definitionEn: (usually in the plural) Something that a person likes (prefers).

example.en: Tell me your likes and dislikes.
example.ja: 好きか嫌いか教えて

definitions.definitionEn: An individual vote showing support for, or approval of, something posted on the Internet.
To enjoy, be pleased by; favor; be in favor of.

example.en: I like hamburgers.
example.ja: ハンバーガー好き

definitions.definitionEn: To please.
To derive pleasure of, by or with someone or something.
To prefer and maintain (an action) as a regular habit or activity.

example.en: I like to go to the dentist every six months.
example.ja: 6ヶ月ごとに歯医者に行くのが好き

definitions.definitionEn: To have an appearance or expression; to look; to seem to be (in a specified condition).
To come near; to avoid with difficulty; to escape narrowly.

example.en: He liked to have been too late.
example.ja: 彼は遅すぎたのが好きだった

definitions.definitionEn: To find attractive; to prefer the company of; to have mild romantic feelings for.

example.en: I really like Sandra but don't know how to tell her.
example.ja: サンドラが本当に好きなのでもどうやって話すか知らないの

definitions.definitionEn: To liken; to compare.
To show support for, or approval of, something posted on the Internet by marking it with a vote.

example.en: I can't stand Bloggs' tomato ketchup, but I liked it on Facebook so I could enter a competition.
example.ja: Bloggs's Tam Ketchupには耐えられないが,Facebookに載せて競走に参加した。

definitions.definitionEn: (with 'would' and in certain other phrases) To want, desire. See also would like.

example.en: We could go to the museum if you like.
example.ja: 博物館に行こうか?

definitions.definitionEn: (sometimes as the likes of') Someone similar to a given person, or something similar to a given object; a comparative; a type; a sort.

example.en: It was something the likes of which I had never seen before.
example.ja: それは私がこれまでに一度も見たことのないようなものでした。

definitions.definitionEn: The stroke that equalizes the number of strokes played by the opposing player or side.

example.en: to play the like
example.ja: を再生します。

definitions.definitionEn: Similar.

example.en: My partner and I have like minds.
example.ja: 相棒と僕は同じ気持ちだ

definitions.definitionEn: Likely; probable.
Likely.
In a like or similar manner.
Similar to, reminiscent of.
Typical of

example.en: It would be just like Achilles to be sulking in his tent.
example.ja: アキレスがテントですねているようなもんだ

definitions.definitionEn: Approximating

example.en: Popcorn costs something like $10 dollars at the movies.
example.ja: ポップコーンは映画で$10ドル

definitions.definitionEn: In the manner of, similarly to.

example.en: He doesn't act like a president.
example.ja: 彼は大統領のふりをしない

definitions.definitionEn: Such as

example.en: It's for websites like Wikipedia.
example.ja: ウィキペディアのようなウェブサイト向け。

definitions.definitionEn: As if there would be.

example.en: It looks like a hot summer in Europe.
example.ja: ヨーロッパの暑い夏のようだ

definitions.definitionEn: As, the way.
As if; as though.

example.en: It looks like you've finished the project.
example.ja: 計画は完了したようだ

definitions.definitionEn: Used to place emphasis upon a statement.

example.en: Divint ye knaa, like?
example.ja: ディヴィントとか?

definitions.definitionEn: To be likely.
The time at which something happens.

example.en: A good article will cover the who, the what, the when, the where, the why and the how.
example.ja: 良い記事は、誰、何、いつ、どこに、なぜ、そして、なぜかをカバーする。

definitions.definitionEn: (interrogative) At what time? At which time? Upon which occasion or circumstance? Used to introduce direct or indirect questions about time.

example.en: Do you know when they arrived?
example.ja: 彼らがいつ着いたか知ってるか?

definitions.definitionEn: At an earlier time and under different, usually less favorable, circumstances.

example.en: He's mister high and mighty now, but I remember him when.
example.ja: 彼は今、高貴で強大です、しかし、私は彼を覚えています。

definitions.definitionEn: (relative) At which, on which, during which: often omitted or replaced with that.

example.en: That was the day when the Twin Towers fell.
example.ja: それはツインタワーが陥落した日だった。

definitions.definitionEn: (interrogative) What time; which time.

example.en: Since when do I need your permission?
example.ja: いつから君の許可が必要なんだ?

definitions.definitionEn: The time that.

example.en: I recall when they were called the Greys.
example.ja: "グレイ"と呼ばれた時を思い出します

definitions.definitionEn: At (or as soon as) that time that; at the (or any and every) time that; if.

example.en: A player wins when [as soon as, or at any time that, if] she has four cards of the same suit.
example.ja: プレーヤーが勝つのは, [すぐに、あるいはいつでも、もし同じスーツを四枚持っているときは、必ず勝利する。

definitions.definitionEn: During the time that; at the time of the action of the following clause or participle phrase.

example.en: Be careful when crossing the street.
example.ja: 道路を渡る時には気をつけてください。

definitions.definitionEn: At what time; at which time.

example.en: I am here till Friday, when [i.e. at which time] I leave for Senegal.
example.ja: 私は金曜までここにいる。 [そのとき] セネガルに発つ。

definitions.definitionEn: Since; given the fact that; considering that.

example.en: I don't see the point of putting up Christmas decorations when I am the only person who is going to see them.
example.ja: クリスマスの飾りを飾る意味が解らない。

definitions.definitionEn: Whereas; although; at the same time as; in spite of the fact that.

example.en: He keeps changing things when the existing system works perfectly well.
example.ja: 神は、現存する体制が完全に機能するとき、物事を変化させてゆかれます。

definitions.definitionEn: That's enough, a command to stop adding something, especially an ingredient of food or drink.
Expressing impatience. (Compare what.)
An act of thinking; consideration (of something).

example.en: I'll have a think about that and let you know.
example.ja: それを考えさせてやろう

definitions.definitionEn: To ponder, to go over in one's head.

example.en: Idly, the detective thought what his next move should be.
example.ja: イドリー刑事は次の行動は?

definitions.definitionEn: To communicate to oneself in one's mind, to try to find a solution to a problem.

example.en: I thought for three hours about the problem and still couldn’t find the solution.
example.ja: 私はこの問題について三時間考えましたが、それでも解決策は見いだせませんでした。

definitions.definitionEn: To conceive of something or someone (usually followed by of; infrequently, by on).

example.en: I tend to think of her as rather ugly.
example.ja: 私はむしろ醜く思う傾向があります。

definitions.definitionEn: To be of opinion (that); to consider, judge, regard, or look upon (something) as.

example.en: At the time I thought his adamant refusal to give in right.
example.ja: その時私は、彼が正しいことをしようとしないのではないかと思いました。

definitions.definitionEn: To guess; to reckon.

example.en: I think she’ll pass the examination.
example.ja: 検査を受けることになると思います。

definitions.definitionEn: To plan; to be considering; to be of a mind (to do something).
To presume; to venture.
To seem, to appear.
Brand or kind; model.

example.en: What make of car do you drive?
example.ja: 車の製造は?

definitions.definitionEn: Manner or style of construction (style of how a thing is made); form.
Origin (of a manufactured article); manufacture; production.

example.en: The camera was of German make.
example.ja: カメラはドイツ製だった。

definitions.definitionEn: A person's character or disposition.
The act or process of making something, especially in industrial manufacturing.
Quantity produced, especially of materials.
A software utility for automatically building large applications, or an implementation of this utility.
Identification or recognition (of identity), especially from police records or evidence.
(usually in phrase "easy make") Past, present or future target of seduction (usually female).
A promotion.
A home-made project
Turn to declare the trump for a hand (in bridge), or to shuffle the cards.
A made basket.
The closing of an electrical circuit.
To create.
To behave, to act.

example.en: He made as if to punch him, but they both laughed and shook hands.
example.ja: パンチのようなものを作りましたが、二人とも笑いながら手を握らせました。

definitions.definitionEn: To tend; to contribute; to have effect; with for or against.
To constitute.

example.en: One swallow does not a summer make.
example.ja: 1 ツバメは夏になるとできません。

definitions.definitionEn: To add up to, have a sum of.

example.en: Two and four make six.
example.ja: 2と4は6になる。

definitions.definitionEn: (construed with of, typically interrogative) To interpret.

example.en: I don’t know what to make of it.
example.ja: どうしたらいいのか分かりません。

definitions.definitionEn: (usually stressed) To bring into success.

example.en: She married into wealth and so has it made.
example.ja: 彼女は富の中に結婚したので、それができたのです。

definitions.definitionEn: (ditransitive, second object is an adjective or participle) To cause to be.

example.en: Did I make myself heard?
example.ja: 自分の声を聞かせた?

definitions.definitionEn: To cause to appear to be; to represent as.
(ditransitive, second object is a verb) To cause (to do something); to compel (to do something).

example.en: I was made to feel like a criminal.
example.ja: 私は犯罪者のように感じさせられました。

definitions.definitionEn: (ditransitive, second object is a verb, can be stressed for emphasis or clarity) To force to do.

example.en: Don’t let them make you suffer.
example.ja: そうしたものに苦しめられてはなりません。

definitions.definitionEn: (ditransitive, of a fact) To indicate or suggest to be.

example.en: His past mistakes don’t make him a bad person.
example.ja: 過去の間違いが悪い人になるわけではありません。

definitions.definitionEn: (of a bed) To cover neatly with bedclothes.
(law enforcement) To recognise, identify, spot.
To arrive at a destination, usually at or by a certain time.

example.en: We should make Cincinnati by 7 tonight.
example.ja: 今夜7時までにシンシナティを作るべきだ

definitions.definitionEn: To proceed (in a direction).

example.en: Make for the hills! It's a wildfire!
example.ja: 山を造れ野火だ

definitions.definitionEn: To cover (a given distance) by travelling.
To move at (a speed).

example.en: The ship could make 20 knots an hour in calm seas.
example.ja: 船は 1 時間に 20 ノットのブレーキをかけることができました。

definitions.definitionEn: To appoint; to name.
To induct into the Mafia or a similar organization (as a made man).
To defecate or urinate.
To earn, to gain (money, points, membership or status).

example.en: He didn't make the choir after his voice changed.
example.ja: 声が変った後は聖歌隊を作らなかった。

definitions.definitionEn: To pay, to cover (an expense); chiefly used after expressions of inability.
To compose verses; to write poetry; to versify.
To enact; to establish.
To develop into; to prove to be.

example.en: She'll make a fine president.
example.ja: 彼女は立派な大統領になる

definitions.definitionEn: To form or formulate in the mind.

example.en: made a questionable decision
example.ja: 不審な判断をした

definitions.definitionEn: To perform a feat.

example.en: make a leap
example.ja: ジャンプして

definitions.definitionEn: To gain sufficient audience to warrant its existence.

example.en: In the end, my class didn't make, which left me with a bit of free time.
example.ja: 結局私のクラスは出来なくなったので、少し自由な時間を残しました。

definitions.definitionEn: To act in a certain manner; to have to do; to manage; to interfere; to be active; often in the phrase to meddle or make.
To increase; to augment; to accrue.
To be engaged or concerned in.
To cause to be (in a specified place), used after a subjective what.
To take the virginity of.
To have sexual intercourse with.
Mate; a spouse or companion; a match.
A halfpenny.
An agricultural tool resembling a scythe, used to cut (harvest) certain plants such as peas, reeds, or tares.
The inevitable progression into the future with the passing of present and past events.

example.en: Time stops for nobody.   the ebb and flow of time
example.ja: だれにとっても時間は停止し、時の流れは衰える

definitions.definitionEn: A duration of time.
An instant of time.
The measurement under some system of region of day or moment.

example.en: Let's synchronize our watches so we're not on different time.
example.ja: 時計を同期させて時間を変えないようにしよう

definitions.definitionEn: Ratio of comparison.

example.en: your car runs three times faster than mine;  that is four times as heavy as this
example.ja: これは4倍の重さです。

definitions.definitionEn: (grammar) Tense.

example.en: the time of a verb
example.ja: 動詞の時刻

definitions.definitionEn: The measured duration of sounds; measure; tempo; rate of movement; rhythmical division.

example.en: common or triple time;   the musician keeps good time.
example.ja: 音楽家は楽しい時を過ごします。

definitions.definitionEn: To measure or record the time, duration, or rate of.

example.en: I used a stopwatch to time myself running around the block.
example.ja: 私自身、ブロックの周りを走り回るのにストップウォッチングを用いました。

definitions.definitionEn: To choose when something begins or how long it lasts.

example.en: The President timed his speech badly, coinciding with the Super Bowl.
example.ja: 大統領は演説のタイミングを悪くしてスーパーボウルと仲裁した

definitions.definitionEn: To keep or beat time; to proceed or move in time.
To pass time; to delay.
To regulate as to time; to accompany, or agree with, in time of movement.
To measure, as in music or harmony.
Reminder by the umpire for the players to continue playing after their pause.
The umpire's call in prizefights, etc.
A call by a bartender to warn patrons that the establishment is closing and no more drinks will be served.
(stative) To perceive or detect with the eyes, or as if by sight.
To form a mental picture of.
(social) To meet, to visit.
To be the setting or time of.

example.en: 1999 saw the release of many great films.
example.ja: 1999年、多くの偉大な映画が発売された。

definitions.definitionEn: (by extension) To ensure that something happens, especially while witnessing it.

example.en: I'll see you hang for this!  I saw that they didn't make any more trouble.
example.ja: これ以上のトラブルは起きなかった

definitions.definitionEn: To wait upon; attend, escort.

example.en: I saw the old lady safely across the road.
example.ja: 婆は無事に道路を渡った

definitions.definitionEn: To respond to another player's bet with a bet of equal value.

example.en: I'll see your twenty dollars and raise you ten.
example.ja: 20ドルを拝見して 10ドル上げる

definitions.definitionEn: To determine by trial or experiment; to find out (if or whether).

example.en: I'll come over later and see if I can fix your computer.
example.ja: 後で来てパソコンを直すわ

definitions.definitionEn: (used in the imperative) To reference or to study for further details.

example.en: For a complete proof of the Poincaré conjecture, see Appendix C.
example.ja: ポインカレ説の完全な証拠については、付録 C をご覧ください。

definitions.definitionEn: To examine something closely, or to utilize something, often as a temporary alternative.

example.en: Can I see that lighter for a second? Mine just quit working.
example.ja: 少しライターを見せてくれ

definitions.definitionEn: To include as one of something's experiences.

example.en: The equipment has not seen usage outside of our projects.
example.ja: この設備は、当該プロジェクトのほか、使用を行っていない。

definitions.definitionEn: Directing the audience to pay attention to the following

example.en: See here, fellas, there's no need for all this rucus!
example.ja: 見てよ、みんな、このルカスは必要ない!

definitions.definitionEn: Introducing an explanation

example.en: See, in order to win the full prize we would have to come up with a scheme to land a rover on the Moon.
example.ja: 満賞を獲得するには月にローバーを着陸させる計画を練らねばならない

definitions.definitionEn: A diocese, archdiocese; a region of a church, generally headed by a bishop, especially an archbishop.
The office of a bishop or archbishop; bishopric or archbishopric
A seat; a site; a place where sovereign power is exercised.
(Singlish) Used to contradict an underlying assumption held by the interlocutor.
Something; thing; stuff.
The identity of a thing, as an answer to a question of what.
Something that is addressed by what, as opposed to a person, addressed by who.
(usually followed by "with," but also sometimes "would" or "might," especially in finance) In some manner or degree; in part; partly. See also what with

example.en: The market will calculate these higher risks in their funding costs what might result in higher lending rates.
example.ja: これらの高いリスクを、計算します。そして、これらのリスクは、

definitions.definitionEn: Such.

example.en: What a beautiful day!
example.ja: なんて素晴らしい天気でしょう！

definitions.definitionEn: Why.
Used to introduce each of two coordinate phrases or concepts; both…and.
(interrogative) Which thing, event, circumstance, etc.: used interrogatively in asking for the specification of an identity, quantity, quality, etc.
That which; those that; the thing that.

example.en: He knows what he wants.
example.ja: 彼は自分が何を望むかを知っている。

definitions.definitionEn: (relative) That; which; who.
Whatever.

example.en: I will do what I can to help you.
example.ja: 力を尽くします

definitions.definitionEn: An expression of surprise or disbelief.
What do you want? An abrupt, usually unfriendly enquiry as to what a person desires.

example.en: What? I'm busy.
example.ja: 忙しいんだ

definitions.definitionEn: Clipping of what do you say?
What did you say? I beg your pardon?
(typically with a) An intensifier to an adjective phrase; used to begin a sentence.

example.en: What a nice car.
example.ja: いい車ね

definitions.definitionEn: The direction opposed to the pull of gravity.

example.en: Up is a good way to go.
example.ja: アップは良い方法だ

definitions.definitionEn: A positive thing.

example.en: I hate almost everything about my job. The only up is that it's so close to home.
example.ja: 仕事のほとんどが嫌いだ家に近いだけだ

definitions.definitionEn: An upstairs room of a two story house.

example.en: She lives in a two-up two-down.
example.ja: 2階の2階に住んでる

definitions.definitionEn: To increase or raise.

example.en: If we up the volume, we may be able to hear what he says.
example.ja: 音量を上げれば彼の言うことを聞くことができるかもしれない

definitions.definitionEn: To promote.

example.en: It wasn’t long before they upped him to Vice President.
example.ja: それから間もなく、副大統領に昇格しました。

definitions.definitionEn: (usually in combination with another verb) To act suddenly.

example.en: He just upped and quit.
example.ja: 彼はちょうど立ち上がり、辞職した。

definitions.definitionEn: To ascend; to climb up.
To upload.

example.en: 100 new apps and games have just been upped.
example.ja: 新しいアプリやゲームが100個アップされました。

definitions.definitionEn: Facing upwards.

example.en: Put the notebook face up on the table.
example.ja: ノートをテーブルの上に

definitions.definitionEn: On or at a physically higher level.

example.en: The flood waters are up again across large areas of the country.
example.ja: 洪水の水は再び国内の広大な地域を横切っています。

definitions.definitionEn: Headed, or designated to go, upward, as an escalator, stairway, elevator etc.

example.en: Where is the up escalator?
example.ja: エスカレーターはどこだ?

definitions.definitionEn: Fitted or fixed at a high or relatively high position, especially on a wall or ceiling.

example.en: The Christmas decorations are up.
example.ja: クリスマスの飾りだ

definitions.definitionEn: Aloft.

example.en: The kite is up!
example.ja: たこが上がった!

definitions.definitionEn: Raised; lifted.

example.en: Don't go into the living room just now – I've got the carpet up.
example.ja: リビングに入るな! カーペットを敷くぞ!

definitions.definitionEn: Built, constructed.

example.en: Are the new buildings up yet?
example.ja: 新しい建物はまだ?

definitions.definitionEn: Standing.

example.en: The audience were up and on their feet.
example.ja: 聴衆は立ち上がり、立ち上がりました。

definitions.definitionEn: Awake and out of bed.

example.en: I can’t believe it’s 3 a.m. and you’re still up.
example.ja: 午前 3 時になるとは信じられないことですが、あなたはまだ起きています。

definitions.definitionEn: Riding the horse; mounted.
(of the sun or moon) Above the horizon, in the sky.

example.en: It'll get warmer once the sun's up.
example.ja: 日が昇れば暖まる

definitions.definitionEn: Larger; greater in quantity, volume, value etc.

example.en: My temperature is up this morning.
example.ja: 今朝は体温が上がってる

definitions.definitionEn: Indicating a larger or higher quantity.

example.en: The barometer is up, so fine weather should be on the way.
example.ja: バロメーターは上空なので天気は良好です

definitions.definitionEn: Ahead; leading; winning.

example.en: The home team were up by two goals at half-time.
example.ja: ホームチームは半時間ごとに2つの目標を達成した。

definitions.definitionEn: Available; made public; posted.

example.en: Is your new video up yet? I looked on the website, but I couldn't find it.
example.ja: 新しいビデオは?

definitions.definitionEn: Finished, to an end

example.en: Her contract is up next month, so it's time to negotiate another one.
example.ja: 彼女の契約は来月アップなので、他の契約を交渉する時間です。

definitions.definitionEn: In a good mood.

example.en: I’m feeling up today.
example.ja: 今日は気分がよくなりました。

definitions.definitionEn: (usually in the phrase up for) Willing; ready.

example.en: If you are up for a trip, let’s go.
example.ja: 旅行に出ようとしている人は、行ってみましょう。

definitions.definitionEn: Next in a sequence.

example.en: Smith is up to bat.
example.ja: スミスはバットだ

definitions.definitionEn: (not used attributively) Happening; new; of concern. See also what's up with.

example.en: What is up with that project at headquarters?
example.ja: 本部でのプロジェクトは?

definitions.definitionEn: (postnominal) Said of the higher-ranking pair in a two pair.

example.en: AAKK = aces up
example.ja: AKK = Aces アップ

definitions.definitionEn: Well-informed; current.

example.en: I’m not up on the latest news. What’s going on?
example.ja: 何が起きているのだろう。

definitions.definitionEn: Functional; working.

example.en: Is the server back up?
example.ja: サーバはバックアップされていますか?

definitions.definitionEn: (of a railway line or train) Traveling towards a major terminus.

example.en: The London train is on the up line.
example.ja: ロンドン列車はアップラインにあります

definitions.definitionEn: (bartending) Chilled and served without ice.

example.en: A Cosmopolitan is typically served up.
example.ja: コスモポリタンは、一般に有用である。

definitions.definitionEn: Erect.
(graffiti) well-known; renowned
Away from the surface of the Earth or other planet; in opposite direction to the downward pull of gravity.

example.en: I looked up and saw the airplane overhead.
example.ja: 目を上げてみると、頭上の飛行機が見えました。

definitions.definitionEn: To or at a physically higher or more elevated position.

example.en: All day we climbed up and up.
example.ja: 一日中上ったり上ったりしました。

definitions.definitionEn: To a higher level of some quantity or notional quantity, such as price, volume, pitch, happiness, etc.

example.en: Cheer up, the weekend's almost here.
example.ja: 楽にして週末はもうすぐよ

definitions.definitionEn: To or in a position of equal advance or equality; not short of, back of, less advanced than, away from, etc.; usually followed by to or with.

example.en: A stranger came up and asked me for directions.
example.ja: 見知らぬ人がやって来て、道を尋ねました。

definitions.definitionEn: (intensifier) Used as an aspect marker to indicate a completed action or state; thoroughly, completely.

example.en: Can you sum up your research?
example.ja: 研究をまとめて

definitions.definitionEn: To or from one's possession or consideration.

example.en: I picked up some milk on the way home.
example.ja: 帰る途中で牛乳を取って来た

definitions.definitionEn: North.

example.en: I live in Florida, but I'm going up to New York to visit my family this weekend.
example.ja: 私はフロリダに住んでいますが、今週末に家族に会いにニューヨークに行く予定です。

definitions.definitionEn: Towards or at a central place, or any place that is visualised as 'up' by virtue of local features or local convention, or arbitrarily, irrespective of direction or elevation change.

example.en: He lives up by the railway station.
example.ja: 駅の近くに住んでます

definitions.definitionEn: Towards the principal terminus, towards milepost zero.
Aside, so as not to be in use.

example.en: to lay up riches; put up your weapons
example.ja: 富を蓄える; 武器を置く

definitions.definitionEn: Against the wind or current.
(Cartesian graph) In a positive vertical direction.
Relatively close to the batsman.

example.en: The bowler pitched the ball up.
example.ja: ボウラーはボールを上げました。

definitions.definitionEn: (bartending) Without additional ice.

example.en: Would you like that drink up or on ice?
example.ja: 飲んでいい? それとも氷?

definitions.definitionEn: (academia) To university, especially to Cambridge or Oxford.

example.en: She's going up to read Classics this September.
example.ja: 彼女は今年の9月からクラシックを読もうとしている。

definitions.definitionEn: Toward the top of.

example.en: The cat climbed up the tree.
example.ja: 猫は木に登りました

definitions.definitionEn: Toward the center, source, or main point of reference; toward the end at which something is attached.

example.en: I felt something crawling up my arm.
example.ja: 何かが私の腕をはい上がってくるのを感じた。

definitions.definitionEn: From south to north of.

example.en: We sailed up the East Coast of England from Ipswich to South Shields.
example.ja: 私たちはイプスウィッチから南の盾に至るイングランドの東海岸を船で上ったのです。

definitions.definitionEn: Further along (in any direction).

example.en: Go up the street until you see the sign.
example.ja: 看板を見るまで道を上れ

definitions.definitionEn: From the mouth towards the source of (a river or waterway).

example.en: He led an expedition up the Amazon.
example.ja: 彼はアマゾンの遠征を指揮した

definitions.definitionEn: Of a man: having sex with.

example.en: Phwoar, look at that bird. I'd love to be up her.
example.ja: フワフル、あの鳥を見て、彼女と一緒にいたい。

definitions.definitionEn: At (a given place, especially one imagined to be higher or more distant from a central location).

example.en: I'll see you later up the snooker club.
example.ja: スヌーククラブで会いましょう

definitions.definitionEn: Of a measurement: approximately, roughly.

example.en: I guess he must have weighed some 90 kilos.
example.ja: 90キロくらいの重量だ

definitions.definitionEn: A certain number, at least two.

example.en: Some enjoy spicy food, others prefer it milder.
example.ja: 芳香のある食物を好きな人もいれば、もっと暖かな食物を好む人もいます。

definitions.definitionEn: An indefinite quantity.

example.en: Can I have some of them?
example.ja: 何本かもらえる?

definitions.definitionEn: An indefinite amount, a part.

example.en: Everyone is wrong some of the time.
example.ja: 人は皆、時々間違っている。

definitions.definitionEn: An other, another (person, etc), more often rendered as another.

example.en: I'm afraid little Robbie does not always play well with others.
example.ja: ロビーのリトルはいつも他人とうまくやってるわけじゃないわ
