definitions.definitionEn: The other one; the second of two.

example.en: One boat is not better than the other.
example.ja: 1隻のボートは他方より優れていない。

definitions.definitionEn: To regard, label or treat as an "other", as not part of the same group; to view as different and alien.
To treat as different or separate; segregate; ostracise.
See other (determiner) below
Second.

example.en: I get paid every other week.
example.ja: 一週間ごとに給料が支給される。

definitions.definitionEn: Alien.
Different.
Left, as opposed to right.
Apart from; in the phrase "other than".

example.en: Other than that, I'm fine.
example.ja: そのほか、私は大丈夫。

definitions.definitionEn: Otherwise.

example.en: If you think other. — Shakespeare.
example.ja: ―シェークスピア。

definitions.definitionEn: A means of exit, escape, reprieve, etc.

example.en: They wrote the law to give those organizations an out.
example.ja: 彼らはそれらの組織を解散させるために法律を書きました。

definitions.definitionEn: A state in which a member of the batting team is removed from play due to the application of various rules of the game such as striking out, hitting a fly ball which is caught by the fielding team before bouncing, etc.

A dismissal; a state in which a member of the batting team finishes his turn at bat, due to the application of various rules of the game, such as the bowler knocking over the batsman's wicket with the ball.
A card which can make a hand a winner.
A trip out; an outing.
(chiefly in the plural) One who, or that which, is out; especially, one who is out of office.
A place or space outside of something; a nook or corner; an angle projecting outward; an open space.
A word or words omitted by the compositor in setting up copy; an omission.
To eject; to expel.
To reveal (a person) as LGBT+ (gay, trans, etc).
To reveal (a person or organization) as having a certain secret, such as a being a secret agent or undercover detective.
To reveal (a secret).

example.en: A Brazilian company outed the new mobile phone design.
example.ja: ブラジルのある会社は、新しい携帯のデザインを編み出しました。

definitions.definitionEn: To come or go out; to get out or away; to become public or apparent.
Not at home; not at one's office or place of employment.

example.en: I'm sorry, Mr Smith is out at the moment.
example.ja: すみませんスミスさんは今外出中なんです

definitions.definitionEn: Not inside or within something.

example.en: I worked away cleaning the U-bend until all the gunge was out.
example.ja: Uベンドを掃除して拳銃が消えるまで

definitions.definitionEn: Freed from confinement or secrecy.

example.en: My secret is out.
example.ja: 秘密は解けた

definitions.definitionEn: Not fitted or inserted into something.

example.en: The TV won't work with the plug out!
example.ja: TVはプラグを通さない!

definitions.definitionEn: Of the ball or other playing implement, falling or passing outside the bounds of the playing area.

example.en: I thought the ball hit the line, but the umpire said it was out.
example.ja: ボールがラインを打ったと思ったが、そのユニバーサルは脱線したと言った。

definitions.definitionEn: Released, available for purchase, download or other use.

example.en: Did you hear? Their newest CD is out!
example.ja: 最新のCDが切れてる!

definitions.definitionEn: (in various games; used especially of a batsman or batter in cricket or baseball) Dismissed from play under the rules of the game.

example.en: He bowls, Johnson pokes at it ... and ... Johnson is out! Caught behind by Ponsonby!
example.ja: ボンソンビーに追われてる!

definitions.definitionEn: Openly acknowledging that one is LGBT+ (gay, trans, etc).

example.en: It's no big deal to be out in the entertainment business.
example.ja: 演劇ビジネスでは大したことない。

definitions.definitionEn: (by extension) Open, public; public about or openly acknowledging some (usually specified) identity.
(of flowers) In bloom.

example.en: The garden looks beautiful now that the roses are out.
example.ja: バラが出てきた今、庭は美しく見える。

definitions.definitionEn: (of the sun, moon or stars) Visible in the sky; not obscured by clouds.

example.en: The sun is out, and it's a lovely day.
example.ja: 陽は出で、美しい一日だ。

definitions.definitionEn: (of lamps, fires etc.) Not shining or burning.

example.en: I called round to the house but all the lights were out and no one was home.
example.ja: 私は家に電話をかけましたが、明かりはすべて消え、家にはだれもいませんでした。

definitions.definitionEn: (of ideas, plans, etc.) Discarded; no longer a possibility.

example.en: Right, so that idea's out. Let's move on to the next one.
example.ja: (2018年3月18日). http://www.nikkansports.com/articles/news/2017/ 2018年9月15日閲覧. ^ ""[[1]".

definitions.definitionEn: (of certain services, devices, or facilities) Not available; out of service.

example.en: My wi-fi is out.
example.ja: Wi-Fiが抜けた

definitions.definitionEn: (of a user of a service) Not having availability of a service, as power or communications.

example.en: Most of the city got service back yesterday, but my neighborhood is still out.
example.ja: 市の殆どは昨日のサービスを受けたが、私の近所はまだ外出している。

definitions.definitionEn: (of an organization, etc.) Temporarily not in operation, or not being attended as usual.

example.en: when school gets out for today, when college is out for the summer
example.ja: 大学が夏休みの今日の学校が卒業したとき

definitions.definitionEn: Of the tide, at or near its lowest level.

example.en: You can walk to the island when the tide's out.
example.ja: 潮が満ちたら島まで歩ける。

definitions.definitionEn: No longer popular or in fashion.

example.en: Black is out this season. The new black is white.
example.ja: このシーズンはブラックアウトだ新しい黒は白だ

definitions.definitionEn: Without; no longer in possession of; not having more

example.en: Do you have any bread? Sorry, we're out.
example.ja: パンは?

definitions.definitionEn: (of calculations or measurements) Containing errors or discrepancies; in error by a stated amount.

example.en: Nothing adds up in this report. All these figures are out.
example.ja: この報告書には何も書いてない

definitions.definitionEn: Of a young lady: having entered society and available to be courted.
Away from the inside, centre or other point of reference.

example.en: For six hours the tide flows out, then for six hours it flows in.
example.ja: 6 時間にわたって潮は流れ、 6 時間は流れ込みます。

definitions.definitionEn: Away from home or one's usual place.

example.en: Let's eat out tonight
example.ja: 今夜は外に食事をしに行きましょうか。

definitions.definitionEn: Outside; not indoors.

example.en: Last night we slept out under the stars.
example.ja: 昨夜は星の下で眠った

definitions.definitionEn: Away from; at a distance.

example.en: Keep out!
example.ja: 立ち入りを禁ず。

definitions.definitionEn: Into a state of non-operation; into non-existence.

example.en: I painted out that nasty mark on the wall.
example.ja: 壁に印を塗った

definitions.definitionEn: To the end; completely.

example.en: I haven't finished. Hear me out.
example.ja: まだ終わってない話を聞いて

definitions.definitionEn: Used to intensify or emphasize.

example.en: The place was all decked out for the holidays.
example.ja: 休日の支度をしてた

definitions.definitionEn: (of the sun, moon, stars, etc.) So as to be visible in the sky, and not covered by clouds, fog, etc.

example.en: The sun came out after the rain, and we saw a rainbow.
example.ja: 雨の後に太陽が出てきたので、私たちは虹を見ました。

definitions.definitionEn: Of a player, so as to be disqualified from playing further by some action of a member of the opposing team (such as being stumped in cricket).

example.en: Wilson was bowled out for five runs.
example.ja: ウィルソンは5回の試合でアウトにされた

definitions.definitionEn: From from the inside to the outside of; out of.
(procedure word) A radio procedure word meaning that the station is finished with its transmission and does not expect a response.

example.en: Destruction. Two T-72s destroyed. Three foot mobiles down. Out.
example.ja: 破壊 T -72が2台破壊 3フィート下

definitions.definitionEn: Get out; begone; away!
(of people)
(of capabilities)
(properties and qualities)
(when with and) Very, extremely. See good and.

example.en: The soup is good and hot.
example.ja: スープはおいしくて熱い。

definitions.definitionEn: Holy (especially when capitalized) .

example.en: Good Friday
example.ja: フライデー

definitions.definitionEn: (of quantities)
That is good; an elliptical exclamation of satisfaction or commendation.

example.en: Good! I can leave now.
example.ja: よかったもう出られるよ

definitions.definitionEn: Well; satisfactorily or thoroughly.

example.en: The boy done good. (did well)
example.ja: (うまくいった)

definitions.definitionEn: The forces or behaviours that are the enemy of evil. Usually consists of helping others and general benevolence.
A result that is positive in the view of the speaker.
The abstract instantiation of goodness; that which possesses desirable qualities, promotes success, welfare, or happiness, is serviceable, fit, excellent, kind, benevolent, etc.

example.en: The best is the enemy of the good.
example.ja: ベストは善の敵である。

definitions.definitionEn: (usually in the plural) An item of merchandise.
To thrive; fatten; prosper; improve.
To make good; turn to good; improve.
To make improvements or repairs.
To benefit; gain.
To do good to (someone); benefit; cause to improve or gain.
To satisfy; indulge; gratify.
To flatter; congratulate oneself; anticipate.
To furnish with dung; manure; fatten with manure; fertilise.
Used as plural of person; a body of human beings considered generally or collectively; a group of two or more persons.

example.en: There were so many people at the restaurant last night.
example.ja: 昨夜レストランには大勢の人がいました

definitions.definitionEn: Persons forming or belonging to a particular group, such as a nation, class, ethnic group, country, family, etc.
A group of persons regarded as being employees, followers, companions or subjects of a ruler.
One's colleagues or employees.
A person's ancestors, relatives or family.

example.en: My people lived through the Black Plague and the Thirty Years War.
example.ja: 民はブラックペストと三十年の戦争を生き抜きました

definitions.definitionEn: The mass of a community as distinguished from a special class (elite); the commonalty; the populace; the vulgar; the common crowd; the citizens.
To stock with people or inhabitants; to fill as with people; to populate.
To become populous or populated.
To inhabit; to occupy; to populate.
To interact with people; to socialize.
An individual; usually a human being.

example.en: Each person is unique, both mentally and physically.
example.ja: 個々の人は精神的にも身体的においても特異な存在です。

definitions.definitionEn: The physical body of a being seen as distinct from the mind, character, etc.
Any individual or formal organization with standing before the courts.

example.en: At common law a corporation or a trust is legally a person.
example.ja: 法学>コンメンタール>コンソーシアム>コンサルティング法>コンクリート・コンメンション=コンメンテーション法>民法>法学>民事法 (コンメンス法) ^ a b c d e f g h i "一般法".

definitions.definitionEn: The human genitalia; specifically, the penis.
(grammar) A linguistic category used to distinguish between the speaker of an utterance and those to whom or about whom he or she is speaking. See grammatical person.
A shoot or bud of a plant; a polyp or zooid of the compound Hydrozoa, Anthozoa, etc.; also, an individual, in the narrowest sense, among the higher animals.
A solar year, the time it takes the Earth to complete one revolution of the Sun (between 365.24 and 365.26 days depending on the point of reference).

example.en: we moved to this town a year ago;  I quit smoking exactly one year ago
example.ja: 私たちは1年前にこの町に移った。

definitions.definitionEn: (by extension) The time it takes for any astronomical object (such as a planet, dwarf planet, small Solar System body, or comet) in direct orbit around a star (such as the Sun) to make one revolution around the star.

example.en: Mars goes around the sun once in a Martian year, or 1.88 Earth years.
example.ja: 1.88の地球年です火星は太陽を周回しています

definitions.definitionEn: A period between set dates that mark a year, from January 1 to December 31 by the Gregorian calendar, from Tishiri 1 to Elul 29 by the Jewish calendar, and from Muharram 1 to Dhu al-Hijjah 29 or 30 by the Islamic calendar.

example.en: A normal year has 365 full days, but there are 366 days in a leap year.
example.ja: 通常の 1 年は 365 日ですが、飛躍的な年には 366 日あります。

definitions.definitionEn: A scheduled part of a calendar year spent in a specific activity.

example.en: During this school year I have to get up at 6:30 to catch the bus.
example.ja: この学年は、バスに乗るために6時30分に起きなければならない。

definitions.definitionEn: A Julian year, exactly 365.25 days, represented by "a".
A level or grade in school or college.

example.en: Every second-year student must select an area of specialization.
example.ja: 2年生ごとに、特別専門分野を選定しなければならない。

definitions.definitionEn: The proportion of a creature's lifespan equivalent to one year of an average human lifespan (see also dog year).

example.en: Geneticists have created baker's yeast that can live to 800 in yeast years.
example.ja: 酵母菌の時代に800まで生きられるパン屋の酵母菌は

definitions.definitionEn: (abstract) This place; this location.

example.en: An Alzheimer patient's here may in his mind be anywhere he called home in the time he presently re-lives.
example.ja: アルツハイマー患者はここで、現在再生している時代に自宅に電話を受けた場所がどこにでもあるかもしれない。

definitions.definitionEn: (abstract) This time, the present situation.
Eye dialect spelling of hear
The or an act of taking.
Something that is taken; a haul.
An interpretation or view, opinion or assessment; perspective.

example.en: What's your take on this issue, Fred?
example.ja: この件で何を? フレッド

definitions.definitionEn: An approach, a (distinct) treatment.

example.en: a new take on a traditional dish
example.ja: 伝統的な料理の新品

definitions.definitionEn: A scene recorded (filmed) at one time, without an interruption or break; a recording of such a scene.

example.en: Act seven, scene three, take two.
example.ja: 第七条シーン3 第2項に規定する

definitions.definitionEn: A recording of a musical performance made during an uninterrupted single recording period.
A visible (facial) response to something, especially something unexpected; a facial gesture in response to an event.

example.ja: 新しい車を見た時盗んだんだ

definitions.definitionEn: An instance of successful inoculation/vaccination.
A catch of the ball (in cricket, especially one by the wicket-keeper).
The quantity of copy given to a compositor at one time.
To get into one's hands, possession or control, with or without force.

definitions.definitionEn: To receive or accept (something) (especially something given or bestowed, awarded, etc).

example.en: The camera takes 35mm film.
example.ja: カメラは35ミリフィルムを取る。

definitions.definitionEn: To remove.

example.en: take two eggs from the carton
example.ja: カートンから卵を2つ取って

definitions.definitionEn: To have sex with.
To defeat (someone or something) in a fight.

example.en: Don't try to take that guy. He's bigger than you.
example.ja: あの男を奪おうとしないで彼はあなたより大きい

definitions.definitionEn: To grasp or grip.

example.en: He took her hand in his.
example.ja: 彼は彼女の手をつかんだ

definitions.definitionEn: To select or choose; to pick.

example.en: I'll take the blue plates.

definitions.definitionEn: To adopt (select) as one's own.

example.en: She took his side in every argument.
example.ja: 彼女はすべての議論で彼の側を取っていた。

definitions.definitionEn: To carry or lead (something or someone).

example.en: I'll take the plate with me.
example.ja: お皿を持ってきます。

definitions.definitionEn: To use as a means of transportation.

example.en: He took the bus to London, and then took a train to Manchester.
example.ja: 彼はバスでロンドンへ行き、それから列車でマンチェスターへ行きました。

definitions.definitionEn: To visit; to include in a course of travel.
To obtain for use by payment or lease.

example.ja: 彼はタイムスで全面広告を取った。

definitions.definitionEn: To consume.
To experience, undergo, or endure.
To cause to change to a specified state or condition.

example.en: He had to take it apart to fix it.
example.ja: 彼はそれを分解して修理しなければならない。

definitions.definitionEn: To regard in a specified way.

example.en: He took the news badly.
example.ja: 彼はそのニュースを悪く取り上げました。

definitions.definitionEn: To conclude or form (a decision or an opinion) in the mind.

definitions.definitionEn: To understand (especially in a specified way).

definitions.definitionEn: To believe, to accept the statements of.

example.ja: 彼女の言葉を受け継ぐ

definitions.definitionEn: To assume or suppose; to reckon; to regard or consider.

example.ja: 私を馬鹿だと思っているのですか。

example.en: I'm not sure what moral to take from that story.
example.ja: その話からどんな道徳心を取るかはわからない。

definitions.definitionEn: To derive (as a title); to obtain from a source.

example.en: "As I Lay Dying" takes its title from Book XI of Homer's "Odyssey"
example.ja: 2018年12月22日閲覧. ^ ""死去"はホメロスの"オデュッセー"の著作物"". 読売新聞。

definitions.definitionEn: To catch or contract (an illness, etc).

definitions.definitionEn: To come upon or catch (in a particular state or situation).

example.ja: 彼女の注意を引いた

definitions.definitionEn: (of a material) To absorb or be impregnated by (dye, ink, etc); to be susceptible to being treated by (polish, etc).

example.en: cloth that takes dye well
example.ja: 染色の良い布

definitions.definitionEn: (of a ship) To let in (water).
To require.

example.ja: 期限内にこれを終わらせるには、多くの残業が必要になります。

definitions.definitionEn: To proceed to fill.

example.ja: 前列の席に座った。

definitions.definitionEn: To fill, to use up (time or space).

example.ja: 彼のコレクションは、多くのスペースを取る。

definitions.definitionEn: To move into.

definitions.definitionEn: To go into, through, or along.

Like

To pretend to be; to behave in the manner of.

definitions.definitionEn: The punctuation mark ⟨,⟩ used to indicate a set off parts of a sentence or between elements of a list.
A similar-looking subscript diacritical mark.
Any of various nymphalid butterflies of the genus Polygonia, having a comma-shaped white mark on the underwings, especially Polygonia c-album and Polygonia c-aureum of North Africa, Europe, and Asia.
A difference in the calculation of nearly identical intervals by different ways.
A delimiting marker between items in a genetic sequence.

A brief interval.

definitions.definitionEn: (auxiliary verb, defective) Used with verbs of perception.

example.en: Can you hear that?.
example.ja: 聞こえたか?

definitions.definitionEn: To know.
Something that could happen, or could be the case, under different circumstances; a potentiality.
(heading) Employment.
(heading) Effort.
Sustained effort to achieve a goal or result, especially overcoming obstacles.

example.en: We don't have much time. Let's get to work piling up those sandbags.
example.ja: あまり時間が無い砂袋を積み上げよう

definitions.definitionEn: (heading) Product; the result of effort.

Ore before it is dressed.

example.en: Tell me you're using clean works at least.

definitions.definitionEn: To do a specific task by employing physical or mental powers.

example.en: He’s working in a bar.
example.ja: 彼はバーで働いている。

definitions.definitionEn: To effect by gradual degrees.

example.en: he worked his way through the crowd
example.ja: 彼は群衆を通り抜けた

definitions.definitionEn: To embroider with thread.
To set into action.

example.en: He worked the levers.
example.ja: 彼はレバーを担当した

definitions.definitionEn: To cause to ferment.
To ferment.
To exhaust, by working.

example.en: The mine was worked until the last scrap of ore had been extracted.
example.ja: 鉱山は、最後の原鉱が採取されるまで働いていました。

definitions.definitionEn: To shape, form, or improve a material.

example.en: He used pliers to work the wire into shape.
example.ja: 彼はワイヤを形作るのにペンチを使った

definitions.definitionEn: To operate in a certain place, area, or speciality.

example.en: she works the night clubs
example.ja: 彼女はナイトクラブで働いている

definitions.definitionEn: To operate in or through; as, to work the phones.
To provoke or excite; to influence.

example.en: The rock musician worked the crowd of young girls into a frenzy.
example.ja: ロック・ミュージシャンは若い少女たちの群衆をかき乱していました。

definitions.definitionEn: To use or manipulate to one’s advantage.

example.en: She knows how to work the system.
example.ja: 彼女はシステムの仕組みを知ってる

definitions.definitionEn: To cause to happen or to occur as a consequence.

example.en: I cannot work a miracle.
example.ja: 奇跡は出来ない

definitions.definitionEn: To cause to work.

example.en: He is working his servants hard.
example.ja: エホバはご自分の僕たちのために懸命に働いておられます。

definitions.definitionEn: To function correctly; to act as intended; to achieve the goal designed for.

example.en: he pointed at the car and asked, "Does it work"?;  he looked at the bottle of pain pills, wondering if they would work;  my plan didn’t work
example.ja: 車を指さして"か"と訊くと、痛みの薬の瓶を見て、それが効くのか疑問に思ったが、私の計画は効かなかった。

definitions.definitionEn: To influence.

example.en: They worked on her to join the group.
example.ja: 彼らはそのグループに加わるために彼女の仕事をしました。

definitions.definitionEn: To effect by gradual degrees; as, to work into the earth.
To move in an agitated manner.

example.en: A ship works in a heavy sea.
example.ja: 船は重い海で働いている。

definitions.definitionEn: To behave in a certain way when handled

example.en: this dough does not work easily;  the soft metal works well
example.ja: 柔らかな金属はよく作動する

definitions.definitionEn: (with two objects) To cause (someone) to feel (something); to do unto somebody (something, whether good or bad).
To hurt; to ache.
The act of using.

example.ja: 国際連合は拷問の使用を非としてきました。

definitions.definitionEn: The act of consuming alcohol or narcotics.
(followed by "of") Usefulness, benefit.

example.en: What's the use of a law that nobody follows?
example.ja: 誰も従わない法律の行使とは?

definitions.definitionEn: A function; a purpose for which something may be employed.

example.en: This tool has many uses.
example.ja: この道具には多くの用途があります。

definitions.definitionEn: Occasion or need to employ; necessity.

example.en: I have no further use for these textbooks.
example.ja: この教科書はもう用済みです。

definitions.definitionEn: Interest for lent money; premium paid for the use of something; usury.
Continued or repeated practice; usage; habit.
Common occurrence; ordinary experience.
The special form of ritual adopted for use in any diocese.

example.en: the Sarum, or Canterbury, use; the Hereford use; the York use; the Roman use; etc.
example.ja: サルム、つまりカンタベリーは使われ、ヘレフォードは使用され、ニューヨークは使用、ローマは使用します。

definitions.definitionEn: (forging) A slab of iron welded to the side of a forging, such as a shaft, near the end, and afterward drawn down, by hammering, so as to lengthen the forging.
To utilize or employ.
To accustom; to habituate. (Now common only in participial form. Uses the same pronunciation as the noun; see usage notes.)

example.en: soldiers who are used to hardships and danger
example.ja: 辛苦と危険に慣れている兵士たち

definitions.definitionEn: (except in past tense) To habitually do; to be wont to do. (Now chiefly in past-tense forms; see used to.)

example.en: I used to get things done.
example.ja: 私はよく物事を済ませた

definitions.definitionEn: To behave toward; to act with regard to; to treat.

example.en: to use an animal cruelly
example.ja: 動物を残酷に用いる

definitions.definitionEn: To behave, act, comport oneself.
At that time; then.

Introduces a comparison, and is associated with comparatives, and with words such as more, less, and fewer. Typically, it seeks to measure the force of an adjective or similar description between two predicates.

example.en: A player than whom none is more skillful.
example.ja: 誰よりも上手なプレイヤーだ

definitions.definitionEn: Used in comparisons, to introduce the basis of comparison.

example.en: she's taller than I am;  she found his advice more witty than helpful;  we have less work today than we had yesterday;  We had no choice than to return home
example.ja: 私よりも背が高く、彼女は助けよりも賢明な助言を見つけた。今日、私たちは、昨日よりも仕事が少なかった。

definitions.definitionEn: (obsolete outside dialectal, usually used with for) Because; for.

definitions.definitionEn: The present time.

example.en: Now is the right time.
example.ja: 今がその時だ

definitions.definitionEn: (often with "the") The state of not paying attention to the future or the past.

example.en: She is living in the now.
example.ja: 彼女は今生きている。

definitions.definitionEn: (chiefly in phenomenology) A particular instant in time, as perceived at that instant.
Present; current.
Fashionable; popular; up to date; current.

example.en: I think this band's sound is very now.
example.ja: このバンドの音は今まさに今である。

definitions.definitionEn: At the time the will is written. Used in order to prevent any inheritance from being transferred to a person of a future marriage. Does not indicate the existence of a previous marriage.

example.en: Now wife.
example.ja: 今度は妻だ

definitions.definitionEn: At the present time.

example.en: Now I am six.
example.ja: 今では 6 歳です。

definitions.definitionEn: (sentence) Used to introduce a point, a qualification of what has previously been said, a remonstration or a rebuke.

example.en: Now stop that, Jimmy!
example.ja: やめてジミー!

definitions.definitionEn: Differently from the immediate past; differently from a more remote past or a possible future; differently from all other times.

example.en: Now I am ready.
example.ja: もう準備はできてる

definitions.definitionEn: Differently from the situation before a stated event or change of circumstance.

example.en: Now all the children have grown up and left, the house is very quiet.
example.ja: 今では子供たちは皆、大きくなって家を出て行きましたが、家はとても静かです。

definitions.definitionEn: At the time reached within a narration.

example.en: He now asked her whether she had made pudding.
example.ja: そして、プリンを作ったのかどうか尋ねました。

definitions.definitionEn: In the context of urgency.

example.en: Now listen, we must do something about this.
example.ja: 聞いてくれ何とかしないと

definitions.definitionEn: As 'but now': Very recently; not long ago; up to the present.

example.ja: 此処に皆参つて、会議を始め給へり。

example.ja: 敵が到着するまで全部発射しろ!

definitions.definitionEn: Used in comparisons, to introduce the basis of comparison.

example.en: she's taller than I am;  she found his advice more witty than helpful;  we have less work today than we had yesterday;  We had no choice than to return home
example.ja: 私よりも背が高く、彼女は助けよりも賢明な助言を見つけた。今日、私たちは、昨日よりも仕事が少なかった。

definitions.definitionEn: (obsolete outside dialectal, usually used with for) Because; for.
That time

example.ja: その前に完成する。

definitions.definitionEn: Being so at that time.
(temporal location) At that time.

example.ja: そのときは幸福でした。

definitions.definitionEn: (temporal location) Soon afterward.

example.ja: 彼はそれを修理し、それから去りました。

example.ja: メアリーは、家の中で踊った。

example.ja: 漂流木片を捕鯨像に刻んだ。

example.ja: 今夜のデートは黒髪だ

example.ja: 24 は 48 にいくつありますか?

example.ja: 彼は何マイルにもわたって唯一の医師だ。

example.ja: 実のところ、その子はただひとりの子なのです。

example.ja: 私の心は彼女のもので、彼女のだけ。

example.ja: チケットがあと1枚あったら!

example.en: She's only gone and run off with the milkman!
example.ja: ただ牛乳屋と逃げただけだ!

example.ja: 私の自転車を借りても?

definitions.definitionEn: But; except.

example.ja: 走るのが楽しくてこの足が折れてるだけ

To appear, to seem.

example.ja: じきに雨が降るように見えるか、あるいはすぐに雨が降りそうに見えるか、又は雨が来ているように見える。

definitions.definitionEn: To give an appearance of being.

example.en: What a fright you looked in that hideous outfit.
example.ja: あの醜い服を何と怖く見たの?

definitions.definitionEn: To search for, to try to find.
To face or present a view.

example.ja: ホテルはヒンズー教のクシュの谷を見渡しています。

definitions.definitionEn: To expect or anticipate.

example.ja: 私は愛する者の到着を待ちわびています。

example.en: {{quote-book|en|year=c. 1815|author=w:Lord Byron|title=Waterloo

definitions.definitionEn: To make sure of, to see to.

example.en: {{RQ:Homer Butler Odyssey|passage="Look to it yourself, father," answered Telemachus, "for they say you are the wisest counsellor in the world, and that there is no other mortal man who can compare with you.}}

definitions.definitionEn: To check, to make sure (of something).
To look at; to turn the eyes toward.

definitions.definitionEn: To seek; to search for.

example.en: She doesn't like to look inside and face up to what she's really like.
example.ja: 彼女は、内を見ながら、自分の本当の姿に向き合うのを嫌がる。

definitions.definitionEn: To influence, overawe, or subdue by looks or presence.

example.en: to look down opposition
example.ja: )の反対を見下げる

definitions.definitionEn: To look at a pitch as a batter without swinging at it.

example.en: The fastball caught him looking.
example.ja: スピードボールは彼を見てるのを捉えた

example.ja: いいかどうするか説明するからよく聞いてくれ

definitions.definitionEn: The action of looking; an attempt to see.

example.ja: [リンク切れ]

definitions.definitionEn: Physical appearance, visual impression.

example.ja: 母親の顔立ちを見ていたのです。

definitions.definitionEn: A facial expression.

example.ja: 汚そうな顔をした

Something needed or desired; a thing of which the loss is felt.

To wish for or desire (something); to feel a need or desire for; to crave or demand.

example.en: What do you want to eat?  I want you to leave.  I never wanted to go back to live with my mother.
example.ja: 何を食べたいの?

example.ja: デンマーク警察は彼の横領を望んだ

definitions.definitionEn: To desire (to experience desire); to wish.

example.en: You can leave if you want.
example.ja: 出ていってもいいよ

example.ja: 最善の結果を得るために、この三、四回繰り返してみたいと思うでしょう。

definitions.definitionEn: (now colloquial) To lack and be in need of or require (something, such as a noun or verbal noun).

example.en: That chair wants fixing.
example.ja: 椅子が直そうとしている

definitions.definitionEn: (now rare) To have occasion for (something requisite or useful); to require or need.
To be lacking or deficient or absent.

example.en: There was something wanting in the play.
example.ja: 演劇中に何か欲しい物があった。

definitions.definitionEn: To be in a state of destitution; to be needy; to lack.

example.en: The paupers desperately want.
example.ja: そうした人々は必死になってそれを求めます。

definitions.definitionEn: To lack and be without, to not have (something).

example.en: She wanted anything she needed.
example.ja: 彼女は必要なものを欲しかった

definitions.definitionEn: (by extension) To lack and (be able to) do without.
The amount of bending that something undergoes when a force is applied to it; a tendency to yield under pressure; resilence.

example.en: There is no give in his dogmatic religious beliefs.
example.ja: 彼の独断的な宗教信条には何の見返りもありません。

example.ja: 成功の確率は95%だ

example.ja: 一本の柱がそれ以上の柱を出し、突然床全体が下の床にパンケーキをかぶってしまいました。

definitions.definitionEn: To provide, as, a service or a broadcast.

example.en: They're giving my favorite show!
example.ja: 私の大好きな番組よ!

definitions.definitionEn: To lead (onto or into).

example.ja: 主人の寝室は、広い天井に建っています。

definitions.definitionEn: To provide a view of.

example.en: His window gave the park.
example.ja: 窓が公園に

example.en: He can be bad-tempered, I'll give you that, but he's a hard worker.
example.ja: 彼は気まずくなれるが、それは認めるが、彼は勤勉な労働者だ。

definitions.definitionEn: To attribute; to assign; to adjudge.

example.ja: 最終的にウムピアは決定を下し、ボールは外に出ました。

To devote or apply (oneself).

example.en: That boy is given to fits of bad temper.
example.ja: その子はひどい怒りをぶちまけるようにされます。

To have a misgiving.

example.ja: これは初めてだ一度は何も言うことはない

definitions.definitionEn: Of an angle, having a size of 90 degrees, or one quarter of a complete rotation; the angle between two perpendicular lines.

example.en: The kitchen counter formed a right angle with the back wall.
example.ja: 台所のカウンターは、背中の壁と正しい角度を保っていました。

definitions.definitionEn: Of a geometric figure, incorporating a right angle between edges, faces, axes, etc.

example.en: a right triangle, a right prism, a right cone
example.ja: 直角三角形, 右プリズム, 右丸

definitions.definitionEn: Complying with justice, correctness or reason; correct, just, true.

example.en: I thought you'd made a mistake, but it seems you were right all along.
example.ja: あなたはミスをしたと思ったがずっと正しかったようだ

definitions.definitionEn: Appropriate, perfectly suitable; fit for purpose.

example.en: Is this the right software for my computer?
example.ja: 私のパソコンの適切なソフトウェア?

definitions.definitionEn: Healthy, sane, competent.

example.en: I'm afraid my father is no longer in his right mind.
example.ja: 父はもう自分の右心の中には居ません。

definitions.definitionEn: Real; veritable (used emphatically).

example.en: You've made a right mess of the kitchen!
example.ja: キッチンを台無しにしたな!

definitions.definitionEn: All right; not requiring assistance.
Most favourable or convenient; fortunate.
Designating the side of the body which is positioned to the east if one is facing north. This arrow points to the reader's right: →

example.en: After the accident, her right leg was slightly shorter than her left.
example.ja: 事故後、右足は左足より少し短い。

definitions.definitionEn: Designed to be placed or worn outward.

example.en: the right side of a piece of cloth
example.ja: 布切れの右側

definitions.definitionEn: Pertaining to the political right; conservative.
On the right side.
Towards the right side.
Exactly, precisely.

example.en: Luckily we arrived right at the start of the film.
example.ja: ラッキーなことに映画のはじめに到着した。

definitions.definitionEn: Immediately, directly.

example.en: Can't you see it? It's right beside you!
example.ja: 見えない?

definitions.definitionEn: Very, extremely, quite.

example.en: I made a right stupid mistake there, didn't I?
example.ja: 愚かなミスをしたな?

definitions.definitionEn: According to fact or truth; actually; truly; really.
In a correct manner.

example.en: Do it right or don't do it at all.
example.ja: 正しい事をするか、全くしないか。

definitions.definitionEn: (still used in some titles) To a great extent or degree.

example.en: Members of the Queen's Privy Council are styled The Right Honourable for life.
example.ja: 女王の小議院の議員は、生涯の正義の誓いを立てている。

definitions.definitionEn: Yes, that is correct; I agree.
I agree with whatever you say; I have no opinion.
Signpost word to change the subject in a discussion or discourse.
Used to check agreement at the end of an utterance.

example.en: You're going, right?
example.ja: 行くんだろ?

definitions.definitionEn: Used to add seriousness or decisiveness before a statement.
That which complies with justice, law or reason.

example.en: We're on the side of right in this contest.
example.ja: 我々は、このコンテストの右側にあります。

definitions.definitionEn: A legal, just or moral entitlement.

example.en: You have no right to go through my personal diary.
example.ja: 日記を調べる権利はない

definitions.definitionEn: The right side or direction.

example.en: The pharmacy is just on the right past the bookshop.
example.ja: 薬局は書店のすぐ右の側にある。

definitions.definitionEn: The right hand or fist.
The ensemble of right-wing political parties; political conservatives as a group.

example.en: The political right holds too much power.
example.ja: 政治的権利は過大に権力を握っている。

definitions.definitionEn: The outward or most finished surface, as of a coin, piece of cloth, a carpet, etc.
A wave breaking from right to left (viewed from the shore).
To correct.

example.en: Righting all the wrongs of the war immediately will be impossible.
example.ja: 戦争のあらゆる悪を正すことは、直ちに不可能です。

definitions.definitionEn: To set upright.

example.en: The tow-truck righted what was left of the automobile.
example.ja: トイトラックは自動車に残ったものを右折した。

definitions.definitionEn: To return to normal upright position.

example.en: When the wind died down, the ship righted.
example.ja: 風が沈んだ時船は右折した

definitions.definitionEn: To do justice to; to relieve from wrong; to restore rights to; to assert or regain the rights of.

example.en: to right the oppressed
example.ja: 虐げられた者には,

meaning: どのように／どのくらい

definitions.definitionEn: The means by which something is accomplished.

example.en: I am not interested in the why, but in the how.
example.ja: その理由には関心がなく、その方法に関心があります。

definitions.definitionEn: To what degree.

example.en: How often do you practice?
example.ja: どれほど練習していますか。

definitions.definitionEn: In what manner.

example.en: How do you solve this puzzle?
example.ja: どうやってパズルを解ける?

definitions.definitionEn: In what state.

example.en: How are you?
example.ja: 元気？

definitions.definitionEn: Used as a modifier to indicate surprise, delight, or other strong feelings in an exclamation.

example.en: How very interesting!
example.ja: それは何と興味深いことでしょう。

definitions.definitionEn: The manner or way that.

example.en: I remember how I solved this puzzle.
example.ja: このパズルをどうやって解いたか覚えてる

definitions.definitionEn: That, the fact that, the way that.
An artificial barrow or tumulus.
A small hill in northern England. (Usage preserved mainly in place names.)
A greeting, used in representations of Native American speech.
The rear of the body, especially the part between the neck and the end of the spine and opposite the chest and belly.

example.en: Could you please scratch my back?
example.ja: 背中を掻いてくれない?

definitions.definitionEn: That which is farthest away from the front.

example.en: He sat in the back of the room.
example.ja: 彼は部屋の裏に座った。

definitions.definitionEn: Upper part of a natural object which is considered to resemble an animal's back.

example.en: The small boat raced over the backs of the waves.
example.ja: 小さな船は波の背中を疾走しました。

definitions.definitionEn: A support or resource in reserve.
The keel and keelson of a ship.

example.en: The ship's back broke in the pounding surf.
example.ja: 船は波打ちで故障した

definitions.definitionEn: The roof of a horizontal underground passage.
Effort, usually physical.

example.en: Put some back into it!
example.ja: 戻して!

definitions.definitionEn: A non-alcoholic drink (often water or a soft drink), to go with hard liquor or a cocktail.

example.en: Could I get a martini with a water back?
example.ja: 水でマティーニを

definitions.definitionEn: Among leather dealers, one of the thickest and stoutest tanned hides.
To go in the reverse direction.

example.en: the train backed into the station;  the horse refuses to back
example.ja: 列車は駅に戻ると、馬は戻ることを拒んだ

definitions.definitionEn: To support.

example.en: I back you all the way;  which horse are you backing in this race?
example.ja: この競走においてあなたはどちらの馬を支持していますか。

definitions.definitionEn: (of the wind) To change direction contrary to the normal pattern; that is, to shift anticlockwise in the northern hemisphere, or clockwise in the southern hemisphere.
(of a square sail) To brace the yards so that the wind presses on the front of the sail, to slow the ship.
(of an anchor) To lay out a second, smaller anchor to provide additional holding power.
(of a hunting dog) To stand still behind another dog which has pointed.
To push or force backwards.

example.en: The mugger backed her into a corner and demanded her wallet.
example.ja: 強盗は少女を追い詰め、財布を要求しました。

definitions.definitionEn: To get upon the back of; to mount.
To place or seat upon the back.
To make a back for; to furnish with a back.

example.en: to back books
example.ja: を選択して、ブックをバックアップする

definitions.definitionEn: To adjoin behind; to be at the back of.
To write upon the back of, possibly as an endorsement.

example.en: to back a letter;  to back a note or legal document
example.ja: をクリックして、手紙をバックアップします。ノートや法律文書をバックアップする

definitions.definitionEn: (of a justice of the peace) To sign or endorse (a warrant, issued in another county, to apprehend an offender).
To row backward with (oars).

example.en: to back the oars
example.ja: を選択して、

definitions.definitionEn: Near the rear.

example.en: Go in the back door of the house.
example.ja: 家の裏口へ行って

definitions.definitionEn: Not current.

example.en: I’d like to find a back issue of that magazine.
example.ja: その雑誌の裏表紙を見つけたいと思います。

definitions.definitionEn: Far from the main area.

example.en: They took a back road.
example.ja: 裏道を取った

definitions.definitionEn: In arrear; overdue.

example.en: They still owe three months' back rent.
example.ja: 家賃は3ヶ月だ

definitions.definitionEn: Moving or operating backward.

example.en: back action
example.ja: バックアクション

definitions.definitionEn: Pronounced with the highest part of the body of the tongue toward the back of the mouth, near the soft palate (most often describing a vowel).

example.en: The vowel of lot has a back vowel in most dialects of England.
example.ja: ロースの母音には、英国のほとんどの方言に母音があります。

definitions.definitionEn: To or in a previous condition or place.

example.en: He gave back the money.   He needs his money back.   He was on vacation, but now he’s back.   The office fell into chaos when you left, but now order is back.
example.ja: お金を返してくれたので、お金を返さなければなりませんでした。

definitions.definitionEn: Away from the front or from an edge.

example.en: Sit all the way back in your chair.
example.ja: 椅子に座れ

definitions.definitionEn: In a manner that impedes.

example.en: Fear held him back.
example.ja: 恐怖は彼を押さえつけました

definitions.definitionEn: In a reciprocal manner; in return.

example.en: If you hurt me, I'll hurt you back.
example.ja: 私を傷つけたら、返すわ。

definitions.definitionEn: Earlier, ago.

example.en: I last saw him a day or two back.
example.ja: 1日か2日で最後に会った

definitions.definitionEn: A large shallow vat; a cistern, tub, or trough, used by brewers, distillers, dyers, picklers, gluemakers, and others, for mixing or cooling wort, holding water, hot glue, etc.
A ferryboat.
To lament.
To intend.
To convey (a meaning).
To have conviction in (something said or expressed); to be sincere in (what one says).

example.en: Does she really mean what she said to him last night?
example.ja: 彼女は本当に昨夜彼に言ったことを意味しているのか?

definitions.definitionEn: To cause or produce (a given result); to bring about (a given result).

example.en: One faltering step means certain death.
example.ja: 一つの転機は確実な死を意味します。

definitions.definitionEn: (usually with to) To be of some level of importance.

example.en: Formality and titles mean nothing in their circle.
example.ja: 形成と題名は、その円上には何の意味もありません。

definitions.definitionEn: Common; general.
Of a common or low origin, grade, or quality; common; humble.

example.en: a man of mean parentage / a mean abode
example.ja: 只(本当に)弱(なのである)。かれらは, でしょう,

definitions.definitionEn: Low in quality or degree; inferior; poor; shabby.

example.en: a mean appearance / mean dress
example.ja: 意地悪な外見 / 意地悪のドレス

definitions.definitionEn: Without dignity of mind; destitute of honour; low-minded; spiritless; base.

example.en: a mean motive
example.ja: 意地悪な動機

definitions.definitionEn: Of little value or worth; worthy of little or no regard; contemptible; despicable.
Ungenerous; stingy; tight-fisted.

example.en: He's so mean. I've never seen him spend so much as five pounds on presents for his children.
example.ja: 子供のプレゼントに 5ポンドを費やしたなんて

definitions.definitionEn: Disobliging; pettily offensive or unaccommodating
Selfish; acting without consideration of others; unkind.

example.en: It was mean to steal the girl's piggy bank, but he just had to get uptown and he had no cash of his own.
example.ja: 少女の小売銀行を盗もうとしていたが、彼はただアップタウンに登り、自分の現金を持っていなかった。

definitions.definitionEn: Intending to cause harm, successfully or otherwise; bearing ill will towards another

example.en: Watch out for her, she's mean. I said good morning to her, and she punched me in the nose.
example.ja: 彼女の気をそらすな、彼女は意地悪だ、朝には、彼女は私を鼻で叩いた。

definitions.definitionEn: Powerful; fierce; strong

example.en: It must have been a mean typhoon that levelled this town.
example.ja: この街を平らげたのは意地悪な台風だったに違いない

definitions.definitionEn: Accomplished with great skill; deft; hard to compete with.

example.en: He hits a mean backhand.
example.ja: 彼は裏手を打つ。

definitions.definitionEn: Difficult, tricky.

example.en: This problem is mean!
example.ja: この問題は意味があるのです。

definitions.definitionEn: (now chiefly in the plural) A method or course of action used to achieve some result.
(in the singular) An intermediate step or intermediate steps.
Something which is intermediate or in the middle; an intermediate value or range of values; a medium.
The middle part of three-part polyphonic music; now specifically, the alto part in polyphonic music; an alto instrument.
The average of a set of values, calculated by summing them together and dividing by the number of terms; the arithmetic mean.
Any function of multiple variables that satisfies certain properties and yields a number representative of its arguments; or, the number so yielded; a measure of central tendency.
Either of the two numbers in the middle of a conventionally presented proportion, as 2 and 3 in 1:2=3:6.
Having the mean (see noun below) as its value.
Middling; intermediate; moderately good, tolerable.
(diminutive) An even number.

example.en: So let's see. There are two evens here and three odds.
example.ja: コインを2回投げて表が出る確率を

definitions.definitionEn: To make flat and level.

example.en: We need to even this playing field; the west goal is too low.
example.ja: 我々はこの競技場までも必要である。西の目標は低すぎる。

definitions.definitionEn: To equal.
To be equal.

example.en: Thrice nine evens twenty seven.
example.ja: ライス 9 偶数 20 7。

definitions.definitionEn: To place in an equal state, as to obligation, or in a state in which nothing is due on either side; to balance, as accounts; to make quits.

example.en: We need to even the score.
example.ja: 得点も必要だ

definitions.definitionEn: To set right; to complete.
To act up to; to keep pace with.
Flat and level.

example.en: Clear out those rocks. The surface must be even.
example.ja: 岩を片付けろ表面は偶数に違いない

definitions.definitionEn: Without great variation.

example.en: Despite her fear, she spoke in an even voice.
example.ja: 恐れていたにもかかわらず、彼女は声を大にして話しました。

definitions.definitionEn: Equal in proportion, quantity, size, etc.

example.en: Call it even.
example.ja: 呼び出せよ

definitions.definitionEn: (of an integer) Divisible by two.

example.en: Four, fourteen and forty are even numbers.

definitions.definitionEn: (of a number) Convenient for rounding other numbers to; for example, ending in a zero.
On equal monetary terms; neither owing nor being owed.
On equal terms of a moral sort; quits.

example.en: You biffed me back at the barn, and I biffed you here—so now we're even.
example.ja: 納屋で私を怒らせたから、私はここであなたを叱った。だから、今、私たちは、実際にそれをしている。

definitions.definitionEn: Parallel; on a level; reaching the same limit.
Without an irregularity, flaw, or blemish; pure.
Associate; fellow; of the same condition.
Exactly, just, fully.

example.en: I fulfilled my instructions even as I had promised.
example.ja: 私は約束どおり指示を果たしました。

definitions.definitionEn: In reality; implying an extreme example in the case mentioned, as compared to the implied reality.

example.en: Did you even make it through the front door?
example.ja: 玄関を通り抜けたのか?

definitions.definitionEn: Emphasizing a comparative.

example.en: I was strong before, but now I am even stronger.
example.ja: 以前は強かったが今はさらに強くなった

definitions.definitionEn: Signalling a correction of one's previous utterance; rather, that is.

example.en: My favorite actor is Jack Nicklaus. Jack Nicholson, even.
example.ja: 私の好きな俳優はジャック・ニコルソン

definitions.definitionEn: Evening.

meaning: 〜してもよい；〜かもしれない；5月

definitions.definitionEn: To be strong; to have power (over).
(auxiliary) To be able; can.
To be able to go.
(modal auxiliary verb, defective) To have permission to, be allowed. Used in granting permission and in questions to make polite requests.

example.en: you may smoke outside;  may I sit there?
example.ja: 外でたばこを吸ってもいいでしょう。

definitions.definitionEn: (modal auxiliary verb, defective) Expressing a present possibility; possibly.

example.en: he may be lying;  Schrödinger's cat may or may not be in the box
example.ja: :彼は嘘をついているかもしれない、シュレーディンガーの猫は箱の中にいようが、そうでないかもしれない。

definitions.definitionEn: (subjunctive present, defective) Expressing a wish (with present subjunctive effect).

example.en: may you win;  may the weather be sunny
example.ja: あなたが勝利を得られるように。

definitions.definitionEn: Used in modesty, courtesy, or concession, or to soften a question or remark.
The hawthorn bush or its blossoms.
To gather may, or flowers in general.
To celebrate May Day.
A maiden.
(abstract) This place; this location.

example.en: An Alzheimer patient's here may in his mind be anywhere he called home in the time he presently re-lives.
example.ja: アルツハイマー患者はここで、現在再生している時代に自宅に電話を受けた場所がどこにでもあるかもしれない。

definitions.definitionEn: (abstract) This time, the present situation.
Filler after a noun or demonstrative pronoun, solely for emphasis.

example.en: John here is a rascal.
example.ja: ジョンはラスカルだ

definitions.definitionEn: Filler after a demonstrative pronoun but before the noun it modifies, solely for emphasis.

example.en: This here orange is too sour.
example.ja: このオレンジは、酸すぎる。

definitions.definitionEn: (location) In, on, or at this place.

example.en: Flu season is here.
example.ja: インフルエンザの季節はここです。

definitions.definitionEn: (location) To this place; used in place of the more dated hither.

example.en: Please come here.
example.ja: どうぞこちらへおいで下さい。

definitions.definitionEn: (abstract) In this context.

example.en: Derivatives can refer to anything that is derived from something else, but here they refer specifically to functions that give the slope of the tangent line to a curve.
example.ja: ここでは、タンジェント線の傾きを曲線に付ける関数を参照しています。これは、曲線の傾きです。

definitions.definitionEn: At this point in the argument, narration, or other, usually written, work.

example.en: Here endeth the lesson.
example.ja: ここから教訓が得られます。

definitions.definitionEn: Used semi-assertively to offer something to the listener.

example.en: Here, now I'm giving it to you.
example.ja: ほら、今、君にあげる。

definitions.definitionEn: Used for emphasis at the beginning of a sentence when expressing an opinion or want.

example.en: Here, I'm tired and I want a drink.
example.ja: 疲れてるから飲んでくる

definitions.definitionEn: A multitude; a great aggregate; a mass of people; the generality; the common herd.

example.en: Democracy must balance the rights of the few against the will of the many.
example.ja: 民主主義は、多数派の意思に反して、少数派の権利の均衡を図なければならない。

definitions.definitionEn: A considerable number.
A large number of; numerous.
An indefinite large number of people or things.

example.en: Many are called, but few are chosen.
example.ja: 多くの人が召されますが、選ばれた人はほとんどいません。

definitions.definitionEn: Something being indicated that is similar to something else.
A person, a thing, people or things like the one or ones already mentioned.
Final, ultimate, coming after all others of its kind.

example.en: “Eyes Wide Shut” was the last film to be directed by Stanley Kubrick.
example.ja: 「EYEE Watch Store」はスタンリー・クブリックが指さす最後の映画である。

definitions.definitionEn: Most recent, latest, last so far.

example.en: I have received your note dated the 17th last, and am responding to say that [...]
example.ja: 17日時点のあなたのメモを受け取りました。。.. ...

definitions.definitionEn: Farthest of all from a given quality, character, or condition; most unlikely, or least preferable.

example.en: He is the last person to be accused of theft.
example.ja: 窃盗で起訴された最後の人物だ

definitions.definitionEn: Being the only one remaining of its class.

example.en: Japan is the last empire.
example.ja: 日本は最後の帝国である。

definitions.definitionEn: Supreme; highest in degree; utmost.
Lowest in rank or degree.

example.en: the last prize
example.ja: 最後の賞

definitions.definitionEn: Most recently.

example.en: When we last met, he was based in Toronto.
example.ja: 最後に会った時彼はトロントを拠点にした

definitions.definitionEn: (sequence) after everything else; finally

example.en: I'll go last.
example.ja: 最後だ

definitions.definitionEn: To perform, carry out.
To endure, continue over time.

example.en: Summer seems to last longer each year.
example.ja: 夏は毎年長く続くようです。

definitions.definitionEn: To hold out, continue undefeated or entire.

example.en: I don't know how much longer we can last without reinforcements.
example.ja: 援軍なしでは長くは生きられない

definitions.definitionEn: A tool for shaping or preserving the shape of shoes.
To shape with a last; to fasten or fit to a last; to place smoothly on a last.

example.en: to last a boot
example.ja: ブートを終了する

definitions.definitionEn: A burden; load; a cargo; freight.
A measure of weight or quantity, varying in designation depending on the goods concerned.
An old English (and Dutch) measure of the carrying capacity of a ship, equal to two tons.
A load of some commodity with reference to its weight and commercial value.
A person who has not yet reached adulthood, whether natural (puberty), cultural (initiation), or legal (majority)

example.en: Go easy on him: he is but a child.
example.ja: 楽にしてやりなさい子供よ

definitions.definitionEn: (specifically) A female child, a girl.
(with possessive) One's direct descendant by birth, regardless of age; a son or daughter.

example.en: My youngest child is forty-three this year.
example.ja: 一番下の子は今年四十三歳。

definitions.definitionEn: The thirteenth Lenormand card.
A figurative offspring, particularly:
A child of noble birth.
The cognomen given to the oldest son prior to his taking his father's title.
To give birth; to beget or procreate.

A reflexive, often habitual behavior, especially one occurring in a context that often features attempts at deception by persons under psychological stress (such as a poker game or police interrogation), that reveals information that the person exhibiting the behavior is attempting to withhold.
That which is told; a tale or account.
A private message to an individual in a chat room; a whisper.
(archaic outside of idioms) To count, reckon, or enumerate.

example.en: All told, there were over a dozen.  Can you tell time on a clock?  He had untold wealth.
example.ja: 全部で12人超えました時計に時を告げられますか?

definitions.definitionEn: To narrate.

example.en: I want to tell a story;  I want to tell you a story.
example.ja: 私は物語を語りたい。

definitions.definitionEn: To convey by speech; to say.

example.en: Finally, someone told him the truth.  He seems to like to tell lies.
example.ja: 結局、だれかが真実を語ったのです。

definitions.definitionEn: To instruct or inform.

example.en: Please tell me how to do it.
example.ja: やり方を教えてください。

definitions.definitionEn: To order; to direct, to say to someone.

example.en: Tell him to go away.
example.ja: 消えろと言え

definitions.definitionEn: To discern, notice, identify or distinguish.

example.en: Can you tell whether those flowers are real or silk, from this distance?  No, there's no way to tell.
example.ja: この距離からあの花は本物か絹かわかるか?

definitions.definitionEn: To reveal.

example.en: Time will tell what became of him.
example.ja: 時がたつにつれて、イエスがどうなったかが明らかになります。

definitions.definitionEn: To be revealed.
To have an effect, especially a noticeable one; to be apparent, to be demonstrated.

example.en: Sir Gerald was moving slower; his wounds were beginning to tell.
example.ja: ジェラルド卿はゆっくりと動き、傷をつき始めていました。

definitions.definitionEn: To use (beads or similar objects) as an aid to prayer.
To inform someone in authority about a wrongdoing.

example.en: I saw you steal those sweets! I'm going to tell!
