example.ja: お前とは違うヤレド薬が喋ってる

definitions.definitionEn: A conversation or discussion; usually serious, but informal.

example.en: We need to have a talk about your homework.
example.ja: あなたの宿題について話したいんだけど

definitions.definitionEn: A lecture.

example.en: There is a talk on Shakespeare tonight.
example.ja: 今夜のシェイクスピアのトークが

definitions.definitionEn: Gossip; rumour.

example.en: There's been talk lately about the two of them.
example.ja: 最近二人の噂が

definitions.definitionEn: (preceded by the; often qualified by a following of) A major topic of social discussion.

example.en: She is the talk of the day.
example.ja: 彼女は本日のトークです。

definitions.definitionEn: (preceded by the) A customary conversation by parent(s) or guardian(s) with their (often teenaged) child about a reality of life; in particular:
(not preceded by an article) Empty boasting, promises or claims.

example.en: The party leader's speech was all talk.
example.ja: 政党党首の演説は、すべて演説であった。

definitions.definitionEn: (usually plural) Meeting to discuss a particular matter.

example.en: The leaders of the G8 nations are currently in talks over nuclear weapons.
example.ja: G8諸国の指導者は、現在、核兵器について議論している。

definitions.definitionEn: An object whose nature is yet to be defined.
An object whose name is forgotten by, unknown or unimportant to the user, e.g., from words of a song. Also used to refer to an object earlier indefinitely referred to as 'something' (pronoun sense).
Applied to an action whose name is forgotten by, unknown or unimportant to the user, e.g. from words of a song.
Having a characteristic that the speaker cannot specify.
(degree) Somewhat; to a degree.

example.en: The baby looks something like his father.
example.ja: 赤ちゃんは父親に似てる

definitions.definitionEn: (degree) To a high degree.
An uncertain or unspecified thing; one thing.

example.en: I have a feeling something good is going to happen today.
example.ja: 今日何かいい事が起きるような気がします

definitions.definitionEn: (of someone or something) A quality to a moderate degree.

example.en: That child is something of a genius.
example.ja: その子は天才だ

definitions.definitionEn: (of a person) A talent or quality that is difficult to specify.

example.en: She has a certain something.
example.ja: 彼女は何かを持っている

definitions.definitionEn: (often with really or quite) Somebody who or something that is superlative or notable in some way.

example.en:
- Some marmosets are less than six inches tall.
- Well, isn't that something?
example.ja: 身長は6インチ以下もある

meaning: 《副詞[句]を伴って》(ある場所・位置に)…を置く,載せる,すえる,付ける / 《状態を表す副詞[句]を伴って》(ある状態に)…を置く,する;〈人・動物〉に(…)させる / (仕事・任務などに)〈人・動物〉を向ける,つける;(用途・目的などに)〈物事〉を向ける,用いる《+名+to+名》 / (苦痛・試練などを)〈人〉に受けさせる《+名〈人〉+to+名》 / (人・物に)〈税・負担など〉を課す,負わせる《+名+on+名(a person's doinn)》 / (人・事に)〈責任など〉をかぶせる,負わせる《+名+on(upon)+名》;(責任などを)〈人・事〉にかぶせる《+名+to+名》 / (物事に)〈解釈・価値など〉を与える,(物に)〈価格など〉を付ける《+名+on(upon)+名》 / …を評価する,見積もる,みなす / (…に)〈考えなど〉を表現する,述べる《+名+into+名》;〈文字・印など〉を書き付ける,記入する《+名+on+名》 / (…に)…を翻訳する《+名+into+名》 / (…に)〈問題・質問など〉を提出する,提起する《+名+to(before)+名》 / (物事に)〈終止・制限など〉を与える《+名+to+名》 / 〈船などが〉進む,行く,向かう / 《話》急いで立ち去る;逃げ出す / (砲丸などの)投げ,投てき;投てき距離 / 突き,押し / 落ち着いた,動かないで

definitions.definitionEn: A right to sell something at a predetermined price.
A contract to sell a security at a set price on or before a certain date.

example.en: He bought a January '08 put for Procter and Gamble at 80 to hedge his bet.
example.ja: 2008年1月プロクターとギャンブルを80年に買った

definitions.definitionEn: The act of putting; an action; a movement; a thrust; a push.

example.en: the put of a ball
example.ja: ボールのパット

definitions.definitionEn: An old card game.
To place something somewhere.

example.en: She put her books on the table.
example.ja: 彼女は本をテーブルに載せました。

definitions.definitionEn: To bring or set into a certain relation, state or condition.

example.en: He is putting all his energy into this one task.
example.ja: 彼は全てのエネルギーをこの1つのタスクに投入している

definitions.definitionEn: To exercise a put option.

example.en: He got out of his Procter and Gamble bet by putting his shares at 80.
example.ja: プロクターとギャンブルの賭けから 80年に株を提出した

definitions.definitionEn: To express something in a certain manner.

example.en: When you put it that way, I guess I can see your point.
example.ja: そういう風に言えば、その意味が分かると思う。

definitions.definitionEn: To throw a heavy iron ball, as a sport. (See shot put. Do not confuse with putt.)
To steer; to direct one's course; to go.
To play a card or a hand in the game called put.
To attach or attribute; to assign.

example.en: to put a wrong construction on an act or expression
example.ja: 行動や表現の上に誤った構造物を置く

definitions.definitionEn: To lay down; to give up; to surrender.
To set before one for judgment, acceptance, or rejection; to bring to the attention.

example.en: to put a question; to put a case
example.ja: )を問わず、事件を提起する。

definitions.definitionEn: To incite; to entice; to urge; to constrain; to oblige.
To convey coal in the mine, as for example from the working to the tramway.
An idiot; a foolish person; a duffer.
A prostitute.
An additional one of the same kind.

example.en: There is one sterling and here is another
example.ja: 此処には、一条の罰金と、又は此処に、一段の罰金を科す。

definitions.definitionEn: One that is different from the current one.

example.en: I saw one movie, but I think I will see another.
example.ja: 映画も見たけど別の映画も観る

definitions.definitionEn: One of a group of things of the same kind.

example.en: His interests keep shifting from one thing to another.
example.ja: 神の関心事は一つのものから別のものへと絶えず変化してゆきます。

definitions.definitionEn: To arrive, come (to a place).
To come about; happen; come into being; arise.

example.en: It hath becomen so that many a man had to sterve.
example.ja: それは多くの人が耐え忍ばねばならないほどのものになっています。

definitions.definitionEn: Begin to be; turn into.

example.en: She became a doctor when she was 25.
example.ja: 彼女は25歳で医者になった。

definitions.definitionEn: To be proper for; to beseem.
Of an adornment, piece of clothing etc.: to look attractive on (someone).

example.en: That dress really becomes you.
example.ja: そのドレスは本当にあなたになる

definitions.definitionEn: The price paid for obtaining, or price received for providing, money or goods in a credit transaction, calculated as a fraction of the amount or value of what was borrowed.

example.en: Our bank offers borrowers an annual interest of 5%.
example.ja: 当該銀行は、毎年5%の貸付け金を提供しています。

definitions.definitionEn: Any excess over and above an exact equivalent
A great attention and concern from someone or something; intellectual curiosity.

example.en: He has a lot of interest in vintage cars.
example.ja: 彼はヴィンテージ自動車に興味があります。

definitions.definitionEn: Attention that is given to or received from someone or something.
An involvement, claim, right, share, stake in or link with a financial, business, or other undertaking or endeavor.

example.en: I have business interests in South Africa.
example.ja: 南アフリカでビジネスの利害がある。

definitions.definitionEn: Something or someone one is interested in.

example.en: Lexicography is one of my interests.
example.ja: リクショナリズムは私の興味の1つだ

definitions.definitionEn: Condition or quality of exciting concern or being of importance
Injury, or compensation for injury; damages.
(usually in the plural) The persons interested in any particular business or measure, taken collectively.

example.en: the iron interest;  the cotton interest
example.ja: 鉄の利子; 綿の利息

definitions.definitionEn: To engage the attention of; to awaken interest in; to excite emotion or passion in, in behalf of a person or thing.

example.en: Action films don't really interest me.
example.ja: アクション映画はあまり興味ない

definitions.definitionEn: To be concerned with or engaged in; to affect; to concern; to excite.
To cause or permit to share.
(chiefly British) An area of land; a district, region.

A set region of land having particular human occupation or agreed limits, especially inhabited by members of the same race, speakers of the same language etc., or associated with a given person, occupation, species etc.
The territory of a nation, especially an independent nation state or formerly independent nation; a political entity asserting ultimate authority over a geographical area; a sovereign state.
(usually preceded by “the”) A rural area, as opposed to a town or city; the countryside.
The rock through which a vein runs.
The female genitalia, especially the vagina.
From or in the countryside or connected with it.
Of or connected to country music.
A style of popular music that originated in the folk music of the rural population of the southern and western United States and characterized by string-band instruments and simple melodies.
(with the, invariable plural only) People who are old; old beings; the older generation, taken as a group.

example.en: A civilised society should always look after the old in the community.
example.ja: 文明社会は、常に地域社会の老齢層の世話をしなければならない。

definitions.definitionEn: (in combination) One of a specified age.

example.en: when he was an eight-year-old ; a 62-year-old should
example.ja: (2018年10月18日). http://www.oricon.co.jp/news/new/2017/2018/ 2018年8月28日閲覧. ^ """"8歳だったとき、六十六歳".

definitions.definitionEn: A person older than oneself, especially an adult in relation to a teenager.
(most often plural) One's parents.

example.en: I had to sneak out to meet my girlfriend and tell the olds I was going to the library.
example.ja: ガールフレンドに会いに行って図書館に行くと云った

definitions.definitionEn: Of an object, concept, relationship, etc., having existed for a relatively long period of time.

example.en: an old abandoned building;  an old friend
example.ja: 古い建物、旧来の友,

definitions.definitionEn: Having been used and thus no longer new or unused.

example.en: I find that an old toothbrush is good to clean the keyboard with.
example.ja: 古い歯ブラシはキーボードできれいにするのがよいことが分かりました。

definitions.definitionEn: Having existed or lived for the specified time.

example.en: How old are they? She’s five years old and he's seven. We also have a young teen and a two-year-old child.
example.ja: 2018年12月22日閲覧. ^ a b c d e f g h i j k l m c d a b "". キャラ誕。

definitions.definitionEn: (heading) Of an earlier time.
Tiresome after prolonged repetition.

example.en: Your constant pestering is getting old.
example.ja: 君の常習的な害虫は年をとってる

definitions.definitionEn: Said of subdued colors, particularly reds, pinks and oranges, as if they had faded over time.
A grammatical intensifier, often used in describing something positive. (Mostly in idioms like good old, big old and little old, any old and some old.)

example.en: We're having a good old time. My next car will be a big old SUV.  My wife makes the best little old apple pie in Texas.
example.ja: 次の車は古いSUVだ妻はテキサスで最高のアップルパイを作る

definitions.definitionEn: Excessive, abundant.
(operations) An individual item: the least quantitative unit in a grouping.
For one; apiece; per.

example.en: The apples cost 50 cents each.
example.ja: リンゴ 1 個につき 50 セント ( 約 2 万円 ) の費用がかかりました。

definitions.definitionEn: Every one; every thing.

example.en: From each according to his ability, to each according to his needs.
example.ja: 各人の能力に応じて、各人の必要に応じたものを与えなさい。

example: I walk to school with my sister.
exampleJa: 私は姉と歩いて学校に行きます。

definitions.definitionEn: (collective) A group of fish or a group of marine mammals such as porpoises, dolphins, or whales.

example.en: The divers encountered a huge school of mackerel.
example.ja: 私は姉と歩いて学校に行きます。

definitions.definitionEn: A multitude.
(of fish) To form into, or travel in a school.
An institution dedicated to teaching and learning; an educational institution.

example.en: Harvard University is a famous American postsecondary school.
example.ja: 私は姉と歩いて学校に行きます。

definitions.definitionEn: An educational institution providing primary and secondary education, prior to tertiary education (college or university).
At Eton College, a period or session of teaching.

example.en: Divinity, history and geography are studied for two schools per week.
example.ja: 私は姉と歩いて学校に行きます。

definitions.definitionEn: Within a larger educational institution, an organizational unit, such as a department or institute, which is dedicated to a specific subject area.

example.en: We are enrolled in the same university, but I attend the School of Economics and my brother is in the School of Music.
example.ja: 私は姉と歩いて学校に行きます。

definitions.definitionEn: An art movement, a community of artists.

example.en: The Barbizon school of painters were part of an art movement towards Realism in art, which arose in the context of the dominant Romantic Movement of the time.
example.ja: 私は姉と歩いて学校に行きます。

definitions.definitionEn: (considered collectively) The followers of a particular doctrine; a particular way of thinking or particular doctrine; a school of thought.

example.en: These economists belong to the monetarist school.
example.ja: 私は姉と歩いて学校に行きます。

definitions.definitionEn: The time during which classes are attended or in session in an educational institution.

example.en: I'll see you after school.
example.ja: 私は姉と歩いて学校に行きます。

definitions.definitionEn: The room or hall in English universities where the examinations for degrees and honours are held.
The canons, precepts, or body of opinion or practice, sanctioned by the authority of a particular class or age.

example.en: He was a gentleman of the old school.
example.ja: 私は姉と歩いて学校に行きます。

definitions.definitionEn: An establishment offering specialized instruction, as for driving, cooking, typing, coding, etc.
To educate, teach, or train (often, but not necessarily, in a school).

example.en: Many future prime ministers were schooled in Eton.
example.ja: 私は姉と歩いて学校に行きます。

definitions.definitionEn: To defeat emphatically, to teach an opponent a harsh lesson.
To control, or compose, one's expression.

example.en: She took care to school her expression, not giving away any of her feelings.
example.ja: 私は姉と歩いて学校に行きます。

definitions.definitionEn: A shift (scheduled work period) that takes place late in the day or at night.
Near the end of a period of time.

example.en: It was late in the evening when we finally arrived.
example.ja: 私たちがやっと到着したのは、夕方遅くのことでした。

definitions.definitionEn: Specifically, near the end of the day.

example.en: It was getting late and I was tired.
example.ja: 遅くなって、私は疲れた。

definitions.definitionEn: (usually not comparable) Associated with the end of a period.

example.en: Late Latin is less fully inflected than classical Latin.
example.ja: 故ラテン文字は古典的なラテン語より完全に伝染しない。

definitions.definitionEn: Not arriving until after an expected time.

example.en: Even though we drove as fast as we could, we were still late.
example.ja: 私たちはできるだけ速く車を運転しましたが、それでも遅れませんでした。

definitions.definitionEn: Not having had an expected menstrual period.

example.en: I'm late, honey. Could you buy a test?
example.ja: 遅刻だテストを頼むよ

definitions.definitionEn: Deceased, dead: used particularly when speaking of the dead person's actions while alive. (Often used with "the"; see usage notes.)

example.en: Her late husband had left her well provided for.
example.ja: 彼女の亡き夫は、十分な食物を残しておきました。

definitions.definitionEn: Existing or holding some position not long ago, but not now; departed, or gone out of office.

example.en: the late administration
example.ja: 故の行政

definitions.definitionEn: Recent — relative to the noun it modifies.
Of a star or class of stars, cooler than the sun.
After a deadline has passed, past a designated time.

example.en: We drove as fast as we could, but we still arrived late.
example.ja: 私たちはできるだけ速く車を運転しましたが、それでも遅刻しませんでした。

definitions.definitionEn: Formerly, especially in the context of service in a military unit.

example.en: Colonel Easterwood, late of the 34th Carbines, was a guest at the dinner party.
example.ja: 34番目のカービネスの後半のイースターウッド大佐は、ディナーパーティーのゲストであった。

definitions.definitionEn: Not long ago; just now.
A high point or position, literally or figuratively; an elevated place; a superior region; a height; the sky; heaven.
A point of success or achievement; a time when things are at their best.

example.en: It was one of the highs of his career.
example.ja: それは彼の経歴の中でも高い地位を占めていました。

definitions.definitionEn: A period of euphoria, from excitement or from an intake of drugs.

example.en: That pill gave me a high for a few hours, before I had a comedown.
example.ja: その薬は数時間の間、私に高圧を与えてくれましたが、私は投下されました。

definitions.definitionEn: A drug that gives such a high.
A large area of elevated atmospheric pressure; an anticyclone.

example.en: A large high is centred on the Azores.
example.ja: アゾレス山脈を中心とした大きな山があります。

definitions.definitionEn: The maximum value attained by some quantity within a specified period.

example.en: Inflation reached a ten-year high.
example.ja: インフレは10年ぶりの高値に達した。

definitions.definitionEn: The maximum atmospheric temperature recorded at a particular location, especially during one 24-hour period.

example.en: Today's high was 32°C.
example.ja: 今日高かったのは32°Cだった。

definitions.definitionEn: The highest card dealt or drawn.
To rise.

example.en: The sun higheth.
example.ja: 陽は高く,

definitions.definitionEn: Very elevated; extending or being far above a base; tall; lofty.

example.en: The balloon rose high in the sky.   The wall was high.   a high mountain
example.ja: 風船が空高く昇って、壁は高くて、高い山でした。

definitions.definitionEn: Relatively elevated; rising or raised above the average or normal level from which elevation is measured.
Having a specified elevation or height; tall.

example.en: three feet high   three Mount Everests high
example.ja: 高さ 3 メートル 3 メートルエベレスト山

definitions.definitionEn: Elevated in status, esteem, prestige; exalted in rank, station, or character.

example.en: The oldest of the elves' royal family still conversed in High Elvish.
example.ja: エルフ家の最古の王族は、まだハイエルフで会話している。

definitions.definitionEn: Of great importance and consequence: grave (if negative) or solemn (if positive).

example.en: high crimes, the high festival of the sun
example.ja: 大犯罪、太陽の盛大な祭。

definitions.definitionEn: Consummate; advanced (e.g. in development) to the utmost extent or culmination, or possessing a quality in its supreme degree, at its zenith.

example.en: high (i.e. intense) heat; high (i.e. full or quite) noon; high (i.e. rich or spicy) seasoning; high (i.e. complete) pleasure; high (i.e. deep or vivid) colour; high (i.e. extensive, thorough) scholarship; high tide; high [tourism] season; the High Middle Ages
example.ja: 高熱、真昼、高熱、高温、高潮、高風、上流風、高波、高音、高瀬、高川、高流、高気、高海、高山、高泉、大潮、潮の季節、大盛、中季。

definitions.definitionEn: (in several set phrases) Remote in distance or time.

example.en: high latitude, high antiquity
example.ja: 高緯度、高い古さ

definitions.definitionEn: (in several set phrases) Very traditionalist and conservative, especially in favoring older ways of doing things; see e.g. high church, High Tory.
Elevated in mood; marked by great merriment, excitement, etc.

example.en: in high spirits
example.ja: 高き霊にて

definitions.definitionEn: (of a lifestyle) Luxurious; rich.

example.en: high living, the high life
example.ja: 高い生活、高い生活,

definitions.definitionEn: Lofty, often to the point of arrogant, haughty, boastful, proud.

example.en: a high tone
example.ja: 高音

definitions.definitionEn: (with "on" or "about") Keen, enthused.
(of a body of water) With tall waves.
Large, great (in amount or quantity, value, force, energy, etc).

example.en: My bank charges me a high interest rate.   I was running a high temperature and had high cholesterol.   high voltage   high prices   high winds   a high number
example.ja: 私の銀行は高い金利を請求し、私は高熱を出しており、コレステロール値は高くなっていました。

definitions.definitionEn: (acoustics) Acute or shrill in pitch, due to being of greater frequency, i.e. produced by more rapid vibrations (wave oscillations).

example.en: The note was too high for her to sing.
example.ja: その音は高すぎるので歌えませんでした。

definitions.definitionEn: Made with some part of the tongue positioned high in the mouth, relatively close to the palate.
Greater in value than other cards, denominations, suits, etc.
(of meat, especially venison) Strong-scented; slightly tainted/spoiled; beginning to decompose.

example.en: Epicures do not cook game before it is high.
example.ja: エピクレスはハイになる前にゲームを作っていない。

definitions.definitionEn: Intoxicated; under the influence of a mood-altering drug, formerly usually alcohol, but now (from the mid-20th century) usually not alcohol but rather marijuana, cocaine, heroin, etc.
(of a sailing ship) Near, in its direction of travel, to the (direction of the) wind.
In or to an elevated position.

example.en: How high above land did you fly?
example.ja: 地上の高度は?

definitions.definitionEn: In or at a great value.

example.en: Costs have grown higher this year again.
example.ja: 今年もまた費用がかさむようになった。

definitions.definitionEn: At a pitch of great frequency.

example.en: I certainly can't sing that high.
example.ja: そんな高い歌は歌えない

definitions.definitionEn: Thought; intention; determination; purpose.
To hie; to hasten.
The different ideal.
Not the same; exhibiting a difference.
Various, assorted, diverse.
Distinct, separate; used for emphasis after numbers and other determiners of quantity.

example.en: Several different scientists all reached this conclusion at about the same time.
example.ja: 幾人かの異なった科学者が皆、ほぼ同じ時にこの結論に達しました。

definitions.definitionEn: Unlike most others; unusual.
Differently.
(usually in phrases such as 'from the off', 'at the off', etc.) Beginning; starting point.

example.en: He has been very obviously an untrustworthy narrator right from the off.
example.ja: 彼は明らかに、遠く離れた所では信頼できない弁論家でした。

definitions.definitionEn: To kill.

example.en: He got in the way so I had him offed.
example.ja: 彼は邪魔をしただから彼を外した

definitions.definitionEn: To switch off.

example.en: Can you off the light?
example.ja: 明かりを消せるか?

definitions.definitionEn: Inoperative, disabled.

example.en: All the lights are off.
example.ja: すべてのライトはオフです。

definitions.definitionEn: Cancelled; not happening.

example.en: The party's off because the hostess is sick.
example.ja: 院長が病気だからパーティーは休みだ

definitions.definitionEn: Not fitted; not being worn.

example.en: The drink spilled out of the bottle because the top was off.
example.ja: ボトルから飲み物が流出した。上がオフだから。

definitions.definitionEn: Rancid, rotten, gone bad.

example.en: This milk is off!
example.ja: この牛乳は脱いだ!

definitions.definitionEn: Less than normal, in temperament or in result.

example.en: sales are off this quarter
example.ja: 売上はこの四半期から

definitions.definitionEn: Inappropriate; untoward.

example.en: I felt that his comments were a bit off.
example.ja: 私は、その人の言葉が少し気に入っていませんでした。

definitions.definitionEn: (in phrases such as 'well off', 'better off', 'poorly off') Circumstanced.
Started on the way.

example.en: And they're off! Whatsmyname takes an early lead, with Remember The Mane behind by a nose.
example.ja: "何の名前が早めに先行して,"The Mane"を鼻で後ろに置いている。

definitions.definitionEn: Far; off to the side.

example.en: He took me down the corridor and into an off room.
example.ja: 私は廊下を降り、部屋の外に連れて行かれました。

definitions.definitionEn: Designating a time when one is not strictly attentive to business or affairs, or is absent from a post, and, hence, a time when affairs are not urgent.

example.en: He took an off day for fishing.  an off year in politics; the off season
example.ja: イエスは漁をするために休みを取り、政治における一年の休み、季節の休みを取った

definitions.definitionEn: (in phrases such as 'off day') Designating a time when one is not performing to the best of one's abilities.
(of a dish on a menu) Presently unavailable.

example.en: — I'll have the chicken please.
example.ja: - チキンを

definitions.definitionEn: (in relation to a vehicle) On the side furthest from the kerb (the right-hand side if one drives on the left).

example.en: The off front wheel came loose.
example.ja: 前輪が緩んだ。

definitions.definitionEn: In, or towards the half of the field away from the batsman's legs; the right side for a right-handed batsman.
In a direction away from the speaker or object.

example.en: He drove off in a cloud of smoke.
example.ja: 彼は煙の雲の中で走り去った。

definitions.definitionEn: Into a state of non-operation or non-existence.

example.en: Please switch off the light when you leave.
example.ja: ライトを消してください

definitions.definitionEn: So as to remove or separate, or be removed or separated.

example.en: He bit off the end of the carrot.
example.ja: ニンジンの端を噛んだ。

definitions.definitionEn: Used in various other ways specific to individual idiomatic phrases, e.g. bring off, show off, put off, tell off, etc. See the entry for the individual phrase.
Not positioned upon; away from a position upon.

example.en: He's off the roof now.
example.ja: 彼は今屋根の外にいます。

definitions.definitionEn: Detached, separated, excluded or disconnected from; away from a position of attachment or connection to.

example.en: He was thrown off the team for cheating.
example.ja: 不正行為でチームから放り出された

definitions.definitionEn: Used to indicate the location or direction of one thing relative to another, implying adjacency or accessibility via.

example.en: His office is off this corridor on the right.
example.ja: 彼のオフィスは右側の廊下から外れてる

definitions.definitionEn: Used to express location at sea relative to land or mainland.

example.en: The island is 23 miles off the cape.
example.ja: 島はマントから23マイル

definitions.definitionEn: Removed or subtracted from.

example.en: There's 20% off the list price.
example.ja: 20%は手数料だ

definitions.definitionEn: No longer wanting or taking.

example.en: He's been off his feed since Tuesday.
example.ja: 火曜日から食事を休んでる

definitions.definitionEn: (more properly 'from') Out of the possession of.

example.en: He didn't buy it off him. He stole it off him.
example.ja: 盗んだんじゃない

definitions.definitionEn: Placed after a number (of products or parts, as if a unit), in commerce or engineering.

example.en: I'd like to re-order those printer cartridges, let's say 5-off.
example.ja: 印刷用カートリッジを順序変更したい

definitions.definitionEn: The one that follows after this one.

example.en: Next, please, don't hold up the queue!
example.ja: 次はキューを押さえないで!

definitions.definitionEn: Nearest in place or position, having nothing similar intervening; adjoining.
Nearest in order, succession, or rank; immediately following (or sometimes preceding) in order.

example.en: the next chapter; the next man I see; the next week; the Sunday next before Easter
example.ja: 次の章、次の人の見たところ; 次の週、復活祭前の日曜日

definitions.definitionEn: Following in a hypothetical sequence of some kind.

example.en: The man was driven by his love for money and his desire to become the next Bill Gates.
example.ja: 彼は金への愛と、次のビル・ゲイツになりたいという欲望に駆り立てられた。

definitions.definitionEn: Nearest in relationship. (See also next of kin.)
In a time, place, rank or sequence closest or following.

example.en: It's the next best thing to ice cream.
example.ja: アイスクリームに最適だ

definitions.definitionEn: On the first subsequent occasion.

example.en: Financial panic, earthquakes, oil spills, riots. What comes next?
example.ja: 次に何が起きるのでしょうか。

definitions.definitionEn: On the side of; nearest or adjacent to; next to.
The terminal point of something in space or time.

example.en: At the end of the road, turn left.
example.ja: 道の果てで左折。

definitions.definitionEn: (by extension) The cessation of an effort, activity, state, or motion.

example.en: Is there no end to this madness?
example.ja: この狂気に終わりはないのですか。

definitions.definitionEn: (by extension) Death.

example.en: He met a terrible end in the jungle.
example.ja: ジャングルでひどい最期を迎えた

definitions.definitionEn: The most extreme point of an object, especially one that is longer than it is wide.

example.en: Hold the string at both ends.
example.ja: 両端に文字列を保持します。

definitions.definitionEn: Result.
A purpose, goal, or aim.
One of the two parts of the ground used as a descriptive name for half of the ground.

example.en: The Pavillion End
example.ja: 大患難の終わり

definitions.definitionEn: The position at the end of either the offensive or defensive line, a tight end, a split end, a defensive end.
A period of play in which each team throws eight rocks, two per player, in alternating fashion.
An ideal point of a graph or other complex.
That which is left; a remnant; a fragment; a scrap.

example.en: odds and ends
example.ja: 可能性と終局

definitions.definitionEn: One of the yarns of the worsted warp in a Brussels carpet.
(in the plural) Money.

example.en: Don't give them your ends. You jack that shit!
example.ja: 奴らに終わりを与えるな!

definitions.definitionEn: To come to an end

example.en: Is this movie never going to end?
example.ja: この映画は終わらないの?

definitions.definitionEn: To finish, terminate.

example.en: The referee blew the whistle to end the game.
example.ja: ゲーム終了の笛を吹いた

definitions.definitionEn: To be alive; to have life.

example.en: He's not expected to live for more than a few months.
example.ja: 数か月以上は生きられないと予想されている。

definitions.definitionEn: To have permanent residence somewhere, to inhabit, to reside.

example.en: I live at 2a Acacia Avenue.  He lives in LA, but he's staying here over the summer.
example.ja: アカシア・アカシア通りの2カ所に住んでるが、夏はここに泊まっている。

definitions.definitionEn: To survive; to persevere; to continue.

example.en: Her memory lives in that song.
example.ja: 彼女の記憶はその歌に収まってる

definitions.definitionEn: To cope.

example.en: You'll just have to live with it!  I can't live in a world without you.
example.ja: 君なしでは生きられない

definitions.definitionEn: To pass life in a specified manner.

example.en: It is difficult to live in poverty.   And they lived happily ever after.
example.ja: 貧困にあえいで生活するのは難しいことであり、その後はいつまでも幸福に暮らしました。

definitions.definitionEn: To spend, as one's life; to pass; to maintain; to continue in, constantly or habitually.

example.en: To live an idle or a useful life.
example.ja: 怠け者や有用な生活を送ること。

definitions.definitionEn: To act habitually in conformity with; to practice; to exemplify in one's way of life.
To outlast danger; to float (said of a ship, boat, etc).

example.en: No ship could live in such a storm.
example.ja: そのような嵐の中では船が生きてゆけませんでした。

definitions.definitionEn: (followed by "on" or "upon") To maintain or support one's existence; to provide for oneself; to feed; to subsist.

example.en: It is hard to live on the minimum wage.   They lived on stale bread.
example.ja: 最低賃金で生きていくのは困難だ。

definitions.definitionEn: To make the most of life; to experience a full, rich life.

example.en: I'm sick of spending every day studying at home: I want to go out there and live!
example.ja: 家で勉強する毎日はうんざりだ。外で生きたい!

definitions.definitionEn: Life
(only used attributively) Having life; that is alive.

example.en: The post office will not ship live animals.
example.ja: 郵便局は生きた動物を運ばない

definitions.definitionEn: Being in existence; actual

example.en: He is a live example of the consequences of excessive drinking.
example.ja: イエスは大酒の結果を示す生きた例です。

definitions.definitionEn: Having active properties; being energized.
Operational; in actual use rather than in testing etc.
Taken from a living animal.

example.en: live feathers
example.ja: 生きた羽

definitions.definitionEn: Imparting power; having motion.

example.en: a live, or driving, axle
example.ja: 生きた、もしくは運転する斧

definitions.definitionEn: Still in active play.

example.en: a live ball
example.ja: ライブボール

definitions.definitionEn: Seen or heard from a broadcast, as it happens.

example.en: The station presented a live news program every evening.
example.ja: 駅は毎晩、生ニュースのプログラムを提供していました。

definitions.definitionEn: (of a performance or speech) In person.

example.en: This nightclub has a live band on weekends.
example.ja: このナイトクラブには週末にライブバンドがある

definitions.definitionEn: (entertainment, performing) Recorded in front of an audience and not having been edited after recording.

example.en: a live album
example.ja: ライブアルバム

definitions.definitionEn: Of firearms or explosives, capable of causing harm.

example.en: The air force practices dropping live bombs on the uninhabited island.
example.ja: 空軍は無人島に生爆弾を投下する

definitions.definitionEn: (circuitry) Electrically charged or energized, usually indicating that the item may cause electrocution if touched.

example.en: Use caution when working near live wires.
example.ja: 生きたワイヤーの近くで作業する時には、注意が必要です。

definitions.definitionEn: Being a bet which can be raised by the bettor, usually in reference to a blind or straddle.

example.en: Tommy's blind was live, so he was given the option to raise.
example.ja: トミーのブラインドは生きているだから彼は昇格の選択肢を与えられた

definitions.definitionEn: Featuring humans; not animated, in the phrases “live actors” or “live action”.
Being in a state of ignition; burning.

example.en: a live coal; live embers
example.ja: (そこには完全に)煙(がある)。

definitions.definitionEn: Full of earnestness; active; wide awake; glowing.

example.en: a live man, or orator
example.ja: 生きた人、オラター

definitions.definitionEn: Vivid; bright.
Of an event, as it happens; in real time; direct.

example.en: The concert was broadcast live by radio.
example.ja: コンサートは生放送だった

definitions.definitionEn: Of making a performance or speech, in person.

example.en: He'll be appearing live at the auditorium.
example.ja: 講堂で生中継する

definitions.definitionEn: Reason

example.en: A good article will cover the who, the what, the when, the where, the why and the how.
example.ja: 良い記事は、誰、何、いつ、どこに、なぜ、そして、なぜかをカバーする。

definitions.definitionEn: For what cause, reason, or purpose (interrogative adverb).
For which cause, reason, or purpose (relative adverb).

example.en: That's the reason why I did that.
example.ja: それが私がやった理由だ

definitions.definitionEn: An exclamation used to express indignation, mild surprise, or impatience.
A young heifer.

example: The first group improved, while the second group did not.

definitions.definitionEn: An uncertain duration of time, a period of time.

example.en: He lectured for quite a long while.
example.ja: 彼は随分長く講義をしてきた。

definitions.definitionEn: To pass (time) idly.
To occupy or entertain (someone) in order to let time pass.
To loiter.
Until.
During the same time that.

example.en: He was sleeping while I was singing.
example.ja: 私が歌っている間彼は眠ってた

definitions.definitionEn: Although.

example.en: This case, while interesting, is a bit frustrating.
example.ja: この事件は興味深いが、少しイライラしている。

definitions.definitionEn: Until.

example.en: I'll wait while you've finished painting.
example.ja: 君が絵を描くのを待っている

definitions.definitionEn: As long as.

example.en: While you're at school you may live at home.
example.ja: 学校にいる間には自宅に住めばよい。

definitions.definitionEn: (public policy) Used to denote an individual experiencing racial profiling when performing a seemingly benign activity.

example.en: He was detained for four hours at the store yesterday. His crime? Shopping while black.
example.ja: 昨日店で4時間拘留された彼の犯罪?

definitions.definitionEn: (with "the") Human collective existence; existence in general.

example.en: There will always be lovers, till the world’s end.
example.ja: 世の終わりに至るまで、常に愛する者たちがいます。

definitions.definitionEn: The Universe.
(with "the") The Earth.

example.en: People are dying of starvation all over the world.
example.ja: 世界中の人々が飢餓のために死にかけています。

definitions.definitionEn: A planet, especially one which is inhabited or inhabitable.

example.en: Our mission is to travel the galaxy and find new worlds.
example.ja: 我々の使命は銀河を旅し、新しい世界を見つけること。

definitions.definitionEn: A very large extent of country.
(speculation) A realm, such as planet, containing one or multiple societies of beings, especially intelligent ones.

example.en: the world of Narnia; the Wizarding World of Harry Potter; a zombie world
example.ja: ナルニア国の世界ハリー・ポッターの魔法使いの世界ゾンビの世界

definitions.definitionEn: An individual or group perspective or social setting.

example.en: In the world of boxing, good diet is all-important.
example.ja: ボクシングの世界では、良い食事は万能です。

definitions.definitionEn: The part of an operating system distributed with the kernel, consisting of the shell and other programs.
A subdivision of a game, consisting of a series of stages or levels that usually share a similar environment or theme.

example.en: Have you reached the boss at the end of the ice world?
example.ja: 氷の世界の果てでボスにたどりついたか?

definitions.definitionEn: The twenty-second trump or major arcana card of the tarot.
A great amount.

example.en: Taking a break from work seems to have done her a world of good.
example.ja: 仕事を休みにすることによって、良い世界が実現したようです。

definitions.definitionEn: Age, era
To consider or cause to be considered from a global perspective; to consider as a global whole, rather than making or focussing on national or other distinctions; compare globalise.
To make real; to make worldly.
Any period of seven consecutive days.
A period of seven days beginning with Sunday or Monday.
A period of five days beginning with Monday.
A subdivision of the month into longer periods of work days punctuated by shorter weekend periods of days for markets, rest, or religious observation such as a sabbath.

example.en: A 4-day week consists of Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday.
example.ja: 四日一日は、月曜日、火曜、水曜日、木曜日からなる。

definitions.definitionEn: Seven days after (sometimes before) a specified date.

example.en: I'll see you Thursday week.
example.ja: また木曜に

definitions.definitionEn: Activity for amusement only, especially among the young.

example.en: Children learn through play.
example.ja: 子供は遊びを通して学びます。

definitions.definitionEn: Similar activity in young animals, as they explore their environment and learn new skills.

example.en: This kind of play helps the young lion cubs develop their hunting skills.
example.ja: この種の遊びは、幼いライオンの子供たちが狩猟の技術を身に着けるのに役立ちます。

definitions.definitionEn: The conduct, or course, of a game.

example.en: After the rain break, play resumed at 3 o'clock.
example.ja: 雨が降ってから3時頃にプレイ再開。

definitions.definitionEn: An individual's performance in a sport or game.

example.en: His play has improved a lot this season.
example.ja: 彼は今季は多くの改善を遂げた。

definitions.definitionEn: A short sequence of action within a game.

example.en: That was a great play by the Mudchester Rovers forward.
example.ja: 2020年3月5日閲覧. ^ a b c d e f g h i j k h i "Madchester Roots".

definitions.definitionEn: (turn-based games) An action carried out when it is one's turn to play.
A literary composition, intended to be represented by actors impersonating the characters and speaking the dialogue.

example.en: This book contains all of Shakespeare's plays.
example.ja: この本にはシェイクスピアの戯曲が全部載っている。

definitions.definitionEn: A theatrical performance featuring actors.

example.en: We saw a two-act play in the theatre.
example.ja: 劇場で2回の劇を見た。

definitions.definitionEn: A major move by a business or investor.

example.en: ABC Widgets makes a play in the bicycle market with its bid to take over Acme Sprockets.
example.ja: ABC ウィジェットスは自転車市場でアカム・スプロックスを乗っ取ろうとする演奏をする。

definitions.definitionEn: A geological formation that contains an accumulation or prospect of hydrocarbons or other resources.
The extent to which a part of a mechanism can move freely.

example.en: No wonder the fanbelt is slipping: there’s too much play in it.
example.ja: ファンベルが滑り落ちているのも不思議ではありません。

definitions.definitionEn: Sexual activity or sexual role-playing.
An instance of watching or listening to digital media.
A button that, when pressed, causes media to be played.
(now usually in compounds) Activity relating to martial combat or fighting.
To act in a manner such that one has fun; to engage in activities expressly for the purpose of recreation or entertainment.

example.en: They played long and hard.
example.ja: 長く懸命に演奏した

definitions.definitionEn: To perform in (a sport); to participate in (a game).

example.en: He plays on three teams
example.ja: 彼は3つのチームでプレイします

definitions.definitionEn: To take part in amorous activity; to make love.
To act as the indicated role, especially in a performance.

example.en: He plays the King, and she's the Queen.
example.ja: 彼は王を演じて、彼女は女王である。

definitions.definitionEn: (heading) To produce music or theatre.
(heading) To behave in a particular way.
To move in any manner; especially, to move regularly with alternate or reciprocating motion; to operate.

example.en: He played the torch beam around the room.
example.ja: 部屋のまわりでトーチビームを弾いた。

definitions.definitionEn: To move to and fro.
To put in action or motion.

example.en: to play a trump in a card game
example.ja: カードゲームで虚構をプレイします

definitions.definitionEn: To keep in play, as a hooked fish in order to land it.
To manipulate, deceive, or swindle someone.

example.en: You played me!
example.ja: 俺を騙したな!

definitions.definitionEn: Power, strength, force or influence held by a person or group.
Physical strength or force.

example.en: He pushed with all his might, but still it would not move.
example.ja: 彼の全力で押えたが、それでも動かない。

definitions.definitionEn: The ability to do something.
Mighty; powerful.
Possible.
To be strong; to have power (over).
(auxiliary) To be able; can.
To be able to go.
(modal auxiliary verb, defective) To have permission to, be allowed. Used in granting permission and in questions to make polite requests.

example.en: you may smoke outside;  may I sit there?
example.ja: 外でたばこを吸ってもいいでしょう。

definitions.definitionEn: (modal auxiliary verb, defective) Expressing a present possibility; possibly.

example.en: he may be lying;  Schrödinger's cat may or may not be in the box
example.ja: :彼は嘘をついているかもしれない、シュレーディンガーの猫は箱の中にいようが、そうでないかもしれない。

definitions.definitionEn: (subjunctive present, defective) Expressing a wish (with present subjunctive effect).

example.en: may you win;  may the weather be sunny
example.ja: あなたが勝利を得られるように。

definitions.definitionEn: Used in modesty, courtesy, or concession, or to soften a question or remark.
(auxiliary) Used to indicate conditional or possible actions.

example.en: I might go to the party, but I haven't decided yet.
example.ja: パーティーに行ってもまだ決めてない

definitions.definitionEn: Used to indicate a desired past action that was not done.

example.en: Hey man, you might have warned me about the thunderstorm.
example.ja: おい雷に警告したかもしれない

definitions.definitionEn: (auxiliary) Even though.

example.en: I might be in a wheelchair, but I still want to be treated as a lady.
example.ja: 私は車いすに乗っているかもしれませんが、やはり女性として扱われたいと思っています。

definitions.definitionEn: (auxiliary) Used in polite requests for permission

example.en: Might I take the last biscuit?
example.ja: 最後のビスケットを

meaning: ～しなければならない／～に違いない

definitions.definitionEn: Something that is mandatory or required.

example.en: If you'll be out all day, a map is a must.
example.ja: 一日中外出するなら地図は不可欠だ

definitions.definitionEn: (modal auxiliary, defective) To do with certainty; indicates that the speaker is certain that the subject will have executed the predicate.

example.en: If it has rained all day, it must be very wet outside.
example.ja: 一日中雨が降ったのであれば、外はとてもぬれたに違いありません。

definitions.definitionEn: (modal auxiliary, defective) To do as a requirement; indicates that the sentence subject is required as an imperative or directive to execute the sentence predicate, with failure to do so resulting in a negative consequence.

example.en: This door handle must be rotated fully.
example.ja: このドアハンドルは完全に回転しなければならない。

definitions.definitionEn: (modal auxiliary, defective) said about something that is very likely, probable, or certain to be true

example.en: The children must be asleep by now.
example.ja: 子供はもう寝ているはずだ

definitions.definitionEn: The property of being stale or musty.
Something that exhibits the property of being stale or musty.
Fruit juice that will ferment or has fermented, usually from grapes.
To make musty.
To become musty.
A time during which male elephants exhibit increased levels of sexual activity and aggressiveness (also spelled musth).
An elephant in this sexual and aggressive state.
A dwelling.
One’s native land; the place or country in which one dwells; the place where one’s ancestors dwell or dwelt.
The locality where a thing is usually found, or was first found, or where it is naturally abundant; habitat; seat.

example.en: the home of the pine
example.ja: 松の故郷

definitions.definitionEn: A focus point.
(of animals) To return to its owner.

example.en: The dog homed.
example.ja: 犬が家へ

definitions.definitionEn: (always with "in on") To seek or aim for something.

example.en: The missile was able to home in on the target.
example.ja: ミサイルは、目標に家に帰ることができた。

definitions.definitionEn: Of or pertaining to one’s dwelling or country; domestic; not foreign; as home manufactures; home comforts.
(except in phrases) That strikes home; direct, pointed.
Personal, intimate.
Relating to the home team (the team at whose venue a game is played).

example.en: the home end, home advantage, home supporters
example.ja: ホーム・エンド、ホーム・プラス、ホームの支持者

definitions.definitionEn: To one's home
At or in one's place of residence or one's customary or official location; at home

example.en: Everyone's gone to watch the game; there's nobody home.
example.ja: 全員が試合を見に行つたが、家には誰もいない。

definitions.definitionEn: To a full and intimate degree; to the heart of the matter; fully, directly.
Into the goal
Into the right, proper or stowed position

example.en: sails sheeted home
example.ja: 帆を敷き詰めて故郷へ

definitions.definitionEn: A directory that contains a user's files.
At no time; on no occasion; in no circumstance.

example.en: I finally finished, and I never want to do that again.
example.ja: やっと終わったの。もう2度とやりたくない。

definitions.definitionEn: Not at any other time; not on any other occasion; not previously.
Negative particle (used to negate verbs in the simple past tense; also used absolutely).

example.en: I never saw him today.
example.ja: 今日彼に会ったことはない

example: The final report included two graphs.

definitions.definitionEn: A piece of source code or other content that is dynamically retrieved for inclusion in another item.
To bring into a group, class, set, or total as a (new) part or member.

example.en: I will purchase the vacation package if you will include car rental.
example.ja: レンタカーも含めていただければ、休暇の包装品を買うことにします。

definitions.definitionEn: To contain, as parts of a whole; to comprehend.

example.en: Does this volume of Shakespeare include his sonnets?
example.ja: シェークスピアのこの量には息子のソナネが含まれているでしょうか。

definitions.definitionEn: To enclose, confine.
To conclude; to terminate.

example.ja: ABとOXが交差する点とします。

definitions.definitionEn: To cause (+ bare infinitive).

example.en: Can you let me know what time you'll be arriving?
example.ja: 何時に来るか教えて

definitions.definitionEn: To hinder, prevent, impede, hamper, cumber; to obstruct (someone or something).
To prevent someone from doing something; also to prevent something from happening.
To tarry or delay.
To allow to, not to prevent (+ infinitive, but usually without to).

example.en: After he knocked for hours, I decided to let him come in.
example.ja: 何時間もノックした後、私はその人を中に入れることにしました。

definitions.definitionEn: To leave.

example.en: Let me alone!
example.ja: 私のことはほっといて。

definitions.definitionEn: To allow the release of (a fluid).

example.en: The physicians let about a pint of his blood, but to no avail.
example.ja: 医師たちはその人の血液を 1 パイントほど注入しましたが、効果はありませんでした。

definitions.definitionEn: To allow possession of (a property etc.) in exchange for rent.

example.en: I decided to let the farmhouse to a couple while I was working abroad.
example.ja: 私は外国で働いている間に、農場を二組の夫婦に預けることにしました。

definitions.definitionEn: To give, grant, or assign, as a work, privilege, or contract; often with out.

example.en: to let the building of a bridge;  to let out the lathing and the plastering
example.ja: )の橋の建造を許可し、その敷物や石こうを外し,

definitions.definitionEn: Used to introduce an imperative in the first or third person.

example.en: Let P be the point where AB and OX intersect.
example.ja: ABとOXが交差する点とします。

definitions.definitionEn: To cause (+ bare infinitive).

example.en: Can you let me know what time you'll be arriving?
example.ja: 何時に来るか教えて

definitions.definitionEn: An obstacle or hindrance.
The hindrance caused by the net during serve, only if the ball falls legally.
To hinder, prevent, impede, hamper, cumber; to obstruct (someone or something).
To prevent someone from doing something; also to prevent something from happening.
To tarry or delay.
Another time; once more.
Over and above a factor of one.
Used metalinguistically, with the repetition being in the discussion, or in the linguistic or pragmatic context of the discussion, rather than in the subject of discussion.

example.en: Great, thanks again!
example.ja: よかったまたありがとう!

definitions.definitionEn: Back in the reverse direction, or to an original starting point.

example.en: Bring us word again.
example.ja: もう1度言ってくれ

definitions.definitionEn: Back (to a former place or state).

example.en: The South will rise again.
example.ja: 南は再び上昇する

definitions.definitionEn: In return, as a reciprocal action; back.
In any other place.
On the other hand.
Moreover; besides; further.
(obsolete or dialectal) Against.
A type, race or category; a group of entities that have common characteristics such that they may be grouped together.

example.en: This is a strange kind of tobacco.
example.ja: これは奇妙な種類の煙草です。

definitions.definitionEn: A makeshift or otherwise atypical specimen.

example.en: The opening served as a kind of window.
example.ja: 開口部は一種の窓の役目を果たしました。

definitions.definitionEn: One's inherent nature; character, natural disposition.
Family, lineage.
Manner.
Goods or services used as payment, as e.g. in barter.
Equivalent means used as response to an action.

example.en: I'll pay in kind for his insult.
example.ja: 彼の侮辱に敬意を払います

definitions.definitionEn: Each of the two elements of the communion service, bread and wine.
Having a benevolent, courteous, friendly, generous, gentle, liberal, sympathetic, or warm-hearted nature or disposition, marked by consideration for – and service to – others.
Affectionate.

example.en: a kind man; a kind heart
example.ja: 親切な人、優しい心

definitions.definitionEn: Favorable.
Mild, gentle, forgiving

example.en: The years have been kind to Richard Gere; he ages well.
example.ja: リチャード・ゲーレはこう語っています。「

definitions.definitionEn: Gentle; tractable; easily governed.

example.en: a horse kind in harness
example.ja: 馬を利用する

definitions.definitionEn: Characteristic of the species; belonging to one's nature; natural; native.
The main tower of a castle or fortress, located within the castle walls.
The food or money required to keep someone alive and healthy; one's support, maintenance.

example.en: He works as a cobbler's apprentice for his keep.
example.ja: 彼は自分の持ち物のために小道具師の弟子として働いている。

definitions.definitionEn: The act or office of keeping; custody; guard; care; heed; charge; notice.
The state of being kept; hence, the resulting condition; case.

example.en: to be in good keep
example.ja: Andrew Way on style on last on now at stay ard

definitions.definitionEn: That which is kept in charge; a charge.
A cap for holding something, such as a journal box, in place.
To continue in (a course or mode of action); not to intermit or fall from; to uphold or maintain.

example.en: to keep silence;  to keep one's word;  to keep possession
example.ja: 故に、黙れ、言つて言ひける、有て有すべし。

definitions.definitionEn: (heading) To hold the status of something.
(heading) To hold or be held in a state.
To wait for, keep watch for.
To act as wicket-keeper.

example.en: Godfrey Evans kept for England for many years.
example.ja: ゴッドフリー・エヴァンズは長年英国のために保管していた

definitions.definitionEn: To take care; to be solicitous; to watch.
To be in session; to take place.

example.en: School keeps today.
example.ja: 今日学校は休みです

definitions.definitionEn: To observe; to adhere to; to fulfill; not to swerve from or violate.
(by extension) To visit (a place) often; to frequent.
To observe or celebrate (a holiday).

example.en: The feast of St. Stephen is kept on December 26.
example.ja: 聖ステファノの祝宴は 12 月 26 日に行なわれます。

definitions.definitionEn: (stative) To perceive sounds through the ear.

example.en: I was deaf, and now I can hear.
example.ja: 耳が聞こえませんでしたが、今では聞こえるようになりました。

definitions.definitionEn: (stative) To perceive (a sound, or something producing a sound) with the ear, to recognize (something) in an auditory way.

example.en: I heard a sound from outside the window.
example.ja: 窓の外から音がした。

definitions.definitionEn: To exercise this faculty intentionally; to listen to.
To listen favourably to; to grant (a request etc.).

example.en: Eventually the king chose to hear her entreaties.
example.ja: やがて王は彼女の嘆願を聞くことにしました。

definitions.definitionEn: To receive information about; to come to learn of.
(with from) To be contacted by.
To listen to (a person, case) in a court of law; to try.

example.en: Your case will be heard at the end of the month.
example.ja: 月末に審問を聴聞する。

definitions.definitionEn: To sympathize with; to understand the feelings or opinion of.

example.en: You're tired of all the ads on TV? I hear ya.
example.ja: テレビの広告に飽きたのか?

example: The city introduced a new system for collecting waste.

definitions.definitionEn: A collection of organized things; a whole composed of relationships among its members.

example.en: There are eight planets in the solar system.
example.ja: 太陽系には八つの惑星があります。

definitions.definitionEn: A method or way of organizing or planning.

example.en: Followers should have a system to follow that works in their interests, not against them.
example.ja: 追随者たちは、自分たちの益のために自分たちに作用する制度を持っていなければなりません。

definitions.definitionEn: of a countable group (considered individually), without exception.

example.en: Every person in the room stood and cheered.
example.ja: 部屋の人は皆、立って、歓声を上げました。

definitions.definitionEn: A sentence, phrase or word which asks for information, reply or response; an interrogative.

example.en: What is your question?
example.ja: 質問は?

definitions.definitionEn: A subject or topic for consideration or investigation.

example.en: The question of seniority will be discussed at the meeting.
example.ja: 昭和二十三年五月二十七日閲覧. ^ "高等学校の問題について、会議で検討する。

definitions.definitionEn: A doubt or challenge about the truth or accuracy of a matter.

example.en: He obeyed without question.
example.ja: イエスは疑問の余地なく従ったのです。

definitions.definitionEn: A proposal to a meeting as a topic for deliberation.

example.en: I move that the question be put to a vote.
example.ja: 私は、その質問の答案を投票に移す。

definitions.definitionEn: (chiefly with definite article) Interrogation by torture.
Talk; conversation; speech.
To ask questions about; to interrogate; to enquire for information.
To raise doubts about; have doubts about.
To argue; to converse; to dispute.
To last, continue, endure.
For all of a given time interval.

example.en: I lived with my parents during the 1970s.
example.ja: 私は 1970 年に両親と共に生活しました。

definitions.definitionEn: At any time or period within a given time interval.

example.en: I lived with my parents at several points during the 1980s.
example.ja: 私は 1980 年に幾つかの点で両親と共に生活しました。

definitions.definitionEn: At all times; throughout all time; since the beginning.

example.en: Airplanes did not always exist as a form of transportation.
example.ja: 飛行機はいつも一種の輸送手段として存在していたわけではありません。

definitions.definitionEn: Constantly during a certain period, or regularly at stated intervals (opposed to sometimes or occasionally).

example.en: In this street, the shops always close during lunchtime.
example.ja: この街では、店は昼休みにいつも閉館する。

definitions.definitionEn: In any event.

example.en: I thought I could always go back to work.
example.ja: 仕事に戻れると思ってた

definitions.definitionEn: Someone or something that is large in stature
An important or powerful person; a celebrity; a big name.
(as plural) The big leagues, big time.
(BDSM) The participant in ageplay who acts out the older role.
To praise, recommend, or promote.
Of great size, large.

example.en: Elephants are big animals, and they eat a lot.
example.ja: 象は大きな動物で、たくさん食べます。

definitions.definitionEn: (of an industry or other field, often capitalized) Thought to have undue influence.

example.en: Big Tech
example.ja: ビッグテクノロジー

definitions.definitionEn: Popular.

example.en: That style is very big right now in Europe, especially among teenagers.
example.ja: そのスタイルは、ヨーロッパでは特に十代の若者の間で今では非常に大きくなっています。

definitions.definitionEn: Adult.

example.en: Kids should get help from big people if they want to use the kitchen.
example.ja: 子供は大きな方から援助を受けなければならない。キッチンを使うなら。

definitions.definitionEn: Fat.

example.en: Gosh, she is big!
example.ja: ああ、彼女は大きい!

definitions.definitionEn: Important or significant.

example.en: What's so big about that? I do it all the time.
example.ja: どうしてそんなに大きいの?

definitions.definitionEn: (with on) Enthusiastic (about).

example.en: I'm not big on the idea, but if you want to go ahead with it, I won't stop you.
example.ja: その考えは苦手だが、もしもそうしたいなら、君を止めるつもりはない。

definitions.definitionEn: Mature, conscientious, principled; generous.

example.en: I tried to be the bigger person and just let it go, but I couldn't help myself.
example.ja: 私は大きな人間になろうとして、ただそれを放ってしまおうとしたが、自分は助からなかった。

definitions.definitionEn: Well-endowed, possessing large breasts in the case of a woman or a large penis in the case of a man.

example.en: Whoa, Nadia has gotten pretty big since she hit puberty.
example.ja: ナディアは思春期からかなり大きくなったわ

definitions.definitionEn: (sometimes figurative) Large with young; pregnant; swelling; ready to give birth or produce.

example.en: She was big with child.
example.ja: 彼女は子供で大きかった

definitions.definitionEn: Used as an intensifier, especially of negative-valence nouns

example.en: You are a big liar.  Why are you in such a big hurry?
example.ja: あなたは嘘つきよなぜそんなに急いでるの?

definitions.definitionEn: (of a city) populous
(of somebody's age) old, mature. Used to imply that somebody is too old for something, or acting immaturely.
In a loud manner.
In a boasting manner.

example.en: He's always talking big, but he never delivers.
example.ja: 彼はいつも大きな話をしているが、彼は決して届けない。

definitions.definitionEn: In a large amount or to a large extent.

example.en: He won big betting on the croquet championship.
example.ja: 彼はクラケット選手権で大賭けした

definitions.definitionEn: On a large scale, expansively.

example.en: You've got to think big to succeed at Amalgamated Plumbing.
example.ja: アマルガメッド・プラウビンで成功を収めるには重大な考えが必要です

definitions.definitionEn: Hard.

example.en: He hit him big and the guy just crumpled.
example.ja: 彼は彼を大きく叩いて男はぐちゃぐちゃにした

To locate oneself
To build; erect; fashion
To dwell; have a dwelling
One or more kinds of barley, especially six-rowed barley.

definitions.definitionEn: To put (something) down, to rest.

example.en: Set the tray there.
example.ja: 盆をそこにセットして

definitions.definitionEn: To attach or affix (something) to something else, or in or upon a certain place.

example.en: I have set my heart on running the marathon.
example.ja: 私はマラソンをすることに心を向けました。

definitions.definitionEn: To put in a specified condition or state; to cause to be.
To start (a fire).
To cause to stop or stick; to obstruct; to fasten to a spot.

example.en: to set a coach in the mud
example.ja: を選択して、泥の中にコーチを置く

definitions.definitionEn: To determine or settle.

example.en: to set the rent
example.ja: を選択し、

definitions.definitionEn: To adjust.

example.en: I set the alarm at 6 a.m.
example.ja: 午前6時に警報をセットした

definitions.definitionEn: To punch (a nail) into wood so that its head is below the surface.
To arrange with dishes and cutlery, to set the table.

example.en: Please set the table for our guests.
example.ja: ゲストに食卓をセットして

definitions.definitionEn: To introduce or describe.

example.en: I’ll tell you what happened, but first let me set the scene.
example.ja: 私はその時のことをお話ししますが、まずその場面を見てみましょう。

definitions.definitionEn: To locate (a play, etc.); to assign a backdrop to, geographically or temporally.

example.en: He says he will set his next film in France.
example.ja: 彼はフランスで次の映画を上映すると話している。

definitions.definitionEn: To compile, to make (a puzzle or challenge).

example.en: This crossword was set by Araucaria.
example.ja: このクロスワードはアラカリアによって定められました。

definitions.definitionEn: To prepare (a stage or film set).
To fit (someone) up in a situation.
To arrange (type).

example.en: It was a complex page, but he set it quickly.
example.ja: 複雑なページだったが、彼は速やかに設定した。

definitions.definitionEn: To devise and assign (work) to.

example.en: The teacher set her students the task of drawing a foot.
example.ja: 先生は生徒たちに、足を引く仕事を割り当てました。

definitions.definitionEn: To direct (the ball) to a teammate for an attack.
To solidify.

example.en: The glue sets in four minutes.
example.ja: 接着剤は4分で作動する。

definitions.definitionEn: To render stiff or solid; especially, to convert into curd; to curdle.

example.en: to set milk for cheese
example.ja: を選択して、チーズにミルクをセットします。

definitions.definitionEn: Of a heavenly body, to disappear below the horizon of a planet, etc, as the latter rotates.

example.en: The moon sets at eight o'clock tonight.
example.ja: 月は今夜8時になる。

definitions.definitionEn: To defeat a contract.
(now followed by "out", as in set out) To begin to move; to go forth.
To produce after pollination.

example.en: to set seed
example.ja: シードを設定

definitions.definitionEn: (of fruit) To be fixed for growth; to strike root; to begin to germinate or form.
(Midwestern US) To sit (be in a seated position).

example.en: He sets in that chair all day.
example.ja: 彼は一日中椅子に座った

definitions.definitionEn: To hunt game with the aid of a setter.
Of a dog, to indicate the position of game.

example.en: The dog sets the bird.
example.ja: 犬は鳥を仕掛けます。

definitions.definitionEn: To apply oneself; to undertake earnestly.
To fit music to words.
To place plants or shoots in the ground; to plant.

example.en: to set pear trees in an orchard
example.ja: 累々と実るタルフ木を,

definitions.definitionEn: To become fixed or rigid; to be fastened.
To have a certain direction of motion; to flow; to move on; to tend.

example.en: The current sets to the north; the tide sets to the windward.
example.ja: 潮流は北に、潮は風上に向けて流れます。

definitions.definitionEn: (country dancing) To acknowledge a dancing partner by facing him or her and moving first to one side and then to the other, while she or he does the opposite.

example.en: Set to partners! was the next instruction from the caller.
example.ja: 請負人から次の指示があった。

definitions.definitionEn: To place or fix in a setting.

example.en: to set a precious stone in a border of metal
example.ja: 宝石を金属の境界に敷く

definitions.definitionEn: To put in order in a particular manner; to prepare.

example.en: to set (that is, to hone) a razor
example.ja: かみそり

definitions.definitionEn: To extend and bring into position; to spread.

example.en: to set the sails of a ship
example.ja: を選択して、帆を設定

definitions.definitionEn: To give a pitch to, as a tune; to start by fixing the keynote.

example.en: to set a psalm
example.ja: ^ a b c d e f e f g h i j k l e f h i

definitions.definitionEn: To reduce from a dislocated or fractured state.

example.en: to set a broken bone
example.ja: 骨を砕く

definitions.definitionEn: To lower into place and fix solidly, as the blocks of cut stone in a structure.
To wager in gambling; to risk.
To adorn with something infixed or affixed; to stud; to variegate with objects placed here and there.
To value; to rate; used with at.
To establish as a rule; to furnish; to prescribe; to assign.

example.en: to set a good example
example.ja: をクリックして良い例を設定します。

definitions.definitionEn: To suit; to become.

example.en: It sets him ill.
example.ja: それは彼を病気にする

definitions.definitionEn: A punch for setting nails in wood.

example.en: nail set
example.ja: 爪セット

definitions.definitionEn: A device for receiving broadcast radio waves (or, more recently, broadcast data); a radio or television.

example.en: television set
example.ja: テレビセット

definitions.definitionEn: A small tuber or bulb used instead of seed, particularly onion sets and potato sets.
The amount the teeth of a saw protrude to the side in order to create the kerf.
That which is staked; a wager; hence, a gambling game.
Permanent change of shape caused by excessive strain, as from compression, tension, bending, twisting, etc.

example.en: the set of a spring
example.ja: 泉の集合。

definitions.definitionEn: A bias of mind; an attitude or pattern of behaviour.
(piledriving) A piece placed temporarily upon the head of a pile when the latter cannot otherwise be reached by the weight, or hammer.
The width of the body of a type.
A young oyster when first attached.
Collectively, the crop of young oysters in any locality.
A series or group of something. (Note the similar meaning in Etymology 4, Noun)
The manner, state, or quality of setting or fitting; fit.

example.en: the set of a coat
example.ja: コートのセット

definitions.definitionEn: The pattern of a tartan, etc.
The camber of a curved roofing tile.
The full number of eggs set under a hen.
The system of tunnels that is the home of a badger.
The pattern of distinctive threads and yarns that make up the plaid of a Scottish tartan.
A small, square-cut piece of quarried stone used for paving and edging.
Fixed in position.
Rigid, solidified.
Ready, prepared.

example.en: on your marks, get set, go!;  on your marks, set, go!
example.ja: 刻印の上に立て!

definitions.definitionEn: Intent, determined (to do something).

example.en: set on getting to his destination
example.ja: 目的地に到着する

definitions.definitionEn: Prearranged.

example.en: a set menu
example.ja: 設定メニュー

definitions.definitionEn: Fixed in one’s opinion.

example.en: I’m set against the idea of smacking children to punish them.
example.ja: 私は子供たちを叱りつけて罰するという考えに反対しようとしています。

definitions.definitionEn: (of hair) Fixed in a certain style.
A young plant fit for setting out; a slip; shoot.
A rudimentary fruit.
The setting of the sun or other luminary; (by extension) the close of the day.
General movement; direction; drift; tendency.
