example.en: to buy at first hand (from the producer, or when new);  to buy at second hand (when no longer in the producer’s hand, or when not new);  It's not a rumor. I heard it at first hand.
example.ja: )を一手(プロデューサーから又は新品から購入)し、第二手(製造業者の手の内から買わないとき、又は新しいものを買わない時)を購入する、これは噂ではない、第一手から聞こえた。

definitions.definitionEn: Rate; price.
To give, pass, or transmit with the hand, literally or figuratively.

example.en: He handed them the letter.   She handed responsibility over to her deputy.
example.ja: その人はその手紙を手渡し、自分の代理人に責任をゆだねました。

definitions.definitionEn: To lead, guide, or assist with the hand; to conduct.

example.en: to hand a lady into a carriage
example.ja: 女を馬車に乗せる

definitions.definitionEn: To manage.
To seize; to lay hands on.
To pledge by the hand; to handfast.
(said of a sail) To furl.
To cooperate.

meaning: 〈C〉(人・物事の)状態,ありさま,様子 / 〈C〉《a ~》《話》極度の緊張状態,異常な精神状態 / 〈U〉地位,階級,身分 / 〈C〉〈U〉《しばしばS-》国家,国,政府 / 〈C〉《時にS-》(アメリカ・オーストラリアなどの)州 / 《the States》《話》米国 / 〈U〉威厳;公式;堂々とした様子 / 国家の,国事に関する / 《しばしばS-》《米》州の,州立の / 公式の,儀式用の / …をはっきり述べる,公式に申し立てる / 〈当局が〉…を指定する,決める

definitions.definitionEn: A condition; a set of circumstances applying at any given time.
High social standing or circumstance.
A polity.
(stochastic processes) An element of the range of the random variables that define a random process.
(grammar) The lexical aspect (aktionsart) of verbs or predicates that do not change over time.
To declare to be a fact.

example.en: He stated that he was willing to help.
example.ja: そして、喜んで援助しようとしていると言いました。

definitions.definitionEn: To make known.

example.en: State your intentions.
example.ja: 君の意思を述べろ

definitions.definitionEn: Stately.
The act of moving; a movement.

example.en: A slight move of the tiller, and the boat will go off course.
example.ja: 舵が少し動くと船はコースを外れる

definitions.definitionEn: An act for the attainment of an object; a step in the execution of a plan or purpose.

example.en: He made another move towards becoming a naturalized citizen.
example.ja: 彼は、自然主義的な市民になるための別の動きをしてきた。

definitions.definitionEn: A formalized or practiced action used in athletics, dance, physical exercise, self-defense, hand-to-hand combat, etc.

example.en: She always gets spontaneous applause for that one move.
example.ja: 彼女はいつもその動きに対して自然に拍手を浴びる

definitions.definitionEn: The event of changing one's residence.

example.en: The move into my fiancé's house took two long days.
example.ja: 婚約者の家への移転には 2日かかった

definitions.definitionEn: A change in strategy.

example.en: I am worried about our boss's move.
example.ja: ボスの動向が心配だ

definitions.definitionEn: A transfer, a change from one employer to another.
The act of moving a token on a gameboard from one position to another according to the rules of the game.

example.en: If you roll a six, you can make two moves.
example.ja: 6回弾くと 2回動くことができる

definitions.definitionEn: To change place or posture; to go, in any manner, from one place or position to another.

example.en: A ship moves rapidly.
example.ja: 船は速く動く

definitions.definitionEn: To act; to take action; to begin to act

example.en: Come on guys, let's move: there's work to do!
example.ja: さあみんな移動しようやることがあるんだ!

definitions.definitionEn: To change residence, for example from one house, town, or state, to another; to go and live at another place. See also move out and move in.

example.en: I decided to move to the country for a more peaceful life.
example.ja: 私はもっと平和な生活を送るために国に移ることにしました。

definitions.definitionEn: (and other games) To change the place of a piece in accordance with the rules of the game.

example.en: My opponent's counter was moving much quicker round the board than mine.
example.ja: 対戦相手のカウンターは私よりもずっと早くボードを回るようになった

definitions.definitionEn: To cause to change place or posture in any manner; to set in motion; to carry, convey, draw, or push from one place to another

example.en: The horse moves a carriage.
example.ja: 馬は馬車を動かす

definitions.definitionEn: To transfer (a piece or man) from one space or position to another, according to the rules of the game

example.en: She moved the queen closer to the centre of the board.
example.ja: 彼女は女王を取締役の中央に近づけた。

definitions.definitionEn: To excite to action by the presentation of motives; to rouse by representation, persuasion, or appeal; to influence.

example.en: This song moves me to dance.
example.ja: この歌は踊りを誘う。

definitions.definitionEn: To arouse the feelings or passions of; especially, to excite to tenderness or compassion, to excite (for example, an emotion).

example.en: That book really moved me.
example.ja: その本には本当に感動しました。

definitions.definitionEn: To propose; to recommend; specifically, to propose formally for consideration and determination, in a deliberative assembly; to submit

example.en: I move to repeal the rule regarding obligatory school uniform.
example.ja: 義務学校の制服に関する規則を廃止する。

definitions.definitionEn: To mention; to raise (a question); to suggest (a course of action); to lodge (a complaint).
To incite, urge (someone to do something); to solicit (someone for or of an issue); to make a proposal to.
To apply to, as for aid.
To request an action from the court.

example.en: An attorney moved the court to issue a restraining order.
example.ja: 一弁護士は法廷を動かして、禁固命令を出しました。

definitions.definitionEn: To bow or salute upon meeting.
To sell, to market (especially, but not exclusively, illegal products)
A legally or socially binding conceptual contract of entitlement to wealth, void of intrinsic value, payable for all debts and taxes, and regulated in supply.
A generally accepted means of exchange and measure of value.

example.en: Before colonial times cowry shells imported from Mauritius were used as money in Western Africa.
example.ja: 植民地時代以前、モーリタニアから輸入された牛の貝は、西アフリカではお金として使われていました。

definitions.definitionEn: A currency maintained by a state or other entity which can guarantee its value (such as a monetary union).

example.en: money supply;  money market
example.ja: 通貨の供給; 通貨市場

definitions.definitionEn: Hard cash in the form of banknotes and coins, as opposed to cheques/checks, credit cards, or credit more generally.
The total value of liquid assets available for an individual or other economic unit, such as cash and bank deposits.
Wealth; a person, family or class that possesses wealth

example.en: He married money.
example.ja: 彼は金と結婚した

definitions.definitionEn: An item of value between two or more parties used for the exchange of goods or services.
A person who funds an operation.
Something actual as opposed to invented.

example.en: In this story, the Gettysburg Address is a fact, but the rest is fiction.
example.ja: ゲティスバーグ住所は事実だが残りはフィクションだ

definitions.definitionEn: Something which is real.

example.en: Gravity is a fact, not a theory.
example.ja: 重力は現実だ理論じゃない

definitions.definitionEn: Something concrete used as a basis for further interpretation.

example.en: Let's look at the facts of the case before deciding.
example.ja: 決議前に事件事実を検討する。

definitions.definitionEn: An objective consensus on a fundamental reality that has been agreed upon by a substantial number of experts.

example.en: There is no doubting the fact that the Earth orbits the Sun.
example.ja: 地球が太陽を回っているという事実に疑問の余地はありません。

definitions.definitionEn: Information about a particular subject, especially actual conditions and/or circumstances.

example.en: The facts about space travel.
example.ja: 宇宙旅行に関する事実。

definitions.definitionEn: An individual value or measurement at the lowest level of granularity in a data warehouse.
Action; the realm of action.
A wrongful or criminal deed.

example.en: He had become an accessory after the fact.
example.ja: 彼は事実が明らかになった後、共犯者になっていました。

definitions.definitionEn: A feat or meritorious deed.
Used before making a statement to introduce it as a trustworthy one.

example: The first method was faster; however, it was less accurate.

definitions.definitionEn: Nevertheless; yet, still; in spite of (that).

example.en: He told me not to do it. I, however, did it anyway. / I did it anyway, however. / (sometimes proscribed:) However, I did it anyway.
example.ja: しかし、私はとにかくそれをしました。 /私はとにかくやった。 / (しかし、時々:):しかし、私はとにかくしました。

definitions.definitionEn: (degree) To whatever degree or extent

example.en: However clear you think you've been, many questions will remain.
example.ja: 君がそう思っていても多くの疑問が残るだろう

definitions.definitionEn: (manner) In whatever way or manner.

example.en: Let me know when you've had your interview, however it goes.
example.ja: インタビューを受けたら連絡を

definitions.definitionEn: An emphatic form of how.

example.en: However were you able to do it?
example.ja: しかし、あなたはそうすることができましたか。

definitions.definitionEn: In any case, at any rate, at all events.
In whatever way or manner.

example.en: she offered to help however she could
example.ja: ♪どんなに力になれても

definitions.definitionEn: Although, though, but, yet.

example: This area receives heavy snow in winter.

definitions.definitionEn: A measure of the extent of a surface; it is measured in square units.
A particular geographic region.
Any particular extent of surface, especially an empty or unused extent.

example.en: The photo is a little dark in that area.
example.ja: 写真は、その地域では少し暗い。

definitions.definitionEn: The extent, scope, or range of an object or concept.

example.en: The plans are a bit vague in that area.
example.ja: 計画は、その地域で少し曖昧です。

definitions.definitionEn: An open space, below ground level, between the front of a house and the pavement.
Penalty box; penalty area.
Genitals.

example: The website provides information in several languages.

definitions.definitionEn: To make a living; earn money for necessities.

example.en: It is difficult to provide for my family working on minimum wage.
example.ja: 家族が最低賃金で働けるようにするのは難しいことです。

definitions.definitionEn: To act to prepare for something.

example.en: Provide against disaster.
example.ja: 災害に対して備えをする。

definitions.definitionEn: To establish as a previous condition; to stipulate.

example.en: I'll lend you the money, provided that you pay it back by Monday.
example.ja: 月曜日までに返せば金を貸す

definitions.definitionEn: To give what is needed or desired, especially basic needs.

example.en: Don't bother bringing equipment, as we will provide it.
example.ja: 備品を運ばないで

definitions.definitionEn: To furnish (with), cause to be present.
To make possible or attainable.

example.en: He provides us with an alternative option.
example.ja: 神は別の選択肢を備えてくださいます。

definitions.definitionEn: (Latinism) To foresee.
To appoint to an ecclesiastical benefice before it is vacant. See provisor.
Any nounal word or phrase which indicates a particular person, place, class, or thing.

example.en: I've never liked the name my parents gave me so I changed it at the age of twenty.
example.ja: 20歳の頃に改めました 20歳のころには

definitions.definitionEn: Reputation.
An abusive or insulting epithet.

example.en: Stop calling me names!
example.ja: 名前を呼ばないで!

definitions.definitionEn: A person (or legal person).
Those of a certain name; a race; a family.
A unique identifier, generally a string of characters.
An investor in Lloyds of London bearing unlimited liability.
Authority.

example.en: Halt in the name of the law!
example.ja: 法の名において停止!

definitions.definitionEn: (ditransitive) To give a name to.

example.en: One visitor named Hou Yugang said he was not too concerned about climate change and Baishui’s melting.
example.ja: ホウユガングという名の訪問者の話によると、彼は気候の変化についてあまり心配しておらず、バシシュイの溶け込みも心配ではないということです。

definitions.definitionEn: To mention, specify.

example.en: He named his demands.
example.ja: 彼は要求を命名した。

definitions.definitionEn: To identify as relevant or important

example.en: naming the problem
example.ja: 問題の名前をつける

definitions.definitionEn: To publicly implicate.

example.en: The painter was named as an accomplice.
example.ja: 画家は共犯者と呼ばれました。

definitions.definitionEn: To designate for a role.

example.en: My neighbor was named to the steering committee.
example.ja: 隣の人はハンドル・スクウェアという名前で呼ばれました。

definitions.definitionEn: (Westminster system politics) To initiate a process to temporarily remove a member of parliament who is breaking the rules of conduct.
Any of several types of true yam (Dioscorea) used in Caribbean Spanish cooking.
A reading or an act of reading, especially an actor's part of a play.
(in combination) Something to be read; a written work.

example.en: His thrillers are always a gripping read.
example.ja: そのスリルを感じている人たちは、いつでも読むのが上手です。

definitions.definitionEn: A person's interpretation or impression of something.

example.en: What's your read of the current political situation?
example.ja: 現在の政治情勢は?

definitions.definitionEn: An instance of reading.
To look at and interpret letters or other information that is written.

example.en: Have you read this book?
example.ja: この本はもう読みましたか。

definitions.definitionEn: To speak aloud words or other information that is written. Often construed with a to phrase or an indirect object.

example.en: All right, class, who wants to read next?
example.ja: さて、クラス、誰が次に読みたいですか?

definitions.definitionEn: To read work(s) written by (a named author).

example.en: At the moment I'm reading Milton.
example.ja: 今ミルトンを読んでる

definitions.definitionEn: To interpret, or infer a meaning, significance, thought, intention, etc. from.

example.en: I can read his feelings in his face.
example.ja: 彼の気持ちが読める

definitions.definitionEn: To consist of certain text.

example.en: On the door hung a sign that reads "No admittance".
example.ja: ドアには"許可なし"と書かれた看板が貼られた。

definitions.definitionEn: Of text, etc., to be interpreted or read in a particular way.

example.en: Arabic reads right to left.
example.ja: アラビア語は左から読む。

definitions.definitionEn: To substitute (a corrected piece of text in place of an erroneous one); used to introduce an emendation of a text.
(usually ironic) Used after a euphemism to introduce the intended, more blunt meaning of a term.
To be able to hear what another person is saying over a radio connection.

example.en: Do you read me?
example.ja: 聞こえますか。

definitions.definitionEn: To observe and comprehend (a displayed signal)

example.en: A repeater signal may be used where the track geometry makes the main signal difficult to read from a distance.
example.ja: 反復信号は、トラックの幾何学が、遠くからの主要信号を読むのを困難にしているところで用いられることがあります。

definitions.definitionEn: (except Scotland) To make a special study of, as by perusing textbooks.

example.en: I am reading theology at university.
example.ja: 私は大学で神学を読んでいます。

definitions.definitionEn: To fetch data from (a storage medium, etc.).

example.en: to read a hard disk; to read a port; to read the keyboard
example.ja: を選択してハードディスクを読む; ポートを読む; キーボードを読む

definitions.definitionEn: To think, believe; to consider (that).
To advise; to counsel. See rede.
To tell; to declare; to recite.
To recognise (someone) as being transgender.

example.en: Every time I go outside, I worry that someone will read me.
example.ja: 外に出るたびに、だれかに読まれてしまうのではないかと心配します。

example.en: John and I have been friends ever since we were roommates at college.   Trust is important between friends.   I used to find it hard to make friends when I was shy.
example.ja: ジョンとわたしは、大学でルームメイトをしてから友達になりました。

definitions.definitionEn: An associate who provides assistance.

example.en: The Automobile Association is every motorist's friend.   The police is every law-abiding citizen's friend.
example.ja: 自動運転協会は全ての自動車士の友人で、警察はすべての法に適合する市民の友人である。

example.en: a friend of a friend;  I added him as a friend on Facebook, but I hardly know him.
example.ja: Facebookに友達として加えたけど、ほとんど知らない。

definitions.definitionEn: A person who backs or supports something.

example.en: I’m not a friend of cheap wine.
example.ja: わたしは安いぶどう酒の友達ではありません。

definitions.definitionEn: An object or idea that can be used for good.

example.en: Wiktionary is your friend.
example.ja: ウィクショナリーは友人だ

definitions.definitionEn: (used only in the vocative) Used as a form of address when warning someone.

example.en: You’d better watch it, friend.
example.ja: 気をつけてください。

definitions.definitionEn: A function or class granted special access to the private and protected members of another class.
A spring-loaded camming device.
A lover; a boyfriend or girlfriend.
A relative, a relation by blood or marriage.

example.en: Friends agree best at a distance.
example.ja: 友人の意見は、離れているのが一番よいというものです。

definitions.definitionEn: To act as a friend to, to befriend; to be friendly to, to help.
To add (a person) to a list of friends on a social networking site; to officially designate (someone) as a friend.
A period into which a year is divided, historically based on the phases of the moon.

example.en: July is my favourite month.
example.ja: 7月は私の大好きな月です。

definitions.definitionEn: A period of 30 days, 31 days, or some alternation thereof.

example.en: We went on holiday for two months.
example.ja: 私たちは 2 か月間休みに行きました。

definitions.definitionEn: (in the plural) A woman's period; menstrual discharge.
An old musical note, equal to two longas, four breves, or eight semibreves.
Liberality, generosity.
(plural: large) A thousand dollars/pounds.

example.en: Getting a car tricked out like that will cost you 50 large.
example.ja: そんなつもりで車を拾うと 50ドルになる

definitions.definitionEn: A large serving of something.

example.en: One small coffee and two larges, please.
example.ja: コーヒーを1杯と大きな2杯を

definitions.definitionEn: Of considerable or relatively great size or extent.

example.en: Russia is a large country.   The fruit-fly has large eyes for its body size.   He has a large collection of stamps.
example.ja: ロシアは大きな国であり、フルーツフライは体の大きさが大きく、切手が大きい。

definitions.definitionEn: Abundant; ample.
Full in statement; diffuse; profuse.
Free; unencumbered.
Unrestrained by decorum; said of language.
Crossing the line of a ship's course in a favorable direction; said of the wind when it is abeam, or between the beam and the quarter.
Before the wind.

example: Small businesses supported the local event.

definitions.definitionEn: A specific commercial enterprise or establishment.

example.en: I was left my father's business.
example.ja: 私は父の商売を去った。

definitions.definitionEn: A person's occupation, work, or trade.

example.en: He is in the motor and insurance businesses.
example.ja: 彼は自動車事業と保険業に従事している。

definitions.definitionEn: Commercial, industrial, or professional activity.

example.en: He's such a poor cook, I can't believe he's still in business!
example.ja: 彼は貧しい料理人なのまだ商売中なんて信じられない!

definitions.definitionEn: The volume or amount of commercial trade.

example.en: Business has been slow lately.
example.ja: 最近、仕事はおそくなっています。

definitions.definitionEn: One's dealings; patronage.

example.en: I shall take my business elsewhere.
example.ja: 他の仕事も引き受ける

definitions.definitionEn: Private commercial interests taken collectively.

example.en: This proposal will satisfy both business and labor.
example.ja: この提案は事業と労働の両方を満足させるものとなるでしょう。

definitions.definitionEn: The management of commercial enterprises, or the study of such management.

example.en: I studied business at Harvard.
example.ja: ハーバードのビジネスを勉強した

definitions.definitionEn: A particular situation or activity.

example.en: This UFO stuff is a mighty strange business.
example.ja: このUFOは、非常に奇妙なビジネスです。

definitions.definitionEn: Any activity or objective needing to be dealt with; especially, one of a financial or legal matter.

example.en: Let's get down to business.
example.ja: 本論に入ろう。

definitions.definitionEn: Something involving one personally.

example.en: That's none of your business.
example.ja: それはあなたの知ったことではありません。

definitions.definitionEn: (parliamentary procedure) Matters that come before a body for deliberation or action.

example.en: If that concludes the announcements, we'll move on to new business.
example.ja: それが発表を終えたときは、新事業に移ります。

definitions.definitionEn: (travel) Business class, the class of seating provided by airlines between first class and coach.
Action carried out with a prop or piece of clothing, usually away from the focus of the scene.
The collective noun for a group of ferrets.
Something very good; top quality. (possibly from "the bee's knees")

example.en: These new phones are the business!
example.ja: この新しい電話はビジネスだ!

definitions.definitionEn: Excrement, particularly that of a non-human animal.

example.en: As the cart went by, its horse lifted its tail and did its business.
example.ja: 荷車が進むにつれて、馬は尾を上げ、商売をしました。

definitions.definitionEn: Of, to, pertaining to or utilized for purposes of conducting trade, commerce, governance, advocacy or other professional purposes.

example.en: Please do not use this phone for personal calls; it is a business phone.

Something that serves as a pattern of behaviour to be imitated (a good example) or not to be imitated (a bad example).

definitions.definitionEn: A proposal that has been made.

example.ja: そして、宿題を手伝ってあげようと言いました。

To place (something) in a position where it can be added to an existing mechanical assembly.
To bid, as a price, reward, or wages.

example.ja: そのために二十ドルを寄付しましたが、会社は年給 3 万ポンド ( 約 240 万円 ) を提供しています。

definitions.definitionEn: To happen, to present itself.
To make an attempt; typically used with at.
To put in opposition to; to manifest in an offensive way; to threaten.

example.ja: 人に暴力をふるう

People who are young; young people, collectively; youth.

definitions.definitionEn: Young or immature offspring (especially of an animal).

example.ja: ライオンはひなにえさを与えようとしてグヌを捕まえました。

definitions.definitionEn: (possibly nonstandard) An individual offspring; a single recently born or hatched organism.

To cause to appear younger.
To exhibit younging.

example.ja: 子羊は若い羊です。

example.ja: 宇宙旅行の年齢は依然として若い。

definitions.definitionEn: (Not) advanced in age; (far towards or) at a specified stage of existence or age.

definitions.definitionEn: Junior (of two related people with the same name).

example.ja: 私の祖母は非常に活発な女性で、年を取るにつれてかなり若い人です。

definitions.definitionEn: Of or belonging to the early part of life.

example.ja: まもなく、皮肉な世界が私の若い夢を打ち砕きました。

definitions.definitionEn: Having little experience; inexperienced; unpracticed; ignorant; weak.

definitions.definitionEn: An end or conclusion.

The conclusion of a strain of music; cadence.
A double bar marking the end.
(travel) The time when checkin staff will no longer accept passengers for a flight.

(social) To finish, to terminate.

Narrow; confined.

example.ja: 家は近くか?

definitions.definitionEn: Intimate; well-loved.

definitions.definitionEn: Oppressive; without motion or ventilation; causing a feeling of lassitude.

definitions.definitionEn: Out of the way of observation; secluded; secret; hidden.

definitions.definitionEn: Short.

definitions.definitionEn: Dense; solid; compact.

definitions.definitionEn: Difficult to obtain.

definitions.definitionEn: Parsimonious; stingy.

example.ja: 近い翻訳

example.ja: 今日の運動クラスのプログラムには、水泳やジョギングが含まれています。

example.ja: 今夜のプログラムはジョニー・カーソンが司会しました。

example.ja: プログラムは Linux と Microsoft Windows の両方で動作します。

example.ja: 彼はDVRをプログラムして彼の好きな番組を記録した

A conical recess or indentation in the end of a shaft or other work, to receive the point of a center, on which the work can turn, as in a lathe.
The ensemble of moderate or centrist political parties.
To cause (an object) to occupy the center of an area.

example.en: He centered the heading of the document.
example.ja: 彼は文書の見出しを中心とした。

definitions.definitionEn: To cause (some attribute, such as a mood or voltage) to be adjusted to a value which is midway between the extremes.
To give (something) a central basis.
To concentrate on (something), to pay close attention to (something).

example.en: The discussion centered around the recent issues.
example.ja: その討論の中心は、最近の論争にありました。

definitions.definitionEn: To form a recess or indentation for the reception of a center.
Of, at, or related to a center.
To become larger, to increase in magnitude.

example.en: Children grow quickly.
example.ja: 子供はすぐに成長します。

definitions.definitionEn: To appear or sprout.

example.en: A long tail began to grow from his backside.
example.ja: 背中から長い尾が生え始めました。

definitions.definitionEn: To develop, to mature.

example.en: As I grew throughout adolescence, I came to appreciate many things about human nature.
example.ja: 私は思春期を迎えてから、人間性について多くのことを認識するようになりました。

definitions.definitionEn: To cause or allow something to become bigger, especially to cultivate plants.

example.en: Have you ever grown your hair before?
example.ja: 前に髪を伸ばしたことある?

definitions.definitionEn: To assume a condition or quality over time.

example.en: The boy grew wise as he matured.
example.ja: 少年は成長するにつれて賢くなりました。

definitions.definitionEn: To become attached or fixed; to adhere.
Something trifling, or of no consequence or importance.
A trivial remark (especially in the term sweet nothings).
A nobody (insignificant person).

example.en: You're nothing to me now!
example.ja: あなたは今私に何もありません!

definitions.definitionEn: Not at all; in no way.
Not any thing; no thing.
An absence of anything, including empty space, brightness, darkness, matter, or a vacuum.
The act of returning.

example.en: I expect the house to be spotless upon my return.
example.ja: 家が滅茶苦茶になるのを期待する

definitions.definitionEn: A return ticket.

example.en: Do you want a one-way or a return?
example.ja: 片道か帰るかどっちがいい?

definitions.definitionEn: An item that is returned, e.g. due to a defect, or the act of returning it.

example.en: Last year there were 250 returns of this product, an improvement on the 500 returns the year before.
example.ja: 昨年は 250 回のこの製品の返還があったので、前年に 500 回の快復がありました。

definitions.definitionEn: An answer.

example.en: a return to one's question
example.ja: 問へ帰す。

definitions.definitionEn: An account, or formal report, of an action performed, of a duty discharged, of facts or statistics, etc.; especially, in the plural, a set of tabulated statistics prepared for general information.

example.en: election returns; a return of the amount of goods produced or sold
example.ja: 配当金の返還;生産された商品の返還

definitions.definitionEn: Gain or loss from an investment.

example.en: It yielded a return of 5%.
example.ja: 5%のリターンだ

definitions.definitionEn: : A report of income submitted to a government for purposes of specifying exact tax payment amounts. A tax return.

example.en: Hand in your return by the end of the tax year.
example.ja: 税年末までに返還を

definitions.definitionEn: A carriage return character.
The act of relinquishing control to the calling procedure.
A return value: the data passed back from a called procedure.
A return pipe, returning fluid to a boiler or other central plant (compare with flow pipe, which carries liquid away from central plant).

example.en: The boiler technician had to cut out the heating return to access the safety valve.
example.ja: ボイラーの技術者は、安全弁に近づくため、暖房装置を切り出さなければなりませんでした。

definitions.definitionEn: A short perpendicular extension of a desk, usually slightly lower.
Catching a ball after a punt and running it back towards the opposing team.
A throw from a fielder to the wicket-keeper or to another fielder at the wicket.

The continuation in a different direction, most often at a right angle, of a building, face of a building, or any member, such as a moulding; applied to the shorter in contradistinction to the longer.

example.en: A facade of sixty feet east and west has a return of twenty feet north and south.
example.ja: 東と西の面影には、北と南が約 30 メートル戻ってきます。

definitions.definitionEn: To come or go back (to a place or person).

example.en: Although the birds fly north for the summer, they return here in winter.
example.ja: この鳥は夏の間北に飛びますが、冬になるとここに戻って来ます。

definitions.definitionEn: To go back in thought, narration, or argument.

example.en: To return to my story [...]
example.ja: 私の話に戻るために...

definitions.definitionEn: To turn back, retreat.
To turn (something) round.
To place or put back something where it had been.

example.en: Please return your hands to your lap.
example.ja: 手は膝に返して

definitions.definitionEn: To give something back to its original holder or owner.

example.en: You should return the library book within one month.
example.ja: ライブラリブックを1か月以内に返す必要があります。

definitions.definitionEn: To take back something to a vendor for a refund.

example.en: If the goods don't work, you can return them.
example.ja: 商品が効かなければ返却できる

definitions.definitionEn: To give in requital or recompense; to requite.
To bat the ball back over the net in response to a serve.

example.en: The player couldn't return the serve because it was so fast.
example.ja: プレーヤーは早かったからサービスを返せなかった。

definitions.definitionEn: To play a card as a result of another player's lead.

example.en: If one players plays a trump, the others must return a trump.
example.ja: もし一人の選手がごまかしをするなら、他の選手はごまかすことをしなければなりません。

definitions.definitionEn: To throw a ball back to the wicket-keeper (or a fielder at that position) from somewhere in the field.
To say in reply; to respond.

example.en: to return an answer;  to return thanks;  "Do it yourself!" she returned.
example.ja: 答:感謝を返そう" "自分でやれ!"と彼女は返事した。

definitions.definitionEn: To relinquish control to the calling procedure.
To pass (data) back to the calling procedure.

example.en: This function returns the number of files in the directory.
example.ja: この関数は、ディレクトリ内のファイル番号を返します。

definitions.definitionEn: To retort; to throw back.

example.en: to return the lie
example.ja: を入力すると、

definitions.definitionEn: To report, or bring back and make known.

example.en: to return the result of an election
example.ja: をクリックして、

definitions.definitionEn: (by extension) To elect according to the official report of the election officers.
A (human) female who has given birth to a baby

example.en: He had something of his mother in him.
example.ja: 彼は母親の何かを持っていた

definitions.definitionEn: A human female who parents an adopted or fostered child
A human female who donates a fertilized egg or donates a body cell which has resulted in a clone.
A pregnant female, possibly as a shortened form of mother-to-be.

example.en: Nutrients and oxygen obtained by the mother are conveyed to the fetus.
example.ja: 母親が得た栄養素と酸素は胎児に送られます。

definitions.definitionEn: A female parent of an animal.

example.en: The lioness was a mother of four cubs.
example.ja: 雌ライオンは 4 匹の子グマの母でした。

definitions.definitionEn: A female ancestor.
A source or origin.

example.en: The Mediterranean was mother to many cultures and languages.
example.ja: 地中海は様々な文化や言語の母国でした。

definitions.definitionEn: Something that is the greatest or most significant of its kind. (See mother of all.)
(when followed by a surname) A title of respect for one's mother-in-law.

example.en: Mother Smith, meet my cousin, Doug Jones.
example.ja: スミス母さんいとこのダグ・ジョーンズだ

definitions.definitionEn: Any elderly woman, especially within a particular community.
Any person or entity which performs mothering.
The principal piece of an astrolabe, into which the others are fixed.
The female superior or head of a religious house; an abbess, etc.
Hysterical passion; hysteria; the uterus.
To give birth to or produce (as its female parent) a child. (Compare father.)
To treat as a mother would be expected to treat her child; to nurture.

A stringy, mucilaginous or film- or membrane-like substance (consisting of acetobacters) which develops in fermenting alcoholic liquids (such as wine, or cider), and turns the alcohol into acetic acid with the help of oxygen from the air.

example.en: pieces of mother, adding mother to vinegar
example.ja: 酢を加えた母親の破片

definitions.definitionEn: To cause to contain mother.

example.en: mothered oil / vinegar / wine
example.ja: 母油 / 酢 / ぶどう酒

definitions.definitionEn: (of an alcohol) To develop mother.
Motherfucker.
A striking example.
A person (especially an entomologist) or animal that catches moths.
To move on the feet by alternately setting each foot (or pair or group of feet, in the case of animals with four or more feet) forward, with at least one foot on the ground at all times. Compare run.

example.en: To walk briskly for an hour every day is to keep fit.
example.ja: 毎日、 1 時間、きびきびと歩いてゆくのは、健康を保つことです。

definitions.definitionEn: To "walk free", i.e. to win, or avoid, a criminal court case, particularly when actually guilty.

example.en: If you can’t present a better case, that robber is going to walk.
example.ja: もっと良い事件を提出できないと、強盗は歩き回ります。

definitions.definitionEn: Of an object, to go missing or be stolen.

example.en: If you leave your wallet lying around, it’s going to walk.
example.ja: 財布を横にしたままにしておくと、歩いて行きます。

definitions.definitionEn: (of a batsman) To walk off the field, as if given out, after the fielding side appeals and before the umpire has ruled; done as a matter of sportsmanship when the batsman believes he is out.
To travel (a distance) by walking.

example.en: I walk two miles to school every day.  The museum’s not far from here – you can walk it.
example.ja: 毎日2マイルも学校まで歩いていく。博物館は遠くない。

definitions.definitionEn: To take for a walk or accompany on a walk.

example.en: I walk the dog every morning.  Will you walk me home?
example.ja: 毎朝犬を歩くから家まで案内してくれる?

definitions.definitionEn: To allow a batter to reach base by pitching four balls.
To move something by shifting between two positions, as if it were walking.

example.en: I carefully walked the ladder along the wall.
example.ja: 私は壁に沿ってはしごを注意深く歩きました。

definitions.definitionEn: To full; to beat cloth to give it the consistency of felt.
To traverse by walking (or analogous gradual movement).

example.en: I walked the streets aimlessly.   Debugging this computer program involved walking the heap.
example.ja: このコンピュータプログラムをデバッグすると

definitions.definitionEn: To operate the left and right throttles of (an aircraft) in alternation.
To leave, resign.

example.en: If we don't offer him more money he'll walk.
example.ja: もっと金を出さなければ彼は歩くだろう

definitions.definitionEn: To push (a vehicle) alongside oneself as one walks.
To behave; to pursue a course of life; to conduct oneself.
To be stirring; to be abroad; to go restlessly about; said of things or persons expected to remain quiet, such as a sleeping person, or the spirit of a dead person.
To be in motion; to act; to move.
To put, keep, or train (a puppy) in a walk, or training area for dogfighting.
(hotel) To move a guest to another hotel if their confirmed reservation is not available on day of check-in.
A trip made by walking.

example.en: I take a walk every morning
example.ja: 私は毎朝散歩します。

definitions.definitionEn: A distance walked.

example.en: It’s a long walk from my house to the library
example.ja: 私の家から図書館への長い歩き方

definitions.definitionEn: An Olympic Games track event requiring that the heel of the leading foot touch the ground before the toe of the trailing foot leaves the ground.
A manner of walking; a person's style of walking.

example.en: The Ministry of Silly Walks is underfunded this year
example.ja: シャイリーウォーク省は今年は資金不足です

definitions.definitionEn: A path, sidewalk/pavement or other maintained place on which to walk. Compare trail.
A situation where all players fold to the big blind, as their first action (instead of calling or raising), once they get their cards.
An award of first base to a batter following four balls being thrown by the pitcher; known in the rules as a "base on balls".

example.en: The pitcher now has two walks in this inning alone
example.ja: ピッチャーは今、このインサイダーで 2つの歩み

definitions.definitionEn: In coffee, coconut, and other plantations, the space between them.
(Belize) An area of an estate planted with fruit-bearing trees.
A place for keeping and training puppies for dogfighting.
An enclosed area in which a gamecock is confined to prepare him for fighting.
A sequence of alternating vertices and edges, where each edge's endpoints are the preceding and following vertices in the sequence.
Something very easily accomplished; a walk in the park.
A cheque drawn on a bank that was not a member of the London Clearing and whose sort code was allocated on a one-off basis; they had to be "walked" (hand-delivered by messengers).
Substance, material.
A condition, subject or affair, especially one of concern.

example.en: What's the matter?;   state matters
example.ja: 何が問題なの?

definitions.definitionEn: An approximate amount or extent.

example.en: I stayed for a matter of months.
example.ja: 私は数か月間滞在しました。

definitions.definitionEn: The essence; the pith; the embodiment.
Inducing cause or reason, especially of anything disagreeable or distressing.
Pus.
To be important.

example.en: Sorry for pouring ketchup on your clean white shirt! - Oh, don't worry, it does not matter.
example.ja: 綺麗な白シャツにケチャップを注がせてごめんなさい!

definitions.definitionEn: (in negative constructions) To care about, to mind; to find important.
To form pus or matter, as an abscess; to maturate.

meaning: 〈U〉(思考・知覚・意志などをつかさどる)心,精神 / 〈C〉《単数形で》(心の働きによって生じた)知性,理性,理解力 / 〈U〉正常な精神状態,正気 / 〈C〉意見,考え方,物の見方 / 〈U〉記憶,回想 / 《one's~》注意,精神の集中 / 〈C〉《単数形で》願い,意向 / 〈C〉《前に形容詞を伴って》(…を備えた)人 / 《しばしば命令文で》…に注意する,用心する / …の番をする,世話をする(look after) / 〈人,助言など〉の言うことを聞く,に従う / 《否定・疑問・条件文で》…を気にする,気にかける,いやだと思う / 《疑問文・否定文で》気にする,心配する,いやに思う

definitions.definitionEn: The ability for rational thought.

example.en: Despite advancing age, his mind was still as sharp as ever.
example.ja: 年を取っていたにもかかわらず、彼の思いは依然として鋭かったのです。

definitions.definitionEn: The ability to be aware of things.

example.en: There was no doubt in his mind that they would win.
example.ja: 彼らが勝利を収めることに疑問の余地はありませんでした。

definitions.definitionEn: The ability to remember things.

example.en: My mind just went blank.
example.ja: 頭が空くなった

definitions.definitionEn: The ability to focus the thoughts.

example.en: I can’t keep my mind on what I’m doing.
example.ja: 自分のしていることを頭の中で考えることができません。

definitions.definitionEn: Somebody that embodies certain mental qualities.

example.en: He was one of history’s greatest minds.
example.ja: 彼は歴史上最も偉大な人の一人でした。

definitions.definitionEn: Judgment, opinion, or view.

example.en: He changed his mind after hearing the speech.
example.ja: 話を聞いた後、考えを変えました。

definitions.definitionEn: Desire, inclination, or intention.

example.en: I am of a mind to listen.
example.ja: 私は耳を傾ける心がある。

definitions.definitionEn: A healthy mental state.

example.en: I, ______ being of sound mind and body, do hereby [...]
example.ja: I, ___ 健全な精神と身体であることは、書きかけです。

definitions.definitionEn: The non-material substance or set of processes in which consciousness, perception, affectivity, judgement, thinking, and will are based.

example.en: The mind is a process of the brain.
example.ja: 心は脳のプロセスである。

definitions.definitionEn: Continual prayer on a dead person's behalf for a period after their death.

example.en: a month's [or monthly] mind; a year's mind
example.ja: 而して、一月一月の精神、一年の精神。

definitions.definitionEn: (originally and chiefly in negative or interrogative constructions) To dislike, to object to; to be bothered by.

example.en: Do you mind if I smoke?
example.ja: タバコを吸ってもよろしいですか。

definitions.definitionEn: To look after, to take care of, especially for a short period of time.

example.en: Would you mind my bag for me?
example.ja: バッグをくれないか?

definitions.definitionEn: (chiefly in the imperative) To make sure, to take care (that).

example.en: Mind you don't knock that glass over.
example.ja: ガラスを叩かないでくれ

definitions.definitionEn: To be careful about.
Take note; used to point out an exception or caveat.

example.en: I'm not very healthy. I do eat fruit sometimes, mind.
example.ja: 俺は健康じゃない時々フルーツを食べるんだ

definitions.definitionEn: To attend to, concern oneself with, heed, be mindful of.

example.en: You should mind your own business.
example.ja: 君は自分の仕事に専心すべきだ。

definitions.definitionEn: To remember.
To have in mind; to intend.
To put in mind; to remind.

example: The study compares what different age groups value.

definitions.definitionEn: The quality (positive or negative) that renders something desirable or valuable.

example.en: The Shakespearean Shylock is of dubious value in the modern world.
example.ja: シェークスピアのシャイロックは現代の世界では不可解な価値があります。

definitions.definitionEn: The degree of importance given to something.

example.en: The value of my children's happiness is second only to that of my wife.
example.ja: 子供の幸福の価値は、妻の幸福に限る。

definitions.definitionEn: That which is valued or highly esteemed, such as one's morals, morality, or belief system.

example.en: He does not share his parents' values.
example.ja: 彼は親の価値観を共有していない。

definitions.definitionEn: The amount (of money or goods or services) that is considered to be a fair equivalent for something else.
The relative duration of a musical note.

example.en: The value of a crotchet is twice that of a quaver.
example.ja: クロッチェットの値はクワバーの 2 倍にもなります。

definitions.definitionEn: The relative darkness or lightness of a color in (a specific area of) a painting etc.
Any definite numerical quantity or other mathematical object, determined by being measured, computed, or otherwise defined.

example.en: The exact value of pi cannot be represented in decimal notation.
example.ja: 円周率の正確な値は小数では説明できません。

definitions.definitionEn: Precise meaning; import.

example.en: the value of a word; the value of a legal instrument
example.ja: 一語の価値; 法律上の道具の価値

definitions.definitionEn: (in the plural) The valuable ingredients to be obtained by treating a mass or compound; specifically, the precious metals contained in rock, gravel, etc.

example.en: The vein carries good values.
example.ja: 静脈には良い価値観があります。

definitions.definitionEn: Esteem; regard.
Valour; also spelled valew.
To estimate the value of; judge the worth of something.

example.en: I will have the family jewels valued by a professional.
example.ja: プロとして評価される家族の宝品を

definitions.definitionEn: To fix or determine the value of; assign a value to, as of jewelry or art work.
To regard highly; think much of; place importance upon.

example.en: Gold was valued highly among the Romans.
example.ja: 金はローマ人の間で高く評価されていました。

definitions.definitionEn: To hold dear.

example.en: I value these old photographs.
example.ja: この古い写真は評価する

definitions.definitionEn: A ceremonial duty or service, particularly:
A position of responsibility.

example.en: When the office of Secretary of State is vacant, its duties fall upon an official within the department.
example.ja: 国務長官の職務が空しくなれば、その職務は、当該省内の職員に課せられる。

definitions.definitionEn: Official position, particularly high employment within government; tenure in such a position.

example.en: She held office as secretary of state until she left office to run for office.
example.ja: 彼女は国務長官として事務を執り、事務所を出頭して事務に就いた。

definitions.definitionEn: An official or group of officials; a personification of officeholders.
A duty, particularly owing to one's position or station; a charge, trust, or role; moral duty.
The performance of a duty; an instance of performing a duty.
Function: anything typically done by or expected of something.
A bodily function, urination and defecation; an act of urination or defecation.
(now usually in plural) A service, a kindness.
Inside information.
A room, set of rooms, or building used for non-manual work, particularly:

example.en: The office of the Secretary of State is cleaned when it is vacant.
example.ja: 国務長官の事務は、空いているときは掃除される。

definitions.definitionEn: The staff of such places.

example.en: The whole office was there... well, except you, of course.
example.ja: 事務所はそこだったもちろん君を除いてね

definitions.definitionEn: (in large organizations) The administrative departments housed in such places, particularly:

example.en: He's from our public relations office.
example.ja: 広報局の者だ

definitions.definitionEn: (now in the plural) The parts of a house or estate devoted to manual work and storage, as the kitchen, scullery, laundry, stables, etc., particularly a house or estate's facilities for urination and defecation: outhouses or lavatories.
Clipping of inquest of office: an inquest undertaken on occasions when the Crown claimed the right of possession to land or property.
A piece of land used for hunting; the area of land overseen by a gamekeeper.
A hangout: a place where one is normally found.
A plane's cockpit, particularly an observer's cockpit.
A collection of business software typically including a word processor and spreadsheet and slideshow programs.
To provide (someone) with an office.
To have an office.
A disk, usually made of a polymer, used to record sound for playback on a phonograph.
An item of information put into a temporary or permanent physical medium.

example.en: The person had a record of the interview so she could review her notes.
example.ja: その人は自分のノートを見直すことができるよう、インタビューの記録を持っていました。

definitions.definitionEn: Any instance of a physical medium on which information was put for the purpose of preserving it and making it available for future reference.

example.en: We have no record of you making this payment to us.
example.ja: この支払いの記録はない

definitions.definitionEn: A set of data relating to a single individual or item.
The most extreme known value of some variable, particularly that of an achievement in competitive events.

example.en: The heat and humidity were both new records.
example.ja: 熱も湿気も新しい記録だった。

definitions.definitionEn: To make a record of information.

example.en: I wanted to record every detail of what happened, for the benefit of future generations.
example.ja: 将来の世代のために起きたことを詳細に記録したかったのです

definitions.definitionEn: To make an audio or video recording of.

example.en: Within a week they had recorded both the song and the video for it.
example.ja: 1 週間もしないうちに、二人は歌とビデオの両方を録音しました。

definitions.definitionEn: To give legal status to by making an official public record.

example.en: When the deed was recorded, we officially owned the house.
example.ja: 供述書が記録されたときは、正式にその家を所有していた。

definitions.definitionEn: To fix in a medium, usually in a tangible medium.
To make an audio, video, or multimedia recording.
To repeat; to practice.
To sing or repeat a tune.
To reflect; to ponder.
Continuance or a period of time spent in a place; abode for an indefinite time; sojourn.

example.en: I hope you enjoyed your stay in Hawaii.
example.ja: ハワイでの滞在をお楽しみください

definitions.definitionEn: A postponement, especially of an execution or other punishment.

example.en: The governor granted a stay of execution.
example.ja: 知事は執行猶予を許可した。

definitions.definitionEn: A stop; a halt; a break or cessation of action, motion, or progress.

example.en: stand at a stay
example.ja: 留置所に立って

definitions.definitionEn: A fixed state; fixedness; stability; permanence.
A station or fixed anchorage for vessels.
Restraint of passion; prudence; moderation; caution; steadiness; sobriety.
Hindrance; let; check.
To prop; support; sustain; hold up; steady.
To support from sinking; to sustain with strength; to satisfy in part or for the time.
To stop; detain; keep back; delay; hinder.
To restrain; withhold; check; stop.
To cause to cease; to put an end to.
To put off; defer; postpone; delay; keep back.

definitions.definitionEn: Any more urbanized center than the place of reference.

example.ja: ヨーカーズでそれから今夜ニックスを見に行く

definitions.definitionEn: A rural settlement in which a market was held at least once a week.
The residents (as opposed to gown: the students, faculty, etc.) of a community which is the site of a university.
Used to refer to a town or similar entity under discussion.

example.en: Call me when you get to town.
example.ja: 町に着いたら電話して

definitions.definitionEn: A major city, especially one where the speaker is located.
A municipal organization, such as a corporation, defined by the laws of the entity of which it is a part.
An enclosure which surrounded the mere homestead or dwelling of the lord of the manor.
The whole of the land which constituted the domain.
A collection of houses enclosed by fences or walls.
A farm or farmstead; also, a court or farmyard.
One of two usually roughly equal parts into which anything may be divided, or considered as divided.

example.en: I ate the slightly smaller half of the apple.
example.ja: リンゴの少し小さい半分を食べた。

definitions.definitionEn: Half of a standard measure; frequently used for half a pint of beer or cider.
(preceded by “a” or a number) The fraction obtained by dividing 1 by 2.

example.en: Three-quarters minus a quarter is a half.
example.ja: 4分の3 ひく 4 分の 1 は 2 分の 1 です。

definitions.definitionEn: Part; side; behalf.
Any of the three terms at Eton College, for Michaelmas, Lent, and summer.
A half sibling.
A child ticket.
To halve.
Consisting of a half (1/2, 50%).

example.en: a half bushel; a half hour; a half dollar; a half view
example.ja: (2018年12月25日). http://www.oricon.co.jp/articles/news/2018/2017/ 2018年2月30日閲覧. ^ ""小林,30分半、半蔵、半沢".

definitions.definitionEn: Consisting of some indefinite portion resembling a half; approximately a half, whether more or less; partial; imperfect.

example.en: a half dream; half knowledge
example.ja: 半分の夢、半蔵の知知。

definitions.definitionEn: (of a sibling) Having one parent (rather than two) in common.
(rare, of a relative other than a sibling) Related through one common grandparent or ancestor rather than two.
In two equal parts or to an equal degree.
In some part approximating a half.
Partially; imperfectly.

example.en: He does sometimes half wish to change his life, but it is too difficult.
example.ja: しかし、それはあまりにも難しいことです。

definitions.definitionEn: A half-hour after, thirty minutes after (used with the number of the hour).

example.en: half one
example.ja: 半分

definitions.definitionEn: A unit of time equal to sixty seconds (one-sixtieth of an hour).

example.en: You have twenty minutes to complete the test.
example.ja: 合格まで20分

definitions.definitionEn: A short but unspecified time period.

example.en: Wait a minute, I’m not ready yet!
example.ja: ちょっと待って、まだ準備ができていません。

definitions.definitionEn: A unit of angle equal to one-sixtieth of a degree.

example.en: We need to be sure these maps are accurate to within one minute of arc.
example.ja: この地図が1分以内に正確か確認する必要がある

definitions.definitionEn: (chiefly in the plural, minutes) A (usually formal) written record of a meeting or a part of a meeting.

example.en: Let’s look at the minutes of last week’s meeting.
example.ja: 先週の集会の時間を見てみましょう。

definitions.definitionEn: A unit of purchase on a telephone or other network, especially a cell phone network, roughly equivalent in gross form to sixty seconds' use of the network.

example.en: If you buy this phone, you’ll get 100 free minutes.
example.ja: この電話を買うなら、 100 分間無料で買えるでしょう。

definitions.definitionEn: A point in time; a moment.
A nautical or a geographic mile.
An old coin, a half farthing.
A very small part of anything, or anything very small; a jot; a whit.
A fixed part of a module.
A while or a long unspecified period of time

example.en: Oh, I ain't heard that song in a minute!
example.ja: ああ、私はすぐにその曲を聴いたことはありません!

definitions.definitionEn: Of an event, to write in a memo or the minutes of a meeting.

example.en: I’ll minute this evening’s meeting.
example.ja: 夕方の集会に出席します。

definitions.definitionEn: To set down a short sketch or note of; to jot down; to make a minute or a brief summary of.
Very small.

example.en: They found only minute quantities of chemical residue on his clothing.
example.ja: 彼らは彼の服にほんのわずかばかりの化学的残留物を見つけた

definitions.definitionEn: Very careful and exact, giving small details.

example.en: The lawyer gave the witness a minute examination.
example.ja: 弁護士は証人を少し調べてみました。

definitions.definitionEn: Any solid substance that can be consumed by living organisms, especially by eating, in order to sustain life.

example.en: The innkeeper brought them food and drink.
example.ja: 宿人は、かれらに食料や飲み物を支給した。

definitions.definitionEn: A foodstuff.
Anything that nourishes or sustains.

example.en: Mozart and Bach are food for my soul.
example.ja: モーツァルトとバッハは僕の魂の糧だ

definitions.definitionEn: An instance of breaking something into two or more pieces.

example.en: The femur has a clean break and so should heal easily.
example.ja: 頸部はきれいな裂け目を持っているので、すぐに治ります。

definitions.definitionEn: A physical space that opens up in something or between two things.

example.en: He waited minutes for a break in the traffic to cross the highway.
example.ja: その人は、高速道路を横切ろうとして往来で休憩するのを何分か待っていました。

definitions.definitionEn: A rest or pause, usually from work.

example.en: Let’s take a five-minute break.
example.ja: 5分休憩しよう。

definitions.definitionEn: A time for students to talk or play.
A short holiday.

example.en: a weekend break on the Isle of Wight
example.ja: ウィト島での週末の休憩

definitions.definitionEn: A temporary split with a romantic partner.

example.en: I think we need a break.
example.ja: 休憩が必要だな

definitions.definitionEn: An interval or intermission between two parts of a performance, for example a theatre show, broadcast, or sports game.
A significant change in circumstance, attitude, perception, or focus of attention.

example.en: big break
example.ja: 大きな休憩

definitions.definitionEn: The beginning (of the morning).

example.en: at the break of day
example.ja: 日が暮れて,

definitions.definitionEn: An act of escaping.

example.en: It was a clean break.
example.ja: 綺麗な休暇だった

definitions.definitionEn: The separation between lines, paragraphs or pages of a written text.
A keystroke or other signal that causes a program to terminate or suspend execution.
A point or condition in a program at which operation may be suspended during debugging so that the state of the program at that point can be investigated. A breakpoint.
A change, particularly the end of a spell of persistent good or bad weather.
A large four-wheeled carriage, having a straight body and calash top, with the driver's seat in front and the footman's behind.
(equitation) A sharp bit or snaffle.
A short section of music, often between verses, in which some performers stop while others continue.

example.en: The fiddle break was amazing; it was a pity the singer came back in on the wrong note.
example.ja: 歌手が間違った音色で戻って来た。 "あなたは、この曲を聴いていない、"彼は言った。

definitions.definitionEn: The point in the musical scale at which a woodwind instrument is designed to overblow, that is, to move from its lower to its upper register.

example.en: Crossing the break smoothly is one of the first lessons the young clarinettist needs to master.
example.ja: 休みを円滑に交差させるのは、若いクラリネット選手が習得しなければならない最初のレッスンの一つです。

definitions.definitionEn: Usu. plural An area along a river that features steep banks, bluffs, or gorges (e.g., Upper Missouri River Breaks National Monument, US).
To separate into two or more pieces, to fracture or crack, by a process that cannot easily be reversed for reassembly.

example.en: If the vase falls to the floor, it might break.
example.ja: 花瓶が床に落ちたら、割れてしまうかもしれない。

definitions.definitionEn: To divide (something, often money) into smaller units.

example.en: Can you break a hundred-dollar bill for me?
example.ja: 100ドル札を破れるか?

definitions.definitionEn: To cause (a person or animal) to lose spirit or will; to crush the spirits of.

example.en: Her child's death broke Angela.
example.ja: 彼女の子供の死はアンジェラを壊した

definitions.definitionEn: To be crushed, or overwhelmed with sorrow or grief.

example.en: My heart is breaking.
example.ja: 心が壊れてる

definitions.definitionEn: To interrupt; to destroy the continuity of; to dissolve or terminate.

example.en: I had won four games in a row, but now you've broken my streak of luck.
example.ja: 4試合連続で優勝したが今度は運が尽きた

definitions.definitionEn: To ruin financially.

example.en: The recession broke some small businesses.
example.ja: 不況は幾つかの小さな事業を破綻させました。

definitions.definitionEn: To violate, to not adhere to.

example.en: He broke his vows by cheating on his wife.
example.ja: 妻をだまして誓いを破ったのです。

definitions.definitionEn: (of a fever) To pass the most dangerous part of the illness; to go down, in terms of temperature.

example.en: Susan's fever broke at about 3 AM, and the doctor said the worst was over.
example.ja: スーザンの熱は午前3時頃に破裂し、医者は最悪の事態が終わったと云った。

definitions.definitionEn: (of a spell of settled weather) To end.

example.en: The forecast says the hot weather will break by midweek.
example.ja: 天気予報によると、週中は暑さが減る。

definitions.definitionEn: (of a storm) To begin; to end.

example.en: Around midday the storm broke, and the afternoon was calm and sunny.
example.ja: 真昼ごろには嵐が起こり、午後は静まり返って陽光が降りました。

definitions.definitionEn: (of morning, dawn, day etc.) To arrive.

example.en: Morning has broken.
example.ja: 午前中は壊れた。

definitions.definitionEn: To render (a game) unchallenging by altering its rules or exploiting loopholes or weaknesses in them in a way that gives a player an unfair advantage.

example.en: Changing the rules to let white have three extra queens would break chess.
example.ja: ルールを変更すれば 3人の女王がチェスを破る

definitions.definitionEn: To stop, or to cause to stop, functioning properly or altogether.

example.en: Did you two break the trolley by racing with it?
example.ja: 競走で二人が敗れたのか?

definitions.definitionEn: To cause (a barrier) to no longer bar.

example.en: break a seal
example.ja: 封印を破る

definitions.definitionEn: To destroy the arrangement of; to throw into disorder; to pierce.

example.en: The cavalry were not able to break the British squares.
example.ja: 騎兵は英国の広場を崩すことができませんでした。

definitions.definitionEn: (of a wave of water) To collapse into surf, after arriving in shallow water.
To burst forth; to make its way; to come into view.
To interrupt or cease one's work or occupation temporarily.

example.en: Let's break for lunch.
example.ja: 昼食に休みましょう

definitions.definitionEn: To interrupt (a fall) by inserting something so that the falling object does not (immediately) hit something else beneath.

example.en: He survived the jump out the window because the bushes below broke his fall.
example.ja: 彼は窓から飛び降りて生き延びた。下の茂みが落ちたから。

definitions.definitionEn: To disclose or make known an item of news, etc.

example.en: I don't know how to break this to you, but your cat is not coming back.
example.ja: どう壊せば良いか分からないが、君の猫は戻ってこない。

definitions.definitionEn: (of a sound) To become audible suddenly.
To change a steady state abruptly.

example.en: His coughing broke the silence.
example.ja: 咳は沈黙を破りました。

definitions.definitionEn: To suddenly become.

example.en: The arrest was standard, when suddenly the suspect broke ugly.
example.ja: 逮捕は基準にかなっていました。

definitions.definitionEn: Of a male voice, to become deeper at puberty.
Of a voice, to alter in type due to emotion or strain: in men generally to go up, in women sometimes to go down; to crack.

example.en: His voice breaks when he gets emotional.
example.ja: 彼の声は感情に駆られると壊れる。

definitions.definitionEn: To surpass or do better than (a specific number), to do better than (a record), setting a new record.

example.en: He broke the men's 100-meter record.
example.ja: 彼は男性100メートルの記録を破りました

definitions.definitionEn: (most often in the passive tense) To demote, to reduce the military rank of.
To end (a connection), to disconnect.

example.en: I couldn't hear a thing he was saying, so I broke the connection and called him back.
example.ja: 彼が言っていることが聞こえなかったから彼とのつながりを破って電話したの

definitions.definitionEn: (of an emulsion) To demulsify.
To counter-attack
To lay open, as a purpose; to disclose, divulge, or communicate.
To become weakened in constitution or faculties; to lose health or strength.
To fail in business; to become bankrupt.
To destroy the strength, firmness, or consistency of.

example.en: to break flax
example.ja: 亜麻を砕く

definitions.definitionEn: To destroy the official character and standing of; to cashier; to dismiss.
To make an abrupt or sudden change; to change the gait.

example.en: to break into a run or gallop
example.ja: クイズにジャンプ

definitions.definitionEn: To fall out; to terminate friendship.
To terminate the execution of a program before normal completion.
To suspend the execution of a program during debugging so that the state of the program can be investigated.
A section of extended repetition of the percussion break to a song, created by a hip-hop DJ as rhythmic dance music.

example: The graph shows a clear difference between the groups.

definitions.definitionEn: Full extent; distance between extreme limits; especially; the distance between the nearest surfaces of two bodies, or the space between walls.

example.en: a room ten feet square in the clear
example.ja: 平板に10フィート四方の部屋

definitions.definitionEn: The completion of a stage or challenge, or of the whole game.
A person who is free from the influence of engrams.
To remove obstructions, impediments or other unwanted items from.

example.en: If you clear the table, I'll wash up.
example.ja: テーブルを片付けたら洗うよ

definitions.definitionEn: To remove (items or material) so as to leave something unobstructed or open.

example.en: Please clear all this stuff off the table.
example.ja: テーブルから片付けてくれ

definitions.definitionEn: To become free from obstruction or obscurement; to become transparent.

example.en: After a heavy rain, the sky cleared nicely for the evening.
example.ja: 大雨の後、空は晩のためによく晴れました。

definitions.definitionEn: To eliminate ambiguity or doubt from (a matter); to clarify or resolve; to clear up.

example.en: We need to clear this issue once and for all.
example.ja: 我々は、この問題を一旦全部解決する必要がある。

definitions.definitionEn: To remove from suspicion, especially of having committed a crime.

example.en: The court cleared the man of murder.
example.ja: 裁判所は殺人の容疑を晴らせた。

definitions.definitionEn: To pass without interference; to miss.

example.en: The door just barely clears the table as it closes.
example.ja: ドアが閉まるとテーブルはほとんど掃除されません。

definitions.definitionEn: (activities such as jumping or throwing) To exceed a stated mark.

example.en: She was the first female high jumper to clear two metres.
example.ja: 彼女は、 2 メートルほど離れた場所に最初に跳躍した女性です。

definitions.definitionEn: To finish or complete (a stage, challenge, or game).

example.en: I cleared the first level in 36 seconds.
example.ja: 36秒で最初のレベルを片付けた

definitions.definitionEn: Of a check or financial transaction, to go through as payment; to be processed so that the money is transferred.

example.en: The check might not clear for a couple of days.
example.ja: 数日は検査をしないかも

definitions.definitionEn: To earn a profit of; to net.

example.en: He's been clearing seven thousand a week.
example.ja: 週に7千を掃除してる

definitions.definitionEn: To approve or authorise for a particular purpose or action; to give clearance to.

example.en: Air traffic control cleared the plane to land.
example.ja: 飛行機は管制によって着陸することができました。

definitions.definitionEn: To obtain approval or authorisation in respect of.

example.en: I've cleared the press release with the marketing department, so go ahead and publish it.
example.ja: マーケティング部門でプレスリリースを発表しましたので、それを公開してください。

definitions.definitionEn: To obtain a clearance.

example.en: The steamer cleared for Liverpool today.
example.ja: 今日リバプールは蒸気機で治った

definitions.definitionEn: To obtain permission to use (a sample of copyrighted audio) in another track.
To disengage oneself from incumbrances, distress, or entanglements; to become free.
To hit, kick, head, punch etc. (a ball, puck) away in order to defend one's goal.

example.en: A low cross came in, and Smith cleared.
example.ja: 低い十字架が入って来て、スミスは始末しました。

definitions.definitionEn: To reset or unset; to return to an empty state or to zero.

example.en: to clear an array;  to clear a single bit (binary digit) in a value
example.ja: を選択して、行列をクリアします。値内の 1 ビット (二桁の数字) をクリアします。

definitions.definitionEn: To style (an element within a document) so that it is not permitted to float at a given position.
Transparent in colour.

example.en: as clear as crystal
example.ja: 澄みきった水晶体

definitions.definitionEn: Bright, not dark or obscured.

example.en: Congress passed the President’s Clear Skies legislation.
example.ja: 議会は、大統領のクリアスキーの法律を可決した。

definitions.definitionEn: Free of obstacles.

example.en: The coast is clear.
example.ja: 海岸はクリアだ

definitions.definitionEn: Without clouds.

example.en: clear weather; a clear day
example.ja: 晴れた日、澄んだ日

definitions.definitionEn: Of the sky, such that less than one eighth of its area is obscured by clouds.
Free of ambiguity or doubt.

example.en: Do I make myself clear? Crystal clear.
example.ja: ハッキリさせるか?

definitions.definitionEn: Distinct, sharp, well-marked.
Free of guilt, or suspicion.

example.en: a clear conscience
example.ja: 明確な良心

definitions.definitionEn: (of a soup) Without a thickening ingredient.
Possessing little or no perceptible stimulus.

example.en: clear of texture;  clear of odor
example.ja: テクスチャーのクリア; 匂いのクリア

definitions.definitionEn: Free from the influence of engrams; see Clear (Scientology).
Able to perceive clearly; keen; acute; penetrating; discriminating.

example.en: a clear intellect; a clear head
example.ja: 英知に満ちた、明瞭に言い表わす者である。

definitions.definitionEn: Not clouded with passion; serene; cheerful.
Easily or distinctly heard; audible.
Unmixed; entirely pure.

example.en: clear sand
example.ja: 澄み切った砂

definitions.definitionEn: Without defects or blemishes, such as freckles or knots.

example.en: a clear complexion; clear lumber
example.ja: 明瞭な天蓋(の書)。

definitions.definitionEn: Without diminution; in full; net.

example.en: a clear profit
example.ja: (かれらのため)相応しい報奨である。

definitions.definitionEn: All the way; entirely.

example.en: I threw it clear across the river to the other side.
example.ja: 川を渡って反対側に投げ込んだ

definitions.definitionEn: Not near something or touching it.

example.en: Stand clear of the rails, a train is coming.
example.ja: レールをどけろ電車が来る

definitions.definitionEn: Free (or separate) from others
In a clear manner; plainly.
The time ahead; those moments yet to be experienced.
Something that will happen in moments yet to come.
Goodness in what is yet to come. Something to look forward to.

example.en: There is no future in dwelling on the past.
example.ja: 過去について考えることには将来がありません。

definitions.definitionEn: The likely prospects for or fate of someone or something in time to come.
(grammar) Verb tense used to talk about events that will happen in the future; future tense.
An object that retrieves the value of a promise.
A minor-league prospect.
Having to do with or occurring in the future.

example.en: Future generations will either laugh or cry at our stupidity.
example.ja: 未来の世代は、我々の愚かさに笑うか泣くだろう。

definitions.definitionEn: Short for futures contract.
(after a negative) As well.

example.en: I don't like him, and I don't like her either.
example.ja: 彼のことは嫌いだし、私も彼女も好きではない。

definitions.definitionEn: One or other of two people or things.

example.en: He made me two offers, but I did not accept either.
example.ja: 彼は私に二つの申し出をしましたが、私も応じませんでした。

definitions.definitionEn: Both, each of two or more.
Introduces the first of two (or occasionally more) options or possibilities, the second (or last) of which is introduced by “or”.

example.en: Either you eat your dinner or you go to your room.
example.ja: 夕食を食べるか部屋に行くか

definitions.definitionEn: Gone; gone by; gone away; passed; passed away.

example.en: in days ago/in days agone
example.ja: 数日前/数日で

definitions.definitionEn: Nearly gone; dead (used in Devonshire at the turn of the 19th century)

example.en: Woe the day- she is agone!
example.ja: 災いなるかな、その日、彼女は滅びてしまえ。

definitions.definitionEn: Before

meaning: …につき,…ごとに / 《文》…によって,…で,…を通じて / 《しばしばas per…で》…によって示された通りに,…に従って

definitions.definitionEn: For each.

example.en: $2.50 per dozen
example.ja: 10 分につき 1,000 ドル

definitions.definitionEn: To each, in each (used in expressing ratios of units).

example.en: 100 centimeters per meter
example.ja: 100 センチ毎秒

definitions.definitionEn: By the, by means of the, via the, through the.

example.en: Introduce the endoscope per nasum.
example.ja: エストロゲンあたりのエントロスコープを

definitions.definitionEn: In accordance with.

example.en: I parked my car at the curb per your request.
example.ja: 君の要求に応じて車を敷いておいた

definitions.definitionEn: Belonging to per, their (singular). Gender-neutral third-person singular possessive adjective, coordinate with gendered his and her.
They (singular). Gender-neutral neologistic third-person singular subject pronoun, coordinate with gendered pronouns he and she.
Them (singular) Neologistic gender-neutral third-person singular object pronoun, suggested for use in place of him and her.

example: One question remains after the experiment.

definitions.definitionEn: (chiefly in the plural) That which is left; relic; remainder.
(in the plural) That which is left of a human being after the life is gone; relics; a dead body.
Posthumous works or productions, especially literary works.
State of remaining; stay.

To stay behind while others withdraw; to be left after others have been removed or destroyed; to be left after a number or quantity has been subtracted or cut off; to be left as not included or comprised.
To continue unchanged in place, form, or condition, or undiminished in quantity; to abide; to stay; to endure; to last.

example.en: There was no food in the house, so I had to remain hungry.
example.ja: 家の中には食べ物がなかったので、私は空腹のままでいなければなりませんでした。

definitions.definitionEn: To await; to be left to.
To continue in a state of being.

example.en: The light remained red for two full minutes.
example.ja: 光は丸 2 分間赤く保たれました。

meaning: 〈C〉《the ~》(…の)いちばん上の部分,最先端,頂上 / 〈C〉《the ~》(…の)最上面,表面《+of+名》 / 《the ~》(…の)最高位,首位;上座《+of+名》 / 《the ~》(…の)最高の程度,頂点《+of+名》 / 〈C〉《the ~》(びんなどの)ふた,栓;(車の)屋根[カバー],ほろ《+of+名》 / 〈C〉《複数形で》(根菜の)葉の部分《+of+名》 / 〈C〉(上下の服の)上 / 《通例名詞の前にのみ用いて》 / 最も高い,いちばんの / 最上位の,第一位(一級)の / 最高程度の / …におおい(ふた)を付ける / …の頂上にある,頂上をおおう / …の頂上に達する,を登りきる / …をしのぐ,にまさる / 〈野菜・果実など〉の葉の部分を切る(刈り込む) / (ゴルフで)〈球〉の上をたたく / こま

definitions.definitionEn: The highest or uppermost part of something.

example.en: His kite got caught at the top of the tree.
example.ja: たこは木の上でつかまったのです。

definitions.definitionEn: A child’s spinning toy; a spinning top.

example.en: The boy was amazed at how long the top would spin.
example.ja: 少年は、頂上がどれほど回転するかに驚きました。
